items.title_en: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Annealing for Protein Side-Chain Optimization: A Feasibility Study
items.title_zh: 用于蛋白质侧链优化的混合量子-经典退火：一项可行性研究
items.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum-classical annealing solvers are moving from research laboratories toward industrial use, but their advantage over classical optimization appears to be confined to a narrow class of problems. A recent systematic benchmark of the D-Wave hybrid solver against industry-leading classical solvers, across several classes of optimization problems, found it to be most competitive on binary quadratic programs, while noting that few industrial problems take this form. Therefore, identifying real-world industrial problems that can be modeled with this structure is a key challenge. We propose protein side-chain optimization, a core step of computational protein design, as one of these problems: it is natively a binary quadratic program, and its application context requires pools of low-energy solutions, which annealers naturally return. In this feasibility study, we test whether the competitiveness of the hybrid solver against industry-leading classical solvers extends to this problem. On 40 instances derived from 20 experimentally determined protein structures with up to about 200 amino acids and 2000 binary variables, we compare the results achieved with a hybrid solver, run for 5 seconds, against those of the commercial solver Gurobi, run for 10 seconds, 1000 seconds, and 4 hours. The hybrid solver reaches the certified optimum whenever one is available, matches Gurobi's performance on smaller instances, and outperforms it on larger instances, finding lower-energy solutions. These results show that the competitiveness of the hybrid solver on binary quadratic programs, so far observed only on a synthetic benchmark, extends to a real-world problem. This motivates comparisons with classical heuristics specific to protein side-chain optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 混合量子-经典退火求解器正从研究实验室走向工业应用，但其相对于经典优化的优势似乎仅限于一类狭窄的问题。最近一项针对 D-Wave 混合求解器与业界领先经典求解器在若干类优化问题上的系统性基准测试发现，它在二元二次规划上最具竞争力，同时指出很少有工业问题采用这种形式。因此，识别可用这种结构建模的真实工业问题是关键挑战。我们提出蛋白质侧链优化——计算蛋白质设计的核心步骤之一——作为这类问题之一：它本质上是二元二次规划，且其应用场景需要低能解池，而退火器会自然返回这类解。在这项可行性研究中，我们检验混合求解器相对于业界领先经典求解器的竞争力是否可扩展到该问题。在由20个实验测定的蛋白质结构导出的40个实例上（最多约200个氨基酸和2000个二元变量），我们将混合求解器运行5秒的结果与商业求解器 Gurobi 运行10秒、1000秒和4小时的结果进行比较。只要存在已认证最优解，混合求解器就能达到该最优解；在较小实例上它与 Gurobi 性能相当，在较大实例上则优于 Gurobi，找到能量更低的解。这些结果表明，混合求解器在二元二次规划上的竞争力——迄今仅在合成基准上观察到——可扩展到真实世界问题。这为与专门针对蛋白质侧链优化的经典启发式方法进行比较提供了动机。

items.title_en: From local learning to global electronic properties in large-scale systems
items.title_zh: 从局部学习到大规模系统中的全局电子性质
items.abstract_en: Machine learning from local atomic environments offers an efficient route to electronic structure, but evaluating global electronic properties in large systems remains computationally demanding. Here we combine real space charge density learning with stochastic propagation using Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians constructed from the predicted densities. The framework avoids target system self-consistent iterations and explicit diagonalization, while hierarchical blocking enables dense grid inference within limited GPU memory. We demonstrate density of states calculations for one million Si atoms and optical and transport calculations for over one hundred thousand atoms, without training separate models for each property. This framework extends the practical scale of electronic structure calculations within Kohn-Sham DFT, opening opportunities to investigate how atomic structure governs electronic, optical and transport properties at length scales relevant to real materials and devices.
items.abstract_zh: 从局部原子环境进行机器学习为电子结构提供了一条高效途径，但在大系统中评估全局电子性质仍然计算需求很高。在这里，我们将实空间电荷密度学习与随机传播相结合，使用由预测密度构建的 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量。该框架避免了目标系统的自洽迭代和显式对角化，而分层分块使稠密网格推断能够在有限的 GPU 内存内完成。我们展示了100万个硅（Si）原子的态密度计算，以及超过10万个原子的光学和输运计算，且无需为每种性质训练单独的模型。该框架扩展了 Kohn-Sham DFT 内电子结构计算的实际规模，为研究与真实材料和器件相关的长度尺度上原子结构如何支配电子、光学和输运性质开辟了机会。

items.title_en: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 组合性去对齐：审计大型视觉-语言模型的安全性
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）易受组合性危害：单独看无害的图像和提示，通过模型的跨模态推理会变得有害。近期的对齐方法在组合安全性基准上报告了很高的分数，但 LLM 评判器只衡量观察到的行为，无法揭示安全性被整合进模型的稳健程度。我们认为，去对齐提供了对对齐鲁棒性的补充审计。我们首先表明，最小化的监督微调可达到与多阶段强化学习流程相当的 LLM 评判分数，因此相似的基准分数本身不能确立鲁棒性。我们随后表明，组合性危害的识别与拒绝是解耦的：九种标准方向寻找方法检测组合性危害的 AUC 最高达 0.99，但消融所恢复的方向要么使拒绝保持不变，要么破坏模型连贯性。因此，我们提出 CMaG，一种用于组合安全性的免训练去对齐方法。CMaG 用拒绝与服从的对数概率边际度量拒绝意图，对其关于中间层激活求梯度，并将其与部分良性的配对进行对比，以分离跨模态交互项。对 80 个样本进行一次反向传播即可得到一个方向，沿该方向引导会单调地将拒绝转化为服从。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，CMaG 将组合安全性分数最多降低 65 分，同时超过 98% 的输出仍保持连贯，优于基于梯度的基线；该方向还可迁移到文本显式危害，并使经过防御性训练加固的模型去对齐。因此，组合安全性可以在行为上显得很强，却仍对有针对性的内部干预很脆弱。警告：本文包含不安全的模型输出，包括提及自残的内容。

items.title_en: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
items.title_zh: 语言作为特质，礼貌作为策略：LLM社交推理智能体中语言效应的受控测试
items.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过对话进行协调，而同一消息可以用更简单或更复杂的语言表述，也可以直率或礼貌地表述。我们使用 LURK Werewolf 框架检验这类差异是否会改变其他智能体的判断和行动；该框架将每句话的言语行为谓词与其自然语言表述分离。我们只重写表述，检查游戏内容得以保留，并从保存的检查点重放每个游戏日，与重采样的对照进行比较。我们在一个说话者的多条消息中一致地改变语言范围，并逐句改变礼貌策略。在30局游戏和4,335次重放中，两种操纵都没有改变其他智能体对说话者的信任，且在对多重比较进行校正后，没有任何对投票或夜间行动的影响仍然存在；最大的未校正效应是，将语言范围从中性改写移开，会使约多4个百分点的其他玩家投票发生改变。在自然对局中，无论角色如何，88%的威胁面子言语均采用 bald on-record 策略。

items.title_en: Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
items.title_zh: Seeing What Matters：面向操作的任务条件可操作空间信念基准测试
items.abstract_en: When should a robot look at the cup, and when at the portafilter? Spatial-reasoning benchmarks evaluate whether a model can describe a scene, but manipulation needs something more specific: the ability to acquire the particular evidence that makes the current command executable. A view that is informative for one task can be useless for another, even at the same workstation. We introduce Seeing What Matters, a benchmark for task-conditioned actionable spatial belief in simulated tabletop manipulation. Across three domains--coffee workstation, drawer/cabinet, and microwave/appliance--the benchmark provides 860 frozen evaluation cases; expanding across methods, budgets, and inference repeats yields more than 115,000 evaluator episodes under two protocols: closed-loop actionability and same-object functional out-of-distribution generalization. Each case pairs a set of candidate RGB views with a manipulation command, shared scripted skills, and hidden postconditions, so the benchmark directly measures whether a view-selection policy acquires the observations its command actually needs. We also provide a diagnostic reference pipeline that maintains a spatial-functional belief state and ranks views by missing evidence. At primary budget settings, this pipeline reaches 98.8% closed-loop and 98.9% functional-OOD success; ablating the functional or command-binding components collapses performance to near zero. Seven vision-language models, evaluated on the same cases, reach only 26-43%. Replacing the reference pipeline's coverage metadata with frozen RGB-derived scores preserves 98.5%/98.9% success; shuffling the visual scores collapses it to 15%/11%, confirming that the result depends on image content. These gaps suggest that spatial belief for manipulation should be evaluated not by scene-level completeness, but by whether it acquires the evidence the current command requires.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人何时应看杯子，何时应看冲煮手柄？空间推理基准评估模型能否描述场景，但操作需要更具体的东西：获取使当前指令可执行所需的特定证据的能力。对一项任务有信息量的视角对另一项任务可能毫无用处，即使在同一工作站也是如此。我们提出 Seeing What Matters，一个用于模拟桌面操作中任务条件可操作空间信念的基准。跨三个领域——咖啡工作站、抽屉/柜子和微波炉/电器——该基准提供860个冻结评测案例；在不同方法、预算和推理重复次数上扩展，可在两种协议下产生超过115,000个评估回合：闭环可操作性和同物体功能分布外泛化。每个案例将一组候选 RGB 视角与一条操作指令、共享的脚本化技能和隐藏后置条件配对，因此该基准直接测量视角选择策略是否获取其指令实际需要的观测。我们还提供一个诊断参考流水线，它维护空间-功能信念状态，并按缺失证据对视角排序。在主要预算设置下，该流水线达到98.8%的闭环成功率和98.9%的功能分布外成功率；消融功能组件或指令绑定组件会使性能降至接近零。在相同案例上评估的七个视觉语言模型仅达到26-43%。将参考流水线的覆盖元数据替换为冻结的 RGB 派生分数仍保持98.5%/98.9%的成功率；打乱视觉分数则使其降至15%/11%，证实该结果依赖于图像内容。这些差距表明，面向操作的空间信念不应按场景级完整性来评估，而应按其是否获取当前指令所需的证据来评估。

items.title_en: Refer-CityFlow and M3Track: A Benchmark Dataset and Reference Framework for Language-Driven Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking
items.title_zh: Refer-CityFlow与M3Track：面向语言驱动的多目标多摄像头跟踪的基准数据集与参考框架
items.abstract_en: Referring multi-object tracking enables users to specify targets through natural language, but existing Refer-MOT benchmarks primarily focus on single-camera settings. We formalize Referring Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking (Refer-MTMCT), where free-form queries specify identity-consistent trajectories to be recovered across a network of sequential, sparse-overlap cameras. We introduce Refer-CityFlow, a benchmark built on CityFlow's global cross-camera identity annotations and augmented with language queries requiring joint language grounding, cross-camera association, and spatio-temporal reasoning. Refer-CityFlow covers 96 videos from 40 roadside cameras with 660+ identity-consistent cross-camera trajectories, 4,362 trajectory-level descriptions, and 7,699 queries, including 1,699 real-user queries collected from 50 participants. Reference experiments on the four-camera Scenario 02 show that single-camera referring trackers reach 14.95-18.28 HOTA on real-user queries, while the evaluated cross-view method achieves about 0.05 HOTA in direct transfer. To establish reference performance, we provide M3Track, a modular multimodal reference framework in which a large language model (LLM)-based agent orchestrates interchangeable detection, tracking, and cross-camera association modules. M3Track reaches 44.10 HOTA and 65.40 IDF1 on the same real-user query set. The project repository is available at https://github.com/phuongnguyen194/Refer-CityFlow-and--M3Track.
items.abstract_zh: 指代多目标跟踪使用户能够通过自然语言指定目标，但现有的 Refer-MOT 基准主要集中于单摄像头设置。我们形式化了指代多目标多摄像头跟踪（Refer-MTMCT），其中自由形式查询指定需在由顺序、稀疏重叠摄像头组成的网络中恢复的身份一致轨迹。我们提出 Refer-CityFlow，一个基于 CityFlow 的全局跨摄像头身份标注构建的基准，并增加了需要联合语言接地、跨摄像头关联和时空推理的语言查询。Refer-CityFlow 涵盖来自40个路边摄像头的96个视频，包含660多条身份一致的跨摄像头轨迹、4,362条轨迹级描述和7,699条查询，其中包括从50名参与者收集的1,699条真实用户查询。在四摄像头场景02上的参考实验表明，单摄像头指代跟踪器在真实用户查询上达到14.95-18.28 HOTA，而所评估的跨视角方法在直接迁移中仅达到约0.05 HOTA。为建立参考性能，我们提供 M3Track，一个模块化多模态参考框架，其中基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编排可互换的检测、跟踪和跨摄像头关联模块。M3Track 在同一真实用户查询集上达到44.10 HOTA和65.40 IDF1。项目仓库见 https://github.com/phuongnguyen194/Refer-CityFlow-and--M3Track。

items.title_en: Personalized health coaching via coachable health age and counterfactual wearable trajectories
items.title_zh: 基于可指导健康年龄与反事实可穿戴轨迹的个性化健康指导
items.abstract_en: Personalized health coaching requires moving beyond retrospective wearable summaries toward quantitative, actionable behavioral prescriptions. We introduce Coachable Health Age (CHA), an interpretable health-age metric built from modifiable physiological and behavioral signals passively captured by consumer wearables. Across the WEAR-ME (N=2,780), All of Us (N=22,748), and longitudinal Fitbit (N=1,464) cohorts, CHA aligns with established cardiometabolic health constructs and improves prognostic discrimination for incident cardiovascular and metabolic disease beyond age, sex, and body mass index. To enable prospective behavioral optimization, we developed Sensor World Model (SensorWM), an action-conditioned wearable world model pretrained on over 2.2 million person-weeks of longitudinal sensor data from approximately 100,000 participants. SensorWM accurately forecasts multi-week physiological responses to candidate lifestyle changes ($R^2=0.664$), outperforming generic time-series foundation models while preserving downstream clinical signal for diabetes, hypertension, and other health outcomes. Finally, we integrate CHA and SensorWM into an agentic counterfactual coaching system to synthesize personalized 12-week coaching plans. In blinded paired reviews, certified lifestyle coaches preferred counterfactual-grounded plans over plans grounded in wearable history alone for overall quality (71.4%, P < 0.001) and anticipated adherence (71.0%, P < 0.001), and board-certified clinicians judged 99.2% of counterfactual-grounded plans to meet clinical safety criteria (vs. 97.6% of comparison plans). Automated evaluations across the full cohort (N=2,780) also favored counterfactual-grounded plans. By closing the loop between longitudinal tracking, trajectory prediction, and counterfactual coaching, our framework provides a scalable path to systematically improve cardiometabolic health.
items.abstract_zh: 个性化健康指导需要超越回顾性可穿戴设备摘要，转向定量、可操作的行为处方。我们提出可指导健康年龄（Coachable Health Age, CHA），一种由消费级可穿戴设备被动捕获的可改变生理和行为信号构建的可解释健康年龄指标。在 WEAR-ME（N=2,780）、All of Us（N=22,748）和纵向 Fitbit（N=1,464）队列中，CHA 与既定的心脏代谢健康构念一致，并在年龄、性别和体重指数之外改善了对新发心血管和代谢疾病的预后区分。为实现前瞻性行为优化，我们开发了 Sensor World Model（SensorWM），一种以动作为条件的可穿戴世界模型，其在来自约100,000名参与者的超过220万人-周的纵向传感器数据上预训练。SensorWM 能准确预测对候选生活方式改变的多周生理反应（R^2=0.664），优于通用时间序列基础模型，同时保留针对糖尿病、高血压和其他健康结局的下游临床信号。最后，我们将 CHA 和 SensorWM 集成到一个智能体式反事实指导系统中，以合成个性化的12周指导计划。在盲法配对评审中，认证生活方式教练在总体质量（71.4%，P < 0.001）和预期依从性（71.0%，P < 0.001）方面更偏好基于反事实的计划，而非仅基于可穿戴历史的计划；委员会认证临床医生判定99.2%的基于反事实的计划满足临床安全标准（对照计划为97.6%）。在全队列（N=2,780）上的自动化评估也更偏好基于反事实的计划。通过在纵向跟踪、轨迹预测和反事实指导之间闭环，我们的框架提供了一条系统性改善心脏代谢健康的可扩展路径。

items.title_en: Optical microscopy for pathological imaging: past, present, and future
items.title_zh: 病理成像中的光学显微镜：过去、现在与未来
items.abstract_en: Histopathology, the microscopic examination of stained tissue sections, remains the gold standard for pathology imaging, but its bright-field imaging is largely morphological. Advanced optical microscopy techniques move beyond this by exploiting diverse light-matter interactions, and are increasingly applied to pathological imaging. By capturing signals such as refractive index, polarisation, harmonic generation, Brillouin shift, and molecular vibrations, these microscopy techniques can provide quantitative or semi-quantitative information on tissue structure, mechanics, and chemical or molecular composition. In this review, we summarise the physical principles, key quantitative parameters, and representative pathological applications of seven modalities--optical diffraction tomography, polarisation microscopy, second-harmonic generation microscopy, third-harmonic generation microscopy, Brillouin microscopy, Raman microscopy, and fluorescence microscopy. We also discuss progress in artificial intelligence that supports reconstruction, analysis, and interpretation across these modalities, together with emerging trends in multimodal integration. Overall, this review shows how different optical contrasts can complement routine histopathology, while outlining the challenges and opportunities that will shape their clinical translation.
items.abstract_zh: 组织病理学是对染色组织切片进行显微镜检查，仍是病理成像的金标准，但其明场成像在很大程度上是形态学的。先进光学显微技术通过利用多样化的光-物质相互作用超越这一点，并越来越多地应用于病理成像。通过捕获折射率、偏振、谐波产生、布里渊频移和分子振动等信号，这些显微技术可提供关于组织结构、力学以及化学或分子组成的定量或半定量信息。在本综述中，我们总结七种模式的物理原理、关键定量参数和代表性病理应用——光学衍射层析、偏振显微、二次谐波产生显微、三次谐波产生显微、布里渊显微、拉曼显微和荧光显微。我们还讨论支持这些模式重建、分析和解释的人工智能进展，以及多模态集成的新兴趋势。总体而言，本综述展示不同光学对比度如何补充常规组织病理学，同时概述将塑造其临床转化的挑战和机遇。

items.title_en: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
items.title_zh: Muir：具有灵敏度分配门控与匹配滤波读出的线性注意力
items.abstract_en: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows, dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Muir, which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection, re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate, and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. Because standard chunkwise algorithms become numerically unstable at the large chunk sizes needed to saturate wide matrix units, we design a parallel update for stable, efficient training. Across 166M-1.34B parameters, Muir lowers perplexity by 1.8-2.0% over GDN-2 and 2.5-3.6% over Transformer, raises commonsense accuracy by up to 1.9 points, and improves extractive recall over GDN-2. At 1.34B, Muir outperforms both baselines on multi-hop and multi-needle recall, extrapolates 2,560x from its 4K training length to 10M-token streams without perplexity drift, and maintains near-100% passkey retrieval to 1M tokens with static readout. Muir achieves these gains while matching GDN-2 throughput, reaching its 100B-token validation loss 1.2x faster, and training 2.7x faster than Transformer at 32K.
items.abstract_zh: 线性注意力将上下文压缩为固定大小的键值状态，以实现线性时间训练和常量内存推理。门控 delta 规则模型会衰减该状态，并在写入新值之前擦除其对传入键的预测；Gated DeltaNet-2（GDN-2）通过逐通道衰减以及解耦的全秩擦除门和写入门对此进行推广。然而，我们表明状态更新对擦除的敏感度远低于对写入的敏感度：键激活和单位归一化将键能量集中到一小部分稀疏通道上，而值写入会缩放所有通道，因此擦除门可以用更低秩参数化。此外，慢衰减状态行累积的范数远大于快衰减行，主导无加权读出，并迫使在写入时进行更强的擦除以抑制干扰。受此分析指导，我们提出 Muir，它将所有门融合为灵敏度分配的低秩投影，用匹配滤波读出重新加权状态行，并将节省的参数重新投入到更宽的前馈网络中。由于标准分块算法在饱和宽矩阵单元所需的大分块尺寸下数值不稳定，我们设计了一种并行更新以实现稳定、高效的训练。在 166M–1.34B 参数范围内，Muir 相比 GDN-2 将困惑度降低 1.8–2.0%，相比 Transformer 降低 2.5–3.6%，将常识准确率提高最多 1.9 个点，并相比 GDN-2 提升抽取式召回。在 1.34B 参数下，Muir 在多跳和多针召回上均优于两个基线，从其 4K 训练长度外推到 10M token 流而困惑度不漂移，并在静态读出下对 1M token 保持接近 100% 的 passkey 检索。Muir 在实现这些增益的同时匹配 GDN-2 吞吐量，以 1.2 倍更快达到其 100B token 验证损失，并在 32K 下比 Transformer 训练快 2.7 倍。

items.title_en: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
items.title_zh: 具有联合训练低秩适配器的可操控多目标组相对偏好优化
items.abstract_en: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型部署通常需要在竞争性目标之间进行不同权衡，因为用户偏好会变化，而标准后训练方法通常针对固定目标权重产生单一策略。我们提出 LambdaMix，一种新的参数高效方法，利用组相对在线强化学习来学习以偏好为条件的一组策略。LambdaMix 在冻结基座模型上为每个目标联合训练一个低秩适配器。一个偏好向量选择生成响应的适配器混合，并对用于更新适配器的分别归一化奖励进行加权。单次训练运行支持在推理时改变偏好而无需进一步优化。我们在有用性和无害性以及遵循指令求解数学问题方面对四个模型进行了实验。我们还评估了两个最大模型在重写评论时保留措辞并减少关于个人属性的线索。在前两个任务上，LambdaMix 在所有四个模型上均比所有评估过的条件化和策略合并基线取得更高超体积。与一组 GRPO 专家策略相比，LambdaMix 使用更少的训练补全并存储更少的适配器参数。在架构和初始化固定时，同时改变适配器混合和目标权重比单独改变任一者给出更宽的分数范围和更高的覆盖度。

items.title_en: Extended Model-Based Learned Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: 扩展的基于模型的学习型惯性里程计
items.abstract_en: Inertial odometry is a compelling approach to state estimation for agile quadrotor flight due to its affordability, low weight, and robustness to perceptual degradation. However, relying only on integrated inertial measurements is impractical, as sensor errors and time-varying biases lead to significant pose drift. Although recent advances have enabled inertial odometry for drone racing, existing approaches show limited generalization to trajectories not seen during training. This work improves generalization by adopting a body-frame representation and incorporating body-frame torque dynamics into the learning pipeline. The learned model predicts short-horizon relative displacements, which are fused with IMU measurements in an Extended Kalman Filter. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the previous state-of-the-art learned inertial odometry approach for quadrotor pose estimation on unseen trajectories. An additional evaluation on four public quadrotor datasets, with whole trajectory shapes held out of training, confirms a lower velocity error on every held-out set and shows that the torque input is most informative when it is derived from the rotor signals. Code, data pipeline and trained models are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 惯性里程计由于成本低、重量轻且对感知退化具有鲁棒性，是敏捷四旋翼飞行状态估计的一种有吸引力的方法。然而，仅依赖积分惯性测量并不实际，因为传感器误差和时变偏置会导致显著的位姿漂移。尽管近期进展使惯性里程计能够用于无人机竞速，但现有方法对训练期间未见过的轨迹泛化能力有限。本工作通过采用机体坐标系表示并将机体坐标系力矩动力学纳入学习流程来提高泛化能力。学习模型预测短时域相对位移，并在扩展卡尔曼滤波中与 IMU 测量融合。实验结果表明，在未见轨迹上的四旋翼位姿估计中，所提方法优于先前最先进的学习型惯性里程计方法。在四个公开四旋翼数据集上的额外评估（整个轨迹形状保留在训练之外）确认每个留出集上的速度误差更低，并表明当力矩输入由旋翼信号导出时信息量最大。代码、数据流程和训练模型已公开可用。

items.title_en: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
items.title_zh: Flex-RSI：对前沿智能体递归自我改进的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Frontier language models are increasingly deployed as agents, and how well an agent performs depends not only on its model but also on its harness: the prompts, tools, memory, and control loop through which the model acts. When an agent is applied to a new problem, a natural question is whether it can use the feedback of the task to improve the way it works, and not merely its answer. Most existing benchmarks keep the agent's harness fixed and score the solution it produces, or target large-scale model training. We introduce Flex-RSI, a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget. In each round, an executor improves the task solution, which is kept only if it scores higher on held-out validation data, and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself. Every run starts from the same general-purpose harness, and the final solution is scored on hidden test data. Evaluating closed-source and open-weight models on tasks spanning perception, reasoning, robot action, 3D reconstruction, visual creation, and infrastructure, we find that self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, that feedback recording only success or failure holds back open-weight models, and that open-weight models fall furthest behind where outputs must pass strict checks of physical stability or exact correctness. Paired runs further show that editing the harness itself contributes to the gains.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型越来越多地作为智能体部署，而智能体表现如何不仅取决于其模型，还取决于其运行框架：模型通过提示、工具、记忆和控制循环来行动。当智能体被应用于新问题时，一个自然的问题是，它能否利用任务反馈来改进其工作方式，而不仅仅是改进其答案。大多数现有基准保持智能体运行框架固定并对其生成的解决方案评分，或针对大规模模型训练。我们提出 Flex-RSI，一个用于在固定预算下对视觉和机器人任务中的智能体递归自我改进进行基准测试的基准。在每一轮中，执行器改进任务解决方案，仅当该方案在留出验证数据上得分更高时才保留，然后改进器修订运行框架，包括执行器及其自身。每次运行都从相同的通用运行框架开始，最终解决方案在隐藏测试数据上评分。在涵盖感知、推理、机器人动作、3D 重建、视觉创建和基础设施的任务上评估闭源和开放权重模型，我们发现：当智能体构建自己的解决方案时，自我改进帮助最大；仅记录成功或失败的反馈会阻碍开放权重模型；开放权重模型在输出必须通过物理稳定性或精确正确性严格检查的地方落后最多。配对运行进一步表明，编辑运行框架本身对这些增益有贡献。

items.title_en: Mind Control of LLMs via Closed-Loop Stimulation: Out-of-Distribution Robustness
items.title_zh: 通过闭环刺激对LLM进行思维控制：分布外鲁棒性
items.abstract_en: Brains and large language models need not be considered equivalent systems to reveal an interpretable commonality: both exhibit high-dimensional, nonlinear dynamics whose behavior can only be modeled imperfectly. This creates a shared challenge whenever we seek to intervene in their dynamics. A controller may either rely on a model identified around a particular operating regime and risk failure as the system moves away from that regime, or explicitly account for uncertainty and a changing internal state. Neurostimulation has confronted an analogous problem for decades. The limitations of fixed, open-loop stimulation have motivated closed-loop and state-dependent approaches that condition intervention on the ongoing state of the neural system. Inspired by this principle, we formulate LLM steering as a feedback-control problem in which the network's internal state, rather than a fixed intervention alone, determines how the system is perturbed. We further account for the mismatch between tractable dynamical models and the nonlinear transformer they approximate through robust control. As one principled realization of this framework, we develop an $H_\infty$-based steering controller that limits sensitivity to disturbances and linearization mismatches. Across multiple steering benchmarks, the controller improves performance over existing baselines, with particularly pronounced gains under out-of-distribution conditions and varying length complexities. Beyond controller performance, we introduce robust steerability, $S_{\mathrm{rob}}$, a pre-deployment measure of tolerance to dynamics mismatch; across model-task pairs, it exhibits task-specific structure and varies systematically with model scale. Beyond robust LLM steering, our measure asks not merely whether control is possible, but how much uncertainty it can survive; a principle that may span artificial and biological neural systems.
items.abstract_zh: 大脑与大型语言模型不必被视为等价系统，也能揭示一种可解释的共性：二者都表现出高维非线性动力学，其行为只能被不完美地建模。这在我们试图干预其动力学时构成了共同挑战。控制器可以依赖在特定运行区间附近辨识的模型，并承担系统偏离该区间时失效的风险；也可以显式考虑不确定性和变化的内部状态。神经刺激数十年来一直面对类似问题。固定开环刺激的局限性推动了闭环与状态依赖方法，这些方法根据神经系统的持续状态来条件化干预。受这一原理启发，我们将 LLM 引导表述为一个反馈控制问题，其中由网络内部状态而非仅由固定干预决定系统如何被扰动。我们进一步通过鲁棒控制来处理可处理动力学模型与其所近似的非线性 Transformer 之间的失配。作为该框架的一种有原则实现，我们开发了一种基于 $H_\infty$ 的引导控制器，限制对扰动和线性化失配的敏感性。在多个引导基准上，该控制器相比现有基线提升了性能，在分布外条件和不同长度复杂度下增益尤为显著。除控制器性能外，我们引入鲁棒可引导性 $S_{\mathrm{rob}}$，一种部署前衡量对动力学失配容忍度的指标；在模型-任务对上，它表现出任务特定结构，并随模型规模系统性变化。超越鲁棒的 LLM 引导，我们的指标不仅追问控制是否可能，还追问它能承受多少不确定性；这一原则可能横跨人工与生物神经系统。

items.title_en: Neutral-atom quantum features as complementary structural encodings for graph learning
items.title_zh: 中性原子量子特征作为图学习的补充结构编码
items.abstract_en: Structural descriptors provide graph neural networks (GNNs) with positional and topological inductive biases. However, widely used classical encodings based on random walks or Laplacian spectra emphasize specific structural statistics of a graph, leaving room for alternative descriptors. Neutral-atom quantum processing units (QPUs) can realize graph-dependent Rydberg Hamiltonians, allowing graph topology to be probed through dynamical correlation measurements. In this work, we use these measurements as quantum graph features (QGFs), providing a complementary, hardware-derived family of structural encoding that is not accurately described by classical features derived from Laplacian and adjacency matrices, even when supplemented with an extended set of random-walk, geometric descriptors and classical physical models. By appropriately selecting the quench parameters of the Hamiltonian, we access two characteristic correlation regimes with distinct structural signatures: antiferromagnetic-like and ferromagnetic-like. On an intrinsic information benchmark of 15 topological and spectral probing tasks, quantum and hybrid quantum-classical features match or surpass classical descriptors on local topological properties. When supplied to message-passing, attention, and graph-transformer backbones, hybrid quantum-classical features yield improvements that are within cross-fold noise on most cells but sign-consistent across architectures. When comparing noiseless, shot-sampled emulation-derived quantum features with a neutral-atom QPU implementation, the downstream hybrid results with compressed hardware features match their emulated counterparts within $0.01$ F$_1$ on all backbones. On a synthetic family of ladder graphs, QGFs distinguish two specific classes, outperforming the strongest classical structural descriptors by a margin exceeding cross-fold variability.
items.abstract_zh: 结构描述符为图神经网络（GNN）提供位置和拓扑归纳偏置。然而，基于随机游走或拉普拉斯谱的广泛使用的经典编码强调图的特定结构统计量，为替代描述符留下了空间。中性原子量子处理单元（QPU）可以实现依赖图的里德堡哈密顿量，从而通过动力学关联测量探测图拓扑。在本工作中，我们将这些测量用作量子图特征（QGF），提供一种互补的、硬件导出的结构编码族；即使补充扩展的随机游走、几何描述符和经典物理模型，源自拉普拉斯矩阵和邻接矩阵的经典特征也无法准确描述这种编码。通过适当选择哈密顿量的淬火参数，我们获得两个具有不同结构特征的特征关联区间：类反铁磁和类铁磁。在包含 15 项拓扑和谱探测任务的内在信息基准上，量子和混合量子-经典特征在局部拓扑性质上匹配或超过经典描述符。当提供给消息传递、注意力和图 Transformer 骨干时，混合量子-经典特征在大多数单元格上的改进处于跨折噪声范围内，但在不同架构间符号一致。当将无噪声、散粒采样仿真导出的量子特征与中性原子 QPU 实现进行比较时，使用压缩硬件特征的下游混合结果在所有骨干上与仿真对应结果在 0.01 F1 以内匹配。在合成梯形图族上，QGF 区分两个特定类别，以超过跨折变异性的幅度优于最强的经典结构描述符。

items.title_en: Generative Latent Priors for Interpreting and Steering Protein Language Models
items.title_zh: 用于解释和引导蛋白质语言模型的生成式潜在先验
items.abstract_en: Dominant methods for interpreting large models impose strong structural assumptions. Generative Latent Priors (GLP) are a complementary approach: a diffusion model that learns the distribution of a frozen model's activations directly, imposing no assumptions. We port GLP to ESM-2 activations (UniRef50) and evaluate it at two host scales (ESM-2-8M and -650M), both as a lens for protein representations and as a prior for editing them. Generation quality scales smoothly with depth and compute. As a lens, single GLP "meta-neurons" are the strongest probes of discrete Swiss-Prot concepts at both hosts, beating InterPLM's released SAE features, and lead on continuous properties at 8M though not at 650M; falsification tests show this is mostly concentration, not new information. As an editing prior, the on-manifold correction makes DiffMean steering of three biochemical properties effective and restores on-manifoldness, but only in isolation: re-embedding the sequences actually produced after several rounds of decoding, the structural plausibility is compromised. This is mainly reproduced in additional SAE-based clamping structural steering experiments, where only Helix motif succeeds. The naturalness failure is traced to the rewriting coverage and the decoder rather than the prior, highlighting what the method must clear before it can serve for both discovery-by-editing and discovery-by-exploration. Trained GLPs are released on huggingface.co/collections/HPAI-BSC/glprot.
items.abstract_zh: 解释大型模型的主导方法施加了很强的结构假设。生成式潜在先验（GLP）是一种互补方法：直接学习冻结模型激活分布的扩散模型，不施加任何假设。我们将 GLP 移植到 ESM-2 激活（UniRef50），并在两种宿主规模（ESM-2-8M 和 -650M）上评估，既作为蛋白质表示的一种透镜，也作为编辑这些表示的先验。生成质量随深度和计算量平滑扩展。作为透镜，单个 GLP“元神经元”在两种宿主上都是对 Swiss-Prot 离散概念最强的探针，优于 InterPLM 发布的 SAE 特征，并在 8M 上在连续性质方面领先，但在 650M 上则不然；证伪测试表明这主要是集中，而非新信息。作为编辑先验，流形上校正使 DiffMean 对三种生化性质的引导有效并恢复流形性，但仅在孤立情况下如此：对经过多轮解码后实际产生的序列重新嵌入时，结构合理性受损。这一点主要在额外的基于 SAE 的钳制结构引导实验中重现，其中只有 Helix 基序成功。自然性失败被追溯到重写覆盖范围和解码器而非先验，突显了该方法在能够同时服务于通过编辑发现和通过探索发现之前必须清除的问题。训练好的 GLP 已在 huggingface.co/collections/HPAI-BSC/glprot 发布。

items.title_en: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively
items.title_zh: RPEG：可扩展且高性价比地训练推理语言模型
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now central to training Reasoning Language Models (RLMs), but RLM pipelines are difficult to scale and costly to run because each RL step couples multiple large models, heterogeneous stages, cross-step state, and complex asynchronous dependencies. Existing systems typically optimize only parts of this design space. We address this complexity by jointly optimizing the pipeline structure as well as its execution using a novel data-centric graph intermediate representation called RLM Pipeline Execution Graph (RPEG). RPEG exposes structural choices such as bounded asynchrony and actor-critic sharing together with execution optimizations such as stage fusion, fine-grained scheduling, and multi-dimensional model parallelism. It is coupled with a comprehensive analytical performance model for RLM training, jointly capturing compute, communication, memory, and hierarchical rack-, node-, and GPU-level effects. Across systems with up to 256 GH200 GPUs, our distributed runtime engine implementing RPEG improves performance by up to 2x over ReaL and reduces step latency by up to 2.48x over verl, while increasing hardware utilization by up to 30%. Overall, RPEG provides a graph-driven foundation for next-generation training pipelines for frontier reasoning LLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）现在是训练推理语言模型（RLM）的核心，但 RLM 流水线难以扩展且运行成本高，因为每个 RL 步骤耦合多个大模型、异构阶段、跨步骤状态和复杂异步依赖。现有系统通常只优化该设计空间的一部分。我们通过使用一种新的以数据为中心的图中间表示——RLM 流水线执行图（RPEG）——联合优化流水线结构及其执行，以应对这种复杂性。RPEG 暴露有界异步和 actor-critic 共享等结构选择，以及阶段融合、细粒度调度和多维模型并行等执行优化。它与一个全面的 RLM 训练分析性能模型相结合，共同刻画计算、通信、内存以及机架、节点和 GPU 层级的分层效应。在最多 256 块 GH200 GPU 的系统上，实现 RPEG 的分布式运行时引擎相比 ReaL 将性能提升最高 2 倍，相比 verl 将步骤延迟降低最高 2.48 倍，同时将硬件利用率提高最高 30%。总体而言，RPEG 为前沿推理 LLM 的下一代训练流水线提供了图驱动的基础。

items.title_en: SURE:Spatiotemporal Uncertainty Representation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Learning
items.title_zh: SURE：面向高效视觉-语言-动作学习的时空不确定性表示
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have become a promising paradigm for end-to-end robot control, but their effectiveness still depends heavily on large volumes of demonstration data. In manipulation tasks, this dependence is compounded by structured spatiotemporal uncertainty in the action space: multiple nearby actions or trajectories may successfully solve the same task, while semantically equivalent demonstrations often unfold at different speeds. Standard pointwise supervision treats each demonstrated action as an exact target, imposing an unnecessary learning burden under such uncertainty. We present SURE, a data-efficient VLA training framework that explicitly models both spatial and temporal uncertainty. SURE augments a VLA backbone with a lightweight transposed-convolutional probabilistic action decoder that captures spatial uncertainty through local correlations among neighboring action bins. It further introduces Soft-DTW alignment supervision to accommodate local timing variations between predicted and demonstrated action chunks. Together, these two components reduce sensitivity to demonstrator-specific poses and execution timing, enabling more data-efficient action learning. We evaluate SURE on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks. Even with only 10% of the demonstration data or 20% of the training steps, SURE achieves manipulation success rates that match or surpass baseline VLAs.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已成为端到端机器人控制的一种有前景的范式，但其有效性仍严重依赖大量演示数据。在操作任务中，这种依赖因动作空间中结构化的时空不确定性而加剧：多个邻近动作或轨迹都可能成功解决同一任务，而语义等价的演示往往以不同速度展开。标准逐点监督将每个演示动作视为精确目标，在此类不确定性下造成不必要的学习负担。我们提出 SURE，一个数据高效的 VLA 训练框架，显式建模空间和时间不确定性。SURE 在 VLA 主干上增加一个轻量转置卷积概率动作解码器，通过相邻动作 bin 之间的局部相关性捕获空间不确定性。它进一步引入 Soft-DTW 对齐监督，以适应预测动作块与演示动作块之间的局部时间变化。这两个组件共同降低了对演示者特定姿态和执行时序的敏感性，从而实现更数据高效的动作学习。我们在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实世界操作任务上评估 SURE。即使仅使用 10% 的演示数据或 20% 的训练步骤，SURE 仍达到与基线 VLA 匹配或超越的操作成功率。

items.title_en: Dynamic GPU Voxel Grids and Voxel-sequential Processing in NanoVDB
items.title_zh: NanoVDB 中的动态 GPU 体素网格与体素顺序处理
items.abstract_en: We introduce two fundamental advances to the NanoVDB data structure: dynamic GPU-native topological updates, and a voxel-sequential access paradigm that dramatically accelerates point-wise and stencil-based operators on sparse grids. NanoVDB's linearized memory layout has delivered strong GPU performance, and the Index-Grid concept introduced in the fVDB framework [Williams et al 2024] provided topology/data separation and optimal compactness of storage in sparse machine learning workloads. However, all these prior iterations of NanoVDB assume a static topology that has precluded use of this data structure in simulation and dynamic geometric processes. We eliminate this limitation by introducing a suite of dynamic topology operators -- morphological dilation, grid merging, pruning, and cross-resolution coarsening and refinement. These operators use bit-parallel algorithms to reconstruct grids containing hundreds of millions of voxels in just a few milliseconds. We also introduce a voxel-sequential access paradigm and data structure for GPU kernels operating on sparse data. We stream active voxels as a flat linear sequence, minimizing or eliminating the need for tree traversal in the process. This achieves compute density and regularity that allow even complex stencil-based operators to approach peak memory bandwidth, with minimal storage overhead. Together, these contributions remove the read-only constraint from NanoVDB, establishing it as a high-performance primary representation for dynamic GPU simulation and geometry manipulation. We evaluate the efficacy of our newly introduced operators in benchmarks sourced from applications such as 3D reconstruction, fluid simulation, and large-scale mesh voxelization.
items.abstract_zh: 我们为 NanoVDB 数据结构引入两项基础性进展：动态的 GPU 原生拓扑更新，以及一种体素顺序访问范式，可显著加速稀疏网格上的逐点和模板类算子。NanoVDB 的线性化内存布局已带来强劲的 GPU 性能，fVDB 框架 [Williams et al 2024] 引入的 Index-Grid 概念在稀疏机器学习工作负载中提供了拓扑/数据分离和最优存储紧凑性。然而，NanoVDB 先前所有迭代都假设静态拓扑，这使该数据结构无法用于仿真和动态几何过程。我们通过引入一套动态拓扑算子——形态学膨胀、网格合并、剪枝以及跨分辨率粗化和细化——消除了这一限制。这些算子使用位并行算法，在短短几毫秒内重建包含数亿体素的网格。我们还为在稀疏数据上运行的 GPU 内核引入体素顺序访问范式和数据结构。我们将活动体素作为扁平线性序列流式传输，在此过程中最小化或消除树遍历需求。这实现了计算密度和规整性，使即使复杂的模板类算子也能以最小存储开销接近峰值内存带宽。这些贡献共同消除了 NanoVDB 的只读约束，使其成为动态 GPU 仿真和几何操作的高性能主表示。我们在来自 3D 重建、流体仿真和大规模网格体素化等应用的基准上评估了新引入算子的有效性。

items.title_en: A multi-scale cell-type resolved map of trans-regulatory architecture in the aging human brain
items.title_zh: 衰老人脑反式调控架构的多尺度细胞类型分辨图谱
items.abstract_en: Mapping genetic effects on distal genes and regulatory programs is essential for understanding how genetic variation influences complex diseases; yet trans-QTL discovery remains limited by weak effect sizes, extensive multiple testing and poor reproducibility. Here, we introduce TransMap, a generalizable computational framework that combines multi-scale trans-QTL mapping with multi-phenotype genetic colocalization to improve the discovery and interpretation of distal regulatory variants. Beyond individual trans-eGenes, TransMap constructs local co-regulatory program phenotypes that account for background expression variation to improve the detection of weak, coordinated distal genetic effects. Across a broad range of simulation settings, TransMap achieved 9.2-36.7% higher trans-QTL discovery power than existing methods while maintaining well-controlled type I error rates. We applied TransMap to bulk and single-nucleus transcriptomic profiles from the aging human brain in the ADSP Functional Genomics Consortium (FunGen-AD), further integrating proteomic, glycoproteomic and metabolomic biomarker measurements (average N=476 donors). Genome-wide fine-mapping of TransMap single-gene and program-level QTL yielded variant annotations with 2.75-2.88x heritability enrichment across 57 complex diseases and traits (average N=307K), with complementary heritability information captured across regulatory scales. Multi-phenotype colocalization identified 49,532 trans-regulatory events supported by shared genetic signals with cis-eQTL or biomarker-QTL, including 1,825 candidate cis-trans-biomarker regulatory configurations. TransMap further revealed an asymmetric cross-cell-type regulatory architecture in which neuronal cis-regulatory signals preferentially associate with coordinated glial trans-regulatory responses, supported by co-culture experiments and spatial transcriptomics. Alzheimer's disease (AD) GWAS-prioritized colocalization identified trans-regulatory associations in 115 AD-associated loci, including a KNOP1 cis-eQTL associated in trans with a microglial regulatory program containing MS4A4E, with additional support from statistical mediation analysis. TransMap provides a multi-scale, cell-type-resolved atlas of trans-regulatory variation and a generalizable framework for elucidating the regulatory architecture of complex diseases.
items.abstract_zh: 绘制遗传变异对远端基因和调控程序的影响，对于理解遗传变异如何影响复杂疾病至关重要；然而，trans-QTL 发现仍受限于效应量较弱、大量多重检验和可重复性差。在此，我们提出 TransMap，一个可推广的计算框架，将多尺度 trans-QTL 定位与多表型遗传共定位相结合，以改进远端调控变异的发现和解释。除单个 trans-eGene 外，TransMap 构建局部共调控程序表型，其考虑背景表达变异，以提高对微弱、协同的远端遗传效应的检测。在广泛的仿真设置中，TransMap 的 trans-QTL 发现功效比现有方法高 9.2–36.7%，同时保持良好控制的第一类错误率。我们将 TransMap 应用于 ADSP 功能基因组学联盟（FunGen-AD）中衰老人类大脑的批量及单核转录组图谱，进一步整合蛋白质组、糖蛋白质组和代谢组生物标志物测量（平均 N=476 名供体）。对 TransMap 单基因和程序水平 QTL 进行全基因组精细定位，得到的变异注释在 57 种复杂疾病和性状（平均 N=307K）中具有 2.75–2.88 倍的遗传力富集，并在不同调控尺度上捕获互补的遗传力信息。多表型共定位识别出 49,532 个反式调控事件，这些事件由与 cis-eQTL 或生物标志物-QTL 共享的遗传信号支持，包括 1,825 个候选 cis-trans-生物标志物调控配置。TransMap 进一步揭示了跨细胞类型的不对称调控架构，其中神经元 cis 调控信号优先与协同的胶质 trans 调控响应相关，并得到共培养实验和空间转录组学的支持。阿尔茨海默病（AD）GWAS 优先化的共定位在 115 个 AD 相关位点中识别出反式调控关联，包括一个 KNOP1 cis-eQTL 与包含 MS4A4E 的小胶质细胞调控程序发生反式关联，并得到统计中介分析的额外支持。TransMap 提供了 trans 调控变异的多尺度、细胞类型分辨图谱，以及一个用于阐明复杂疾病调控架构的可推广框架。

items.title_en: Deep-UV All-dielectric qBIC Metasurface for Refractive Index Sensing
items.title_zh: 用于折射率传感的深紫外全介质 qBIC 超表面
items.abstract_en: All-dielectric metasurfaces supporting quasi-bound states in the continuum (qBICs) have emerged as powerful platforms for biosensing, yet their operation remains largely concentrated in the visible and near-infrared regimes. Extending these resonances into the deep-ultraviolet (DUV) to probe the intrinsic electronic absorption of biomolecules presents substantial material and nanofabrication challenges. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a hafnium dioxide (HfO$_{2}$) metasurface supporting DUV qBICs in the wavelength range from 225 nm to 340 nm with quality factors reaching 500. We further demonstrate its refractive index sensing capabilities through integration with a microfluidic cell and optical characterization in reflection mode. We show that the introduction of an aqueous buffer leads to a further quality factor enhancement. Achieving a sensitivity of up to approximately 60 nm/RIU and an operational figure of merit of 40 $\mathrm{RIU}^{-1}$, this low-loss HfO$_{2}$ metasurface provides a robust foundation for label-free DUV biosensing.
items.abstract_zh: 支持连续域中准束缚态（qBIC）的全介质超表面已成为生物传感的有力平台，但其工作波段仍主要集中在可见光和近红外区域。将这些共振扩展到深紫外（DUV）以探测生物分子的本征电子吸收，带来了显著的材料和纳米制造挑战。在此，我们实验演示了一种二氧化铪（HfO$_{2}$）超表面，在 225 nm 至 340 nm 波长范围内支持 DUV qBIC，品质因数达到 500。我们进一步通过与微流控池集成以及在反射模式下进行光学表征，展示了其折射率传感能力。我们表明，引入水性缓冲液会带来品质因数的进一步增强。该低损耗 HfO$_{2}$ 超表面实现了高达约 60 nm/RIU 的灵敏度和 40 $\mathrm{RIU}^{-1}$ 的工作品质因数，为无标记 DUV 生物传感提供了稳健基础。

items.title_en: ICare-DT: a digital twin for continuous forecasting of intensive care patients
items.title_zh: ICare-DT：用于重症监护患者连续预测的数字孪生
items.abstract_en: Digital twins of intensive care patients should update forecasts from new data and predict treatment responses, but few studies test whether routine records support either. We propose ICare-DT, a Transformer-based twin that updates a latent patient state hourly from new measurements without retraining. We trained it on 140,473 eICU-CRD stays to forecast vital signs crossing their training-set means. On test data, later forecasts beat the twin's own hour-6 forecasts of the same windows in all 12 settings (+0.073 to +0.153 AUROC). On validation data, controls that withheld or swapped the new hours traced the gain to the patient's own measurements. Without refitting, the model kept its gain on a second database (8 of 9 settings, +0.025 to +0.114 AUROC) in a prespecified evaluation of the previously analyzed MIMIC-IV test split. Refitted within MIMIC-IV, a twin state fine-tuned on clinical endpoints gave gradient boosting a significant gain for acute kidney injury (+0.0035 AUROC; hypotension +0.0010, not significant). To test response prediction, we built a benchmark that replaces the treatments in real records with simulated doses and injects responses of known size, visible only at measurement times. Ridge models supervised with injected effects recovered them from real records only through frequently measured variables (heart rate) read at their measurement times. We asked standard learners to predict these effects for a dosing regime no patient had received. No standard learner outperformed predicting zero effect at an out-of-support query. When told how the simulated responses were generated, a separate learner recovered the effects from the same records without seeing their true values (R2 0.30 to 0.40 at one effect size). Routine records support forecasts that improve with each patient's new data, and our benchmark is a testbed for models that learn how responses are generated.
items.abstract_zh: 重症监护患者的数字孪生应能从新数据更新预测并预测治疗反应，但很少有研究检验常规记录是否支持二者。我们提出 ICare-DT，一个基于 Transformer 的孪生，它无需重新训练即可每小时根据新测量更新潜在患者状态。我们在 140,473 次 eICU-CRD 住院上训练它，以预测生命体征跨越其训练集均值。在测试数据上，较晚的预测在所有 12 种设置中都优于该孪生自己对相同窗口的第 6 小时预测（AUROC +0.073 至 +0.153）。在验证数据上，扣留或替换新增小时数据的对照实验将增益归因于患者自身的测量。在针对先前分析过的 MIMIC-IV 测试划分的预先设定评估中，模型无需重新拟合，在第二个数据库上保持增益（9 种设置中的 8 种，AUROC +0.025 至 +0.114）。在 MIMIC-IV 内重新拟合后，在临床终点上微调的孪生状态使梯度提升在急性肾损伤上获得显著增益（AUROC +0.0035；低血压 +0.0010，不显著）。为测试反应预测，我们构建了一个基准，将真实记录中的治疗替换为模拟剂量，并注入已知幅度的反应，这些反应仅在测量时间可见。用注入效应监督的 Ridge 模型仅通过在其测量时间读取的频繁测量变量（心率）从真实记录中恢复了这些效应。我们要求标准学习器为没有任何患者接受过的给药方案预测这些效应。在超出支持范围的查询上，没有标准学习器优于预测零效应。当被告知模拟反应是如何生成的时，一个单独的学习器在未看到真实值的情况下从相同记录中恢复了这些效应（在一种效应大小下 R2 为 0.30 至 0.40）。常规记录支持随每位患者新数据而改善的预测，我们的基准是用于学习反应如何生成的模型的测试平台。

items.title_en: PhoPunct: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Transformer Architectures for Vietnamese Punctuation Restoration
items.title_zh: PhoPunct：用于越南语标点恢复的 Transformer 架构大规模基准
items.abstract_en: Vietnamese punctuation restoration is often evaluated on relatively small benchmarks, limiting conclusions about how architectural choices scale with data volume. We present a controlled benchmark on News and Novels corpora containing 22.1 million labeled tokens (19.9M News and 2.2M Novels). We evaluate 17 architectures formed from four pretrained Transformer backbones and optional bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and conditional random field (CRF) layers, together with a PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF model, PhoPunct. Every model is trained for eight epochs with the same learning rate and without architecture-specific tuning. Under this fixed budget, adding Bi-LSTM and CRF layers does not reliably improve macro F1: in seven of eight matched domain-backbone comparisons, a plain Transformer classifier matches or outperforms its Bi-LSTM-CRF counterpart. PhoPunct obtains the best News result (61.35), whereas XLM-R with a CRF obtains the best Novels result (50.18), exceeding PhoPunct (48.97). These results show that the value of recurrent and structured-prediction heads depends on their optimization regime and motivate explicit separation between architectural improvements and improvements due to architecture-specific tuning. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/aisia-research-lab/PhoPunct
items.abstract_zh: 越南语标点恢复通常在相对较小的基准上评估，限制了对架构选择如何随数据量扩展的结论。我们在包含 2210 万个标注 token 的 News 和 Novels 语料（1990 万 News 和 220 万 Novels）上提出了一个受控基准。我们评估了由四个预训练 Transformer 主干与可选双向长短期记忆（Bi-LSTM）和条件随机场（CRF）层构成的 17 种架构，以及一个 PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF 模型 PhoPunct。每个模型都使用相同学习率训练八个 epoch，且不进行架构特定调优。在此固定预算下，添加 Bi-LSTM 和 CRF 层并不能可靠提升宏 F1：在八组匹配的领域-主干比较中，有七组普通 Transformer 分类器匹配或优于其 Bi-LSTM-CRF 对应模型。PhoPunct 获得最佳 News 结果（61.35），而带 CRF 的 XLM-R 获得最佳 Novels 结果（50.18），超过 PhoPunct（48.97）。这些结果表明，循环和结构化预测头的价值取决于其优化方案，并促使明确区分架构改进与由架构特定调优带来的改进。我们的源代码见：https://github.com/aisia-research-lab/PhoPunct

items.title_en: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
items.title_zh: MOMASPLAT：面向移动操作任务的动态新视角示范增强
items.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.
items.abstract_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感。这对移动操作（MoMa）尤其成问题，因为由于导航不确定性、定位漂移和环境约束，机器人很少从示范采集时使用的完全相同基座位姿执行操作。近期方法使用新视角合成（NVS）用未见视角增强示范，但它们假设静态场景，因此无法在接触后交互阶段重新渲染被操作物体，使示范中最关键的部分未被增强。我们提出 MOMASPLAT，一个面向移动操作的新视角示范增强框架，可从未见机器人基座位姿合成完整操作轨迹，包括动态物体交互。我们的关键洞察是，标准 MoMa 数据采集自然提供了在三维中重建静态场景和被操作物体所需的多视角观测。MOMASPLAT 结合三维高斯泼溅、前馈三维基础模型和基于运动学的动作重定向，分别重建场景与被操作物体，从新视角渲染它们，并生成与变换后动作配对的几何一致的合成示范。我们在三个场景中涉及刚性和铰接物体的五个真实世界移动操作任务上评估 MOMASPLAT，并在仿真中对照真值验证其合成示范的保真度。MOMASPLAT 显著提升了对未见基座位姿的鲁棒性，将最强基线的平均成功率提高一倍以上，并在所有基线都失败的大基座位移下保持非平凡的成功率，同时减少了对大规模真实世界数据采集的需求。

items.title_en: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
items.title_zh: 基于假设空间推理的碰撞结构重建
items.abstract_en: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.
items.abstract_zh: 物体隐藏内部结构（包括空腔的存在和位置）的知识对于预测性仿真、机器人操作和无损检测至关重要。然而，此类空腔在静态可见表面上没有直接特征，使得碰撞诱导的形变成为推断其存在的少数线索之一。Structure from Collision（SfC）通过从一次碰撞事件的多视角观测中恢复物体的隐藏内部结构来解决该问题。SfC 具有挑战性有两个原因：隐藏空腔只能通过表面运动间接观测；空洞对应于材料缺失，使得使用标准密度表示的直接优化变得困难。基于密度的 SfC 基线同时继承了这两个困难。表面匹配梯度不能直接指示空腔位置，而密度梯度在空洞区域内部或附近可能较弱或缺乏信息。因此，我们将 SfC 重新表述为假设空间推理，将隐藏空腔表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码可用的结构假设，而不是依赖隐式密度更新。全局阶段使用仅前向的物质点法（MPM）仿真在该假设空间上进行无梯度优化。随后，局部阶段将选定的假设作为拉格朗日粒子系统，通过使用可微 MPM 仿真的基于梯度的优化进行细化。在 SfC 基准上，我们的方法在隐藏结构重建和未来预测方面优于基于密度的 SfC 基线。内部拓扑压力测试和鲁棒性分析刻画了其范围和局限性。项目页面见 https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/。

items.title_en: Three-dimensional mapping of human lung fibrosis identifies spatial coupling between tissue microarchitecture and maladaptive repair states
items.title_zh: 人类肺纤维化的三维图谱揭示组织微结构与适应不良修复状态之间的空间耦合
items.abstract_en: Human lung fibrosis progressively destroys three-dimensional tissue architecture, yet how the structural microenvironment shapes cellular states remains unclear. Integrating 3D X-ray histology with spatial omics, we generate a volumetric multimodal atlas of human lung fibrosis that enables direct interrogation of relationships between tissue microarchitecture and spatial molecular programmes. We identify collapse of the alveolar-capillary unit - the coupled loss of alveolar type 1 epithelial cells, capillary endothelial cells, and basement membrane integrity - as a structural transition associated with early fibrogenesis. Surrounding transitional zones exhibit aberrant epithelial differentiation and proteolytic matrix remodelling, with epithelium shifting toward bronchiolised, airway-like states. Stromal activation converges on spatially restricted fibrogenic cores, sites of maximal collagen maturation and matrix stabilisation that function as signalling hubs within surrounding perifocal and vascular microenvironments. Molecular signatures of atlas-defined tissue states were associated with lung function and mortality across independent patient cohorts. Together, these data support a model in which fibrosis emerges as a spatial tissue-state process, with alveolar-capillary collapse redirecting repair towards mechanically stabilised niches that reinforce pathological remodelling.
items.abstract_zh: 人类肺纤维化会逐步破坏三维组织结构，但结构微环境如何塑造细胞状态仍不清楚。我们将三维 X 射线组织学与空间组学整合，生成了人类肺纤维化的体积多模态图谱，可直接探究组织微结构与空间分子程序之间的关系。我们识别出肺泡-毛细血管单元塌陷——即肺泡 1 型上皮细胞、毛细血管内皮细胞和基底膜完整性的耦合丧失——是与早期纤维化发生相关的结构转变。周围的过渡区表现出异常的上皮分化和蛋白水解性基质重塑，上皮向细支气管化、气道样状态转变。基质活化汇聚于空间受限的促纤维化核心，这些核心是胶原成熟和基质稳定程度最高的部位，在周围的病灶周边和血管微环境中充当信号枢纽。图谱定义的组织状态的分子特征在独立患者队列中与肺功能和死亡率相关。总之，这些数据支持一个模型：纤维化作为一个空间组织状态过程出现，肺泡-毛细血管塌陷将修复重定向至机械稳定的生态位，从而强化病理性重塑。

items.title_en: Deep-learning surrogate model for rapid quantum-noise computation in dual-pump fiber-optic phase-sensitive amplifiers
items.title_zh: 用于双泵浦光纤相位敏感放大器中快速量子噪声计算的深度学习代理模型
items.abstract_en: Fiber-optic parametric amplifiers in a phase-sensitive amplifier (PSA) configuration are well known for their low noise properties. Quantum mechanics dictates that these amplifiers can have a 0 dB noise figure (NF) (ratio of signal-to-noise ratio at the input and output of the amplifier) under certain conditions. However, for a dual-pump configuration, when the system is highly nonlinear, fully quantum calculations of NF become non-trivial. In such cases, semi-quantum models of NF evaluation exists, however, they are often complicated and resource intensive. To simplify that, in this work, first we use a semi-quantum NF calculation framework for the generation of numerically simulated input-output dataset of NF over a large parameter spaces. Then we use the data to train an optimized deep neural network (DNN) for rapid NF prediction. Utilizing the DNN, we demonstrate about 400 times reduction in the computation time compared to the standard semi-quantum NF evaluation approach with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.0015 dB. Using clustering we demonstrate a rapid exploration of the parameter space with respect to high gain (20 dB) and low NF (0.3 dB) targets and retrieve associated design parameters. These results illustrate the efficacy of machine learning-based approaches for rapid search of high-dimensional parameter spaces especially in compute intensive photonic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 相位敏感放大器（PSA）配置下的光纤参量放大器以其低噪声特性而闻名。量子力学规定，这些放大器在某些条件下可以具有 0 dB 噪声系数（NF）（放大器输入与输出信噪比之比）。然而，对于双泵浦配置，当系统高度非线性时，NF 的全量子计算变得并不简单。在此类情况下，存在 NF 评估的半量子模型，但它们通常复杂且资源密集。为简化这一点，在本工作中，我们首先使用半量子 NF 计算框架，在大参数空间上生成 NF 的数值模拟输入-输出数据集。然后，我们使用该数据训练一个优化的深度神经网络（DNN）以快速预测 NF。利用该 DNN，我们证明与标准半量子 NF 评估方法相比，计算时间约减少 400 倍，平均绝对误差（MAE）为 0.0015 dB。通过聚类，我们展示了对高增益（20 dB）和低 NF（0.3 dB）目标的参数空间快速探索，并检索相关设计参数。这些结果说明了基于机器学习的方法在快速搜索高维参数空间方面的有效性，尤其是在计算密集型光子系统中。

items.title_en: Fixed-point acceleration on Neural Wasserstein manifolds
items.title_zh: 神经 Wasserstein 流形上的不动点加速
items.abstract_en: We propose a fixed-point acceleration method for optimization over probability measures, applicable to a variety of machine learning problems. We represent probability measures as pushforwards of a reference distribution through a neural network map and equip the parameter space with the induced pullback Wasserstein metric. This geometric structure allows natural gradient descent to be interpreted as a fixed-point iteration on a Riemannian manifold. We accelerate this iteration using Riemannian Anderson mixing method, which exploits historical residuals to capture approximate second-order information without forming Hessians. In the present parametric setting, the manifold is represented by Euclidean coordinates endowed with a point-dependent metric, simplifying retraction and vector transport. We evaluate the method on multimodal sampling, PDE-based inverse problems, aggregation dynamics, Bayesian logistic regression, and generative modeling. Across the tested tasks, Anderson mixing reduces the number of natural-gradient iterations and achieves competitive performance relative to SGD and Adam in terms of both loss-gradient evaluations and wall-clock time. These results suggest that fixed-point acceleration is an efficient tool for improving the computational efficiency of training on parametric Wasserstein methods.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种用于概率测度优化的不动点加速方法，适用于多种机器学习问题。我们将概率测度表示为参考分布经神经网络映射后的前推，并为参数空间赋予诱导的拉回 Wasserstein 度量。这种几何结构使自然梯度下降可被解释为黎曼流形上的不动点迭代。我们使用黎曼 Anderson 混合方法加速该迭代，该方法利用历史残差来捕捉近似二阶信息，而无需构造 Hessian。在当前参数化设定中，流形由赋予点依赖度量的欧氏坐标表示，从而简化了回缩和向量传输。我们在多模态采样、基于 PDE 的逆问题、聚集动力学、贝叶斯逻辑回归和生成建模上评估该方法。在所测试任务中，Anderson 混合减少了自然梯度迭代次数，并在损失梯度评估次数和实际耗时方面相对于 SGD 和 Adam 取得了有竞争力的性能。这些结果表明，不动点加速是提高参数化 Wasserstein 方法训练计算效率的一种高效工具。

items.title_en: AlienBench: A Benchmark of Structural Novelty in Language Model Outputs
items.title_zh: AlienBench：语言模型输出中结构新颖性的基准
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for creative tasks such as writing, design, and idea generation. For these uses, it matters whether a model's ideas depart from familiar examples or stay close to them. Novelty is one standard measure of creativity, and current creativity evaluations ask human experts or LLM judges to rate how novel an output is. However, these ratings have no fixed reference for what counts as novel (or, in other terms, departure from the familiar). Measuring this departure requires a task with known familiar defaults. The structured imagination task from cognitive psychology is such a task. In this creativity test, people imagine a creature from another planet. The departure from features of Earth animals, such as bilateral symmetry and legs as mode of locomotion, is used as measure of creativity. We introduce AlienBench, a benchmark that adapts the structured imagination task to language models. Models describe alien creatures, and a panel of three LLM judges extracts ten biological features from the description and labels them as either Earth-typical or a departure. The sum of feature departures is the score of a description, from 0 to 10. Each model describes alien creatures under six prompt conditions that vary the framing of the task and the planetary environment. Each model generates 30 descriptions per condition (180 in total), and its overall score is the mean across these descriptions. We evaluate 10 language models, from frontier to open-weight models. Overall scores range from 3.28 (GPT-6 Luna) to 6.55 (Ministral 3 14B). Interestingly, open-weight models score higher than proprietary models in this task (5.40 vs. 4.58). Under the baseline prompt, the models depart from Earth defaults more often on average than 100 human participants on every feature. We release all prompts, generations, judge outputs, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于写作、设计和创意生成等创造性任务。对于这些用途，模型的构想是偏离熟悉示例还是贴近它们很重要。新颖性是创造力的一种标准度量，当前的创造力评估要求人类专家或 LLM 评判器对输出的新颖程度进行评分。然而，这些评分对于什么算作新颖（换言之，偏离熟悉事物）没有固定参照。测量这种偏离需要一个具有已知熟悉默认值的任务。认知心理学中的结构化想象任务就是这样一个任务。在该创造力测试中，人们想象一个来自另一颗行星的生物。与地球动物特征（如双侧对称和以腿作为运动方式）的偏离程度被用作创造力的度量。我们提出 AlienBench，这是一个将结构化想象任务适配到语言模型的基准。模型描述外星生物，由三个 LLM 评判器组成的小组从描述中提取十个生物特征，并将其标记为地球典型或偏离。特征偏离数之和即为描述的得分，范围为 0 到 10。每个模型在六种提示条件下描述外星生物，这些条件改变任务框架和行星环境。每个模型在每种条件下生成 30 个描述（总共 180 个），其总体得分为这些描述的平均值。我们评估了 10 个语言模型，从前沿模型到开放权重模型。总体得分范围为 3.28（GPT-6 Luna）到 6.55（Ministral 3 14B）。有趣的是，开放权重模型在该任务上的得分高于专有模型（5.40 对 4.58）。在基线提示下，模型平均而言在每个特征上都比 100 名人类参与者更频繁地偏离地球默认值。我们发布所有提示、生成结果、评判器输出和得分。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主性的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时目标查询，但固定速率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视点期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种用于低功耗移动机器人的能量感知 OVD 调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上在低、中、高功耗 YOLO-World-S 模式之间切换。我们在 AgileX LIMO 上使用 40 次真实导航试验评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体、每个目标-策略对五次放置以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器记录 8/10 任务成功，而每个固定速率基线为 7/10，同时相对于 8 Hz 高速率基线将平均 Jetson 输入功率（一种 Jetson 侧功耗指标）降低 5.2%，并将实现的 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。一个单独的 60 秒静止微基准隔离感知工作负载：相对于 8 Hz 基线，调度器将平均功率从 8.045 W 降至 7.301 W，能量从 484.7 J 降至 438.1 J。这些结果支持机器人状态感知的 OVD 调度作为一种有前景的功率管理机制，具有有竞争力的任务可靠性，同时表明任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量必须与任务进度和运行时间一起解读。

items.title_en: StitchEdit: Stitching Depth Priors into Image Editors via Per-Layer Gradient Probing
items.title_zh: StitchEdit：通过逐层梯度探测将深度先验缝合进图像编辑器
items.abstract_en: Text-guided image editing with diffusion models struggles with spatial edits (e.g. manipulating objects, changing viewpoints, manipulating occlusions) that depend on the 3D structure understanding of a scene. Marigold and follow-up work demonstrate that a pretrained diffusion backbone already harbors strong geometric priors that can be activated for depth estimation, yet how to redirect these priors toward editing remains unresolved. Through per-layer gradient probing, we discover that the editing and depth objectives are compatible in early transformer layers but actively conflict in late layers, explaining why naive depth-conditioned editing either ignores geometry or degrades visual quality. We present StitchEdit, which first activates the backbone's geometric capability via a lightweight depth-denoising adapter, then selectively fine-tunes this adapter for editing using a probe-guided per-layer learning rate schedule that preserves depth knowledge where it helps and prunes it where it conflicts. On the proposed StitchEditBench, a benchmark of 150 geometry-dependent edits spanning spatial transformation, occlusion manipulation, and viewpoint change, StitchEdit consistently surpasses both instruction-based and depth-conditioned baselines on perceptual quality and geometric fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 基于扩散模型的文本引导图像编辑在处理依赖场景三维结构理解的空间编辑（例如操作物体、改变视角、处理遮挡）时仍面临困难。Marigold 及后续工作表明，预训练的扩散主干网络已经蕴含强大的几何先验，可被激活用于深度估计，但如何将这些先验重定向用于编辑仍未解决。通过逐层梯度探测，我们发现编辑目标与深度目标在 Transformer 早期层中兼容，但在后期层中 actively conflict，这解释了为什么朴素的深度条件编辑要么忽略几何，要么降低视觉质量。我们提出 StitchEdit：它首先通过一个轻量级深度去噪适配器激活主干的几何能力，然后使用由探测引导的逐层学习率调度，选择性地针对编辑任务微调该适配器，从而在深度知识有益处保留它，在冲突处剪除它。在提出的 StitchEditBench（包含 150 个依赖几何的编辑任务，涵盖空间变换、遮挡操作和视角变化）上，StitchEdit 在感知质量和几何保真度上均持续优于基于指令的基线和深度条件基线。

items.title_en: Molecular typing and characterisation of antimicrobial resistance determinants of Neisseria gonorrhoeae among symptomatic individuals in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
items.title_zh: 南非东开普省有症状个体中淋病奈瑟菌的分子分型及抗菌药物耐药决定因素特征
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Background. Antimicrobial resistance in Neisseria gonorrhoeae threatens gonorrhoea treatment, while surveillance is constrained by limited culture capacity. We evaluated multi-antigen sequence typing (NG-MAST) and targeted real-time PCR for molecular epidemiology and detection of antimicrobial resistance-associated determinants directly from clinical specimens. Methods. We analysed 235 N. gonorrhoeae-positive stored DNA extracts from symptomatic individuals in South Africa. NG-MAST sequence types were obtained directly or from whole-genome sequences (WGS) of paired cultured isolates. Real-time PCR targeted quinolone resistance-associated mutations (RAMs) in parC and gyrA and macrolide RAMs in the 23S rRNA gene. Results were compared with WGS and with phenotypic susceptibility results from paired isolates. Results. NG-MAST sequence types were obtained for 200/235 (85.1%) specimens and were diverse, with ST21253 predominating (n=26). At least one gyrA or parC mutation was detected by real-time PCR in 110/193 (57.0%) specimens. Compared with WGS, positive agreement was 81.2% for parC and 97.0% for gyrA, and negative agreement 100% and 95.8%, respectively. Among 65 ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates, RAMs were detected in 60 (92.3%) by real-time PCR and 61 (93.8%) by WGS; four had no RAM detected by either method. The 23S rRNA C2611T mutation was detected by both methods in one isolate (azithromycin MIC, 8 mg/L); no A2059G mutations were detected. Conclusions. Gonococcal sequence types were diverse, quinolone RAMs were common, and the assessed macrolide RAMs were rare. Real-time PCR applied directly to specimen DNA agreed well with WGS, but the targeted markers did not fully predict ciprofloxacin susceptibility, supporting complementary molecular and phenotypic approaches. Key words: Neisseria gonorrhoeae, NG-MAST, Real-time PCR, WGS; quinolone resistance; ciprofloxacin resistance, macrolide resistance
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景。淋病奈瑟菌的抗菌药物耐药性威胁淋病治疗，而监测受限于培养能力。我们评估了多抗原序列分型（NG-MAST）和靶向实时 PCR 在分子流行病学以及直接从临床标本中检测抗菌药物耐药相关决定因素方面的作用。方法。我们分析了来自南非有症状个体的 235 份淋病奈瑟菌阳性保存 DNA 提取物。NG-MAST 序列型直接从 DNA 中获得，或从配对培养分离株的全基因组序列（WGS）中获得。实时 PCR 靶向 parC 和 gyrA 中的喹诺酮耐药相关突变（RAMs）以及 23S rRNA 基因中的大环内酯类 RAMs。结果与 WGS 以及配对分离株的表型药敏结果进行了比较。结果。在 200/235（85.1%）份标本中获得了 NG-MAST 序列型，且具有多样性，以 ST21253 为主（n=26）。实时 PCR 在 110/193（57.0%）份标本中检出至少一个 gyrA 或 parC 突变。与 WGS 相比，parC 的阳性一致率为 81.2%，gyrA 为 97.0%，阴性一致率分别为 100% 和 95.8%。在 65 株环丙沙星耐药分离株中，实时 PCR 检出 RAMs 的有 60 株（92.3%），WGS 检出 61 株（93.8%）；4 株在两种方法中均未检出 RAM。两种方法在一株分离株中均检出 23S rRNA C2611T 突变（阿奇霉素 MIC 为 8 mg/L）；未检出 A2059G 突变。结论。淋球菌序列型具有多样性，喹诺酮 RAMs 常见，所评估的大环内酯类 RAMs 罕见。直接应用于标本 DNA 的实时 PCR 与 WGS 一致性良好，但靶向标志物不能完全预测环丙沙星敏感性，支持分子与表型方法互补。关键词：淋病奈瑟菌，NG-MAST，实时 PCR，WGS；喹诺酮耐药；环丙沙星耐药，大环内酯类耐药

items.title_en: Machine learning classification of dynamical phases in a driven nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice
items.title_zh: 驱动非线性 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 晶格中动力学相位的机器学习分类
items.abstract_en: Driven nonlinear photonic lattices can settle into steady, symmetry-broken, periodic, or chaotic states, and mapping where each occurs in parameter space is key to device design. Brute-force mapping is slow and relies on hand-built criteria, while machine-learning classifiers are usually tested on different systems, so it is unclear which suits a new lattice. We therefore apply four classifiers to the same coherently driven Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain of Kerr resonators: a hand-built heuristic classifier based on Lyapunov exponents and spectral diagnostics, a supervised convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on the heuristic labels, an unsupervised library-building scheme based on augmented dynamic mode decomposition (aDMD), and an unsupervised Gaussian mixture model (GMM) on four dynamical invariants that include an aDMD reconstruction error. Using a converged heuristic diagram as the reference, the CNN reaches 98.0% held-out accuracy, while the two label-free methods reach adjusted Rand indices (ARIs) of 0.916 and 0.947, respectively, without seeing any labels. We show that the aDMD library cleanly resolves the stable and bistable phases and separates symmetric from symmetry-broken periodic oscillations, which the heuristic misses, though it cannot distinguish periodic from chaotic switching. We also find that a poorly converged reference understates the label-free methods' accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 驱动非线性光子晶格可以稳定在稳态、对称破缺、周期或混沌状态，而绘制每种状态在参数空间中出现的区域对器件设计至关重要。暴力映射速度慢且依赖手工构建的判据，而机器学习分类器通常在不同系统上测试，因此尚不清楚哪种方法适合新晶格。因此，我们将四种分类器应用于同一相干驱动的 Kerr 谐振器 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链：基于 Lyapunov 指数和谱诊断的手工启发式分类器、在启发式标签上训练的监督卷积神经网络（CNN）、基于增广动态模式分解（aDMD）的无监督库构建方案，以及在四个动力学不变量（包括 aDMD 重构误差）上的无监督高斯混合模型（GMM）。以收敛的启发式相图作为参考，CNN 达到 98.0% 的留出准确率，而两种无标签方法在未见任何标签的情况下分别达到 0.916 和 0.947 的调整兰德指数（ARI）。我们表明，aDMD 库能清晰分辨稳定相和双稳相，并将对称与对称破缺的周期振荡分开，而启发式方法漏掉了这一点，尽管它无法区分周期切换和混沌切换。我们还发现，收敛不佳的参考会低估无标签方法的准确率。

items.title_en: Not All Entropy Is Equal: Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.title_zh: 并非所有熵都相同：可验证奖励强化学习中的奖励条件化熵分配
items.abstract_en: Policy entropy is widely used to diagnose exploration and collapse in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), yet its magnitude does not consistently track reasoning performance across optimization objectives. We argue that this ambiguity arises because global token entropy conflates uncertainty in successful and failed trajectories, diversity across correct solution strategies, and variation among realizations of the same strategy. We introduce \textbf{Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation (RCEA)}, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that separates complete-trajectory entropy from average token entropy, conditions uncertainty on verifier outcome and process validity, measures correct-solution-mode retention, and connects these population-level quantities to local covariance-driven updates. In controlled sweeps over six RLVR objectives at two model scales, entropy trajectories do not induce a stable ordering of reasoning accuracy. Token entropy is higher for verifier-failed than successful trajectories under both broad separately aggregated estimates and a common-question paired analysis, whose confidence intervals exclude equality at 10 of 12 displayed endpoints. A local covariance approximation predicts the direction of adjacent-checkpoint entropy change in 95.5\% of nonfailed transitions; a reward-stratified endpoint proxy further shows that positive chosen-token covariance is more tail-concentrated within failed prefixes. Every reportable trained endpoint exhibits some contraction in independently audited correct-solution-mode breadth, whose positive association with large-\(k\) coverage remains exploratory. These results show that entropy collapse should be diagnosed by which uncertainty is removed, rather than by global entropy alone.
items.abstract_zh: 策略熵被广泛用于诊断可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的探索与崩溃，然而其大小在不同优化目标下并不能一致地反映推理性能。我们认为，这种模糊性源于全局 token 熵混淆了成功轨迹与失败轨迹中的不确定性、不同正确解题策略之间的多样性，以及同一策略不同实现之间的变异。我们引入奖励条件化熵分配（RCEA），这是一个分层诊断框架，将完整轨迹熵与平均 token 熵分开，将不确定性以验证器结果和过程有效性为条件，度量正确解模式的保留情况，并将这些总体层面量与局部协方差驱动的更新联系起来。在两个模型规模、六个 RLVR 目标的受控扫描中，熵轨迹并未诱导出稳定的推理准确率排序。在广泛分别聚合的估计和共同问题配对分析下，验证器失败轨迹的 token 熵都高于成功轨迹；后者的置信区间在展示的 12 个端点中有 10 个排除了相等。局部协方差近似在 95.5% 的非失败转移中预测了相邻检查点熵变化的方向；按奖励分层的端点代理进一步表明，正的选择 token 协方差在失败前缀内更集中于尾部。每个可报告的已训练端点都表现出独立审计的正确解模式广度的某种收缩，而其与大 k 覆盖率的正关联仍属探索性。这些结果表明，熵崩溃应通过被移除的是哪种不确定性来诊断，而不是仅通过全局熵来诊断。

items.title_en: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
items.title_zh: 模拟视角的几何：在多模态语言模型中分离表征与行为
items.abstract_en: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型可以模拟不同的观察者，但被赋予的视角如何重塑其内部表征以及这些变化是否支配其判断仍不清楚。我们研究了 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 中以人物设定为条件的视觉有趣度的表征几何。在 100 张图像和 53 种提示条件下，我们系统地改变人物设定内容以及引入该设定的语言框架，同时记录行为评分和逐层隐藏状态。我们观察到表征几何随处理深度发生系统性重组：早期层主要编码图像身份，而人物设定特定的结构出现在较晚层。引人注目的是，提示框架对内部表征的重塑强于人物设定身份，而人物设定内容对行为判断的影响更大。这种分离进一步由最小身份陈述体现：即使不改变回答，它们也会改变表征。这些发现表明，表征距离不一定反映行为相关性。更广泛地说，它们揭示了模拟视角如何在人工认知系统的表征空间中作为独特结构出现，强调了内部表征几何与其功能后果之间的根本区别。

items.title_en: TwinBridge: Digital Twin-Driven Policy and Reward Transfer for Real-World Reinforcement Learning in Laboratory Robotics
items.title_zh: TwinBridge：数字孪生驱动的策略与奖励迁移，用于实验室机器人中的真实世界强化学习
items.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning offers an effective approach to precise laboratory manipulation, yet costly real-world demonstrations and limited access to dense process rewards hinder its practical application. We present TwinBridge, a digital twin-driven framework that supplies policy initialization and dense visual rewards for real-world online learning. We construct digital twins by combining 3D Gaussian splatting with physics simulation. Here, simulator states provide task events and geometric progress under physical prerequisites and ordering constraints, yielding rewards for policy pretraining with simulated demonstrations and reinforcement learning. We distill this supervision into a visual reward model. During real-world interaction, its predictions are combined with execution history to compute dense rewards for human-in-the-loop policy refinement. Across five real-world laboratory tasks, TwinBridge achieves a final mean autonomous success rate of 98% with at most 25 minutes of real-world interaction per task. Experiments show that dense rewards improve interaction efficiency over sparse rewards, and simulation-based policy initialization further accelerates learning.
items.abstract_zh: 在线强化学习为精确的实验室操作提供了一种有效方法，然而昂贵的真实世界演示以及难以获得密集过程奖励阻碍了其实际应用。我们提出 TwinBridge，一个数字孪生驱动的框架，为真实世界在线学习提供策略初始化和密集视觉奖励。我们通过将 3D 高斯泼溅与物理仿真相结合来构建数字孪生。在这里，仿真器状态在物理前提和顺序约束下提供任务事件和几何进度，从而产生用于使用模拟演示和强化学习进行策略预训练的奖励。我们将这种监督蒸馏到视觉奖励模型中。在真实世界交互期间，其预测与执行历史相结合，以计算用于人在回路策略细化的密集奖励。在五个真实世界实验室任务中，TwinBridge 实现了最终平均自主成功率 98%，每个任务最多使用 25 分钟的真实世界交互。实验表明，密集奖励相比稀疏奖励提高了交互效率，而基于仿真的策略初始化进一步加速了学习。
