items.title_en: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
items.title_zh: Concertina：在一个扩散视觉-语言模型中同时体现操作与认知
items.abstract_en: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D. Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina
items.abstract_zh: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过将外部动作机制附加到视觉-语言模型（VLM）上来将操作与认知解耦——要么将动作量化为离散 token，其误差与物理位移没有稳定的对应关系；要么将连续轨迹生成委托给单独的动作专家，其梯度与 VLM 主干竞争或被阻止更新主干。我们认为，操作与认知应当体现在同一个模型中，即从解耦的 VLA 转向具身视觉-语言模型（eVLM）。我们提出 Concertina，一种 eVLM，它将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接置于共享扩散 VLM 主干的 computation and parameter path 上。每个控制时间步被编码为主干隐藏空间中的一个连续潜在动作 token，共享 Transformer 通过与多模态预训练相同的 corrupt-and-reconstruct 算子重建按时间排序的动作块。在 4.46B 模型中，活跃动作投影仅占参数的 0.21%，且没有任何单独的动作生成器层；相比之下，代表性连续 VLA 中专用动作专家的容量为 16.5%–35.1%。使用我们提出的 Action Interface Audit，我们确认跨时间轨迹耦合出现在共享主干的中层和深层，而不是出现在动作接口处。在标准基准上，Concertina 在常规 LIBERO 上取得 98.15% 的平均成功率，在包含 10,030 个任务的 LIBERO-Plus 基准上取得 85.9%，在 CALVIN ABC-D 上平均完成链长为 4.142。代码：https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face：https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

items.title_en: Single-cell profiling of human plaques reveals cellular and molecular signatures of symptomatic atherosclerosis
items.title_zh: 人类斑块的单细胞分析揭示症状性动脉粥样硬化的细胞和分子特征
items.abstract_en: Atherosclerotic plaque vulnerability drives ischemic cardiovascular events, yet the cellular and molecular signatures distinguishing symptomatic from asymptomatic human plaques remain poorly defined. Here, we compared 53 symptomatic and asymptomatic human carotid plaques using single-nucleus (snRNA-seq; 17 samples, 19,100 nuclei; AtherOMICS biobank) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq; 36 samples, 68,983 cells; four public datasets), analyzed independently and combined by meta-analysis. Across sequencing approaches, symptomatic plaques showed cell-state shifts toward later or terminal states in osteochondrogenic smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and CD4 T cells, as well as transcriptional changes toward inflammatory and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in endothelial cells (ECs), T cells, and fibroblasts. Nuclear profiling uncovered a depletion of fibroblasts in symptomatic plaques, marked by downregulation of RGS5. Integrating these transcriptomic signatures with genome-wide association data for coronary, cerebrovascular, and peripheral atherosclerotic disease, we found that genetic risk was enriched primarily in vascular wall cells (SMCs, fibroblasts, ECs), rather than immune cell types. The analyses further nominated higher TWIST1 expression in ECs (colocalized with risk across four atherosclerotic phenotypes), lower GUCY1A1 expression in fibroblasts and macrophages, and higher MRAS expression in T cells as candidate driver mechanisms linking genetic risk to symptomatic plaque transition. These findings provide novel insights into cellular and molecular phenotypes associated with plaque vulnerability and identify potential driver mechanisms of symptomatic plaque transformation that could inform therapeutic development.
items.abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化斑块易损性驱动缺血性心血管事件，但区分症状性与无症状性人类斑块的细胞和分子特征仍定义不清。在此，我们比较了 53 个症状性和无症状性人类颈动脉斑块，使用单核 RNA 测序（snRNA-seq；17 个样本，19,100 个细胞核；AtherOMICS 生物样本库）和单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq；36 个样本，68,983 个细胞；四个公共数据集），分别独立分析并通过荟萃分析合并。跨测序方法，症状性斑块显示骨软骨生成性平滑肌细胞（SMCs）和 CD4 T 细胞向较晚或终末状态的细胞状态转变，以及内皮细胞（ECs）、T 细胞和成纤维细胞中向炎症和上皮-间质转化（EMT）的转录变化。细胞核分析发现症状性斑块中成纤维细胞耗竭，以 RGS5 下调为标志。将这些转录组特征与冠状动脉、脑血管和外周动脉粥样硬化疾病的全基因组关联数据整合，我们发现遗传风险主要富集于血管壁细胞（SMCs、成纤维细胞、ECs），而非免疫细胞类型。分析进一步提名 ECs 中较高的 TWIST1 表达（与四种动脉粥样硬化表型的风险共定位）、成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞中较低的 GUCY1A1 表达，以及 T 细胞中较高的 MRAS 表达，作为将遗传风险与症状性斑块转变联系起来的候选驱动机制。这些发现为与斑块易损性相关的细胞和分子表型提供了新见解，并识别了症状性斑块转化的潜在驱动机制，可为治疗开发提供信息。

items.title_en: An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 一种智能体驱动、交叉验证的介质超表面逆向设计流程
items.abstract_en: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5\% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under $\pm$10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 介质超表面的逆向设计功能强大但 labour-intensive：每个新目标都需要选择参数化和品质因数、管理计算资源，并批判性评估可能数值未收敛、对制造误差敏感或陷入局部最优的结果。我们提出一个开源流程，其中人工智能（AI）编码智能体将自然语言规格说明转化为超表面优化运行，执行这些运行，用固定检查清单分析每次运行并提议下一次迭代。设计通过可微的三维严格耦合波分析（RCWA）优化，包括对制造容差的鲁棒性，并且每个报告的设计都用有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真独立验证。我们在 1550 nm 下展示了该工作流：一个自由形状硅超光栅、一个组装成光束偏转超胞的偏振无关超原子库，以及由同一库构建的超透镜。在超光栅案例中，独立的 FDTD 验证揭示了优化模型将效率高估 5%，而传统收敛测试未能检测到这一点；鲁棒设计在 ±10 nm 制造误差下保留了大部分效率。而在其他案例中，所获得的 RCWA 结果得到了全波仿真的确认。

items.title_en: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
items.title_zh: DexDICE：通过双专家离线模仿学习协调安全性与性能
items.abstract_en: Ensuring high returns while providing strong safety guarantees in offline imitation learning (IL) is a fundamental challenge: existing approaches either rely on explicitly specified cost functions, which are difficult to design for complex real-world safety constraints, or require expert demonstrations that are both safe and high-performing, which are often too costly to collect. We introduce dual-expert imitation learning, which leverages two complementary data sources: (i) safety-compliant demonstrations that faithfully follow safety guidelines but may be suboptimal, and (ii) performance-oriented demonstrations that achieve high returns but may violate safety guidelines. To address this problem, we propose DexDICE (Dual-expert offline imitation learning via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation). Instead of conventional distribution constraints, DexDICE combines DICE-style offline learning with safe support constraints, enabling agents to exploit high-return behaviors while remaining within safety-compliant regions. We prove that the ideal solution satisfying this constraint exactly has zero unsafe-region visitation with high probability. We evaluate DexDICE on a re-curated DSRL benchmark and validate it on a real-world mobile-robot navigation task trained directly from human teleoperation demonstrations, where it substantially outperforms baselines and remains robust to data scarcity and quality degradation.
items.abstract_zh: 在离线模仿学习（IL）中，在提供强安全保证的同时确保高回报是一项根本性挑战：现有方法要么依赖显式指定的成本函数，而这类函数难以为复杂的现实世界安全约束设计；要么要求既安全又高性能的专家演示，而这类演示往往收集成本过高。我们引入双专家模仿学习，它利用两个互补的数据来源：（i）忠实遵循安全指南但可能次优的安全合规演示，以及（ii）获得高回报但可能违反安全指南的性能导向演示。为解决该问题，我们提出 DexDICE（通过平稳分布校正估计的双专家离线模仿学习）。DexDICE 不采用传统分布约束，而是将 DICE 风格离线学习与安全支撑约束相结合，使智能体能够利用高回报行为，同时仍处于安全合规区域内。我们证明，满足该约束的理想解以高概率具有零不安全区域访问。我们在重新整理的 DSRL 基准上评估 DexDICE，并在直接由人类遥操作演示训练的真实移动机器人导航任务上验证；在该任务上，它大幅优于基线，并对数据稀缺和质量退化保持稳健。

items.title_en: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
items.title_zh: 自动关键词提取与标注：面向文本和语音的现代理论方法与实践解决方案
items.abstract_en: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
items.abstract_zh: 文本和视听信息的指数增长使自动关键词提取（KE）任务日益重要。本文全面分析了跨文本和语音模态的 KE 的当代理论方法和实践解决方案。这项工作的主要贡献在于将这些通常分散的研究脉络系统性地综合为一个统一分析框架，突出该领域从统计方法向大语言模型（LLMs）和端到端语音处理的演变。我们考察 KE 的阶段、书面和口语中关键词的特征以及术语细微差别。详细讨论和分析了各种自动 KE 方法：统计、混合、基于机器学习和结构化方法。综述相当关注新兴范式，包括使用 LLMs 的关键词生成，并详细概述自动语料标注的方法和挑战。此外，我们专门分析口语 KE 的当前方向和固有困难，比较基于转录和端到端声学方法。这一综合使我们得出结论：该领域正朝着更集成、上下文感知的范式发展。未来进展将取决于应对关键挑战，如低资源语言的数据稀缺、有效的多模态融合以及对生成式 KE 系统的细致评估。

items.title_en: When to Trust the BIM: Identifiability-Aware LiDAR-Inertial--BIM Fusion under As-Built Deviations
items.title_zh: 何时信任 BIM：竣工偏差下可辨识性感知的 LiDAR-惯性-BIM 融合
items.abstract_en: Building information models (BIM) can provide a global geometric reference for robot localization with LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO). However, as-built deviations from the as-designed model mean that a disagreement between a scan and the BIM may arise from a pose error, an offset wall surface (an as-built deviation or an unmodeled object in front of the wall), or a shifted room, and in some geometries these explanations produce identical observations. In this paper, we formalize this attribution problem as fault identification over three fault classes and derive a geometric criterion for when attribution is possible. Building on it, we propose an identifiability-aware method that reports an attribution only when the fault is attributable; otherwise, it retains the candidates, defers BIM updates and BIM-based pose corrections in the ambiguous directions, and recovers once new references arrive. In the pre-registered two-dimensional study, on cases whose fault is detectable but not attributable, the method's conditional error rate was 0.83%, against 31.67% for a baseline with uncertainty-based abstention at the same answer rate. On the 5,600 attributable cases, the method reported a unique attribution 5,574 times, with no incorrect attributions. In paired fault injections in a laboratory room with its IFC model and on three floors of the SLABIM dataset, it raised no off-target attribution (0 of 168 conditions in the laboratory; 0 of 1,302 on SLABIM) and attributed all eight laboratory faults predicted to be attributable, whereas both reproduced baselines raised off-target structural flags in every setting.
items.abstract_zh: 建筑信息模型（BIM）可为结合 LiDAR-惯性里程计（LIO）的机器人定位提供全局几何参考。然而，竣工状态相对于设计模型的偏差意味着，扫描与 BIM 之间的不一致可能源于位姿误差、偏移的墙面（竣工偏差或墙前未建模物体）或房间偏移，而在某些几何结构中，这些解释会产生相同观测。本文将这一归因问题形式化为三类故障上的故障识别，并推导出何时可以进行归因的几何准则。在此基础上，我们提出一种可辨识性感知方法，仅当故障可归因时才报告归因；否则保留候选，在模糊方向上推迟 BIM 更新和基于 BIM 的位姿校正，并在新参考到达后恢复。在预注册的二维研究中，对于故障可检测但不可归因的情况，该方法的条件错误率为 0.83%，而在相同回答率下，采用基于不确定性弃权的基线为 31.67%。在 5,600 个可归因案例上，该方法报告了 5,574 次唯一归因，且没有错误归因。在配有 IFC 模型的实验室房间以及 SLABIM 数据集的三层楼上进行配对故障注入时，它没有产生非目标归因（实验室 168 个条件中 0 个；SLABIM 上 1,302 个条件中 0 个），并对所有八个预测为可归因的实验室故障进行了归因，而两个复现基线在每种设置中都产生了非目标结构标志。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置的体积密度和与视图相关的发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机姿态的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Deep Learning-based Framework for Rapid, Precise and Fully Automated Localization of Cochlea Landmarks in 3D CT Images
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的快速、精确且全自动定位3D CT图像中耳蜗标志点的框架
items.abstract_en: Manual localization of anatomical landmarks within human cochlea structures in 3D computed tomography (CT) images is labor-intensive. However, despite progress in various studies on automatic localization methods, it remains challenging to jointly achieve rapid, precise, and fully automated landmark localization. Therefore, we propose a deep learning-based localization framework, called MEDICO-YOLO, which bridges speed and precision. It can automatically and simultaneously localize 6 human cochlea landmarks (apex, basal point, round window center of both left and right cochleae) in the full-resolution 3D CT images. The main contributions are: 1) MEDICO-YOLO learns from few manually annotated 3D CT images; 2) Within the framework, a 2D CNN-based network was developed to specifically localize cochlea landmarks in 3D single-scale medical CT images; 3) A novel loss function was designed; 4) The localization model achieved human expert-level precision while ensuring rapid inference. This study employed anonymized 3D pre-operative CT images (0.3 mm, covering the full head or temporal bone region). The evaluation involved comparing four models that were trained using 4 different training set sizes (n=4, 8, 12, 16). Each of them was evaluated on a distinct test set (n=16). The results show that the MEDICO-YOLO framework achieved strong localization performance by learning from few annotated 3D CT images. Trained on only 8 CT volumes, the model already attained a mean localization error of 1.30 mm (approximately 4 voxels). When trained on 16 CT volumes, the model achieved a mean error of 0.71 mm and a successful detection rate (SDR@3.0 mm) of 97.92%. Furthermore, on an Apple M1 laptop, the model achieved a real-time speed (32 ms) for inferencing each 2D slice (608 x 608) and an average latency of 25.43 s for inferencing the full 3D CT image (608 x 608 x 200, including post-processing). The complete methodology for the MEDICO-YOLO framework is presented in this article.
items.abstract_zh: 在三维计算机断层扫描（CT）图像中手动定位人耳蜗结构内的解剖标志点是一项劳动密集型工作。然而，尽管关于自动定位方法的多项研究取得了进展，同时实现快速、精确且全自动的标志点定位仍然具有挑战性。因此，我们提出一种基于深度学习的定位框架，称为 MEDICO-YOLO，它兼顾速度与精度。该框架可在全分辨率三维 CT 图像中自动且同时定位 6 个人耳蜗标志点（左右耳蜗的顶点、基底点和圆窗中心）。主要贡献包括：1）MEDICO-YOLO 从少量手动标注的三维 CT 图像中学习；2）在该框架内，开发了一个基于二维 CNN 的网络，专门用于在三维单尺度医学 CT 图像中定位耳蜗标志点；3）设计了一种新颖的损失函数；4）该定位模型在保证快速推理的同时达到了人类专家级精度。本研究采用匿名三维术前 CT 图像（0.3 mm，覆盖全头或颞骨区域）。评估比较了使用 4 种不同训练集规模（n=4、8、12、16）训练的四个模型。每个模型均在独立的测试集（n=16）上评估。结果表明，MEDICO-YOLO 框架通过从少量标注三维 CT 图像中学习，获得了较强的定位性能。仅使用 8 个 CT 体积训练时，模型已达到 1.30 mm（约 4 个体素）的平均定位误差。使用 16 个 CT 体积训练时，模型达到 0.71 mm 的平均误差和 97.92% 的成功检测率（SDR@3.0 mm）。此外，在 Apple M1 笔记本电脑上，模型对每个二维切片（608 x 608）的推理达到实时速度（32 ms），对完整三维 CT 图像（608 x 608 x 200，包括后处理）的平均延迟为 25.43 s。本文给出了 MEDICO-YOLO 框架的完整方法。

items.title_en: Analytical Modeling of the Admittance Tensor of Periodic Elliptical Meta-Atoms
items.title_zh: 周期椭圆超原子导纳张量的解析建模
items.abstract_en: A metasurface is an electrically thin interface that controls the phase, amplitude and polarization of a wave, upon reflection or transmission. Printed on a grounded dielectric substrate and spatially modulated across the aperture, it converts a guided surface wave into a radiated leaky wave, a mechanism used in holographic metasurface antennas. Controlling this conversion requires synthesizing a prescribed distribution of admittance tensors, each derived from the homogenization of a subwavelength unit cell. Many numerical and semi-analytical methods have been proposed to relate the geometry of a meta-atom to the tensor it produces. This paper presents, to the author's knowledge, the first analytical model, restricted to elliptical meta-atoms on a uniform lattice. The Galerkin method is applied directly to the geometry of the patches, without spatial meshing. An affine transformation maps any rotated ellipse onto the unit disk, so that a single formulation covers every configuration. A wideband response takes from minutes to tens of minutes with a periodic full-wave solver, while the proposed model evaluates it in a few tens of milliseconds on the same workstation, roughly three orders of magnitude faster. The predicted admittance agrees with a method-of-moments reference up to the fundamental resonance and captures the guided-mode anomaly of the substrate. Beyond the physical insight it brings, the model is a differentiable function of the geometry, which makes the quasi-real-time design of optimized metasurfaces possible.
items.abstract_zh: 超表面是一种电薄界面，可在反射或透射时控制波的相位、幅度和极化。它印刷在接地的介质基板上并在孔径上空间调制，将导波表面波转换为辐射漏波，这一机制用于全息超表面天线。控制这种转换需要合成规定的导纳张量分布，每个张量由亚波长晶胞的均匀化得到。已有许多数值和半解析方法被提出来关联超原子的几何结构与其产生的张量。本文提出据作者所知的首个解析模型，限于均匀格点上的椭圆超原子。Galerkin 方法直接应用于贴片几何结构，无需空间网格划分。仿射变换将任意旋转椭圆映射到单位圆盘，因此单一公式可覆盖每种配置。使用周期全波求解器计算宽带响应需要数分钟到数十分钟，而所提模型在同一工作站上可在数十毫秒内完成评估，约快三个数量级。预测的导纳与矩量法参考结果在基频谐振前一致，并捕捉到基底的导模异常。除带来的物理洞见外，该模型是几何结构的可微函数，这使得优化超表面的准实时设计成为可能。

items.title_en: Topology as a Design Variable: Joint Architecture-Sizing Optimization for SRAM
items.title_zh: 拓扑作为设计变量：SRAM 的联合架构-尺寸优化
items.abstract_en: SRAM's power-performance-area-stability trade-off depends on bitcell topology, a discrete architectural choice that interacts non-separably with continuous transistor sizing. However, no open-source SRAM tool treats topology as an optimizable variable. OpenRAM generates SRAM layouts but performs no optimization, while OpenYield supports high-fidelity evaluation but restricts optimization to scalar sizing of a fixed 6T cell. OpenYieldV2 closes this gap through three integrated contributions. First, a fully parameterized compiler generates complete 6T and 10T SRAM macros with peripheral circuits and replica-bitline self-timing, enabling topology comparison under identical simulation conditions. Second, a few-shot TabPFN surrogate learns topology-dependent PPA responses with limited full-macro SPICE samples. Third, a coarse-to-refined multi-objective optimizer combines global exploration of discrete architectural choices with local refinement of continuous transistor sizes. Experiments across varying design conditions reveal a topology decision boundary that shifts with operating constraints rather than following a fixed design rule. Jointly optimizing across this boundary improves hypervolume by up to 17.3\% over the strongest single-topology baseline. OpenYieldV2 is open-source to support reproducible SRAM design research.
items.abstract_zh: SRAM 的功耗-性能-面积-稳定性权衡取决于位单元拓扑，这是一种离散架构选择，并与连续晶体管尺寸不可分离地相互作用。然而，尚无开源 SRAM 工具将拓扑视为可优化变量。OpenRAM 生成 SRAM 版图但不执行优化，而 OpenYield 支持高保真评估，但将优化限制为固定 6T 单元的标量尺寸调整。OpenYieldV2 通过三项集成贡献填补这一空白。第一，全参数化编译器生成完整的 6T 和 10T SRAM 宏，包含外围电路和复制位线自定时，从而能够在相同仿真条件下比较拓扑。第二，少样本 TabPFN 代理利用有限的全宏 SPICE 样本学习依赖拓扑的 PPA 响应。第三，由粗到精的多目标优化器将离散架构选择的全局探索与连续晶体管尺寸的局部细化相结合。在不同设计条件下的实验揭示了一条拓扑决策边界，它随工作约束移动，而不是遵循固定设计规则。跨该边界联合优化相比最强的单一拓扑基线将超体积最多提高 17.3%。OpenYieldV2 已开源，以支持可复现的 SRAM 设计研究。

items.title_en: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining
items.title_zh: 先循环再跳跃：循环深度在数据有限预训练中能带来什么、不能带来什么
items.abstract_en: Multimodal models have often scored below text-only baselines in the BabyLM Challenge (Klerings et al., 2024; Takmaz et al., 2025). We test whether additional recurrent computation helps close this gap. Recurrence increases computation by reusing layers without adding parameters or training data. Using a single implementation, we compare standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget, with three seeds per main condition. Each image is represented by one feature vector from a frozen DINOv2 encoder, used as a prefix token. Caption words count toward the budget, so multimodal training also changes the language data. In a pre-registered text-only comparison, a 12-layer stack repeated four times exceeds a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP percentage points at matched inference compute. However, multimodal training lowers BLiMP accuracy by about 3.8 points in both architectures, with no clear mitigation from recurrence. An exploratory loop-side no-image control, trained with the multimodal language data and batching schedule, scores 5.7 points below the text-only baseline. Adding the visual prefix raises accuracy by 1.85 points on average, but this contrast is uncertain with three seeds. These results suggest that changes in language data and its presentation are a major source of the drop. Diagnostic tests show that the models use visual information; its contribution to grammatical generalization remains uncertain under this single-vector interface.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态模型在BabyLM挑战中通常得分低于纯文本基线（Klerings等，2024；Takmaz等，2025）。我们测试额外的循环计算是否有助于缩小这一差距。循环通过重用层来增加计算，而不增加参数或训练数据。使用单一实现，我们在1亿词预算下比较标准Transformer和循环Transformer，每个主要条件使用三个随机种子。每张图像由来自冻结DINOv2编码器的一个特征向量表示，用作前缀标记。标题词计入预算，因此多模态训练也改变了语言数据。在预注册的纯文本比较中，在匹配推理计算量下，重复四次的12层堆叠比标准48层Transformer高出5.4个BLiMP百分点。然而，多模态训练在两种架构中均使BLiMP准确率降低约3.8个百分点，循环没有明显缓解。一个探索性的循环侧无图像对照，使用多模态语言数据和批处理调度训练，得分比纯文本基线低5.7个百分点。添加视觉前缀平均提高准确率1.85个百分点，但在三个随机种子下这一对比不确定。这些结果表明，语言数据及其呈现方式的变化是性能下降的主要来源。诊断测试表明模型使用了视觉信息；在这种单向量接口下，其对语法泛化的贡献仍不确定。

items.title_en: Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization
items.title_zh: 协作定位中用于规范漂移校正的无线电到位姿信息
items.abstract_en: Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team's estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across $1000$ simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from $0.542$m to $0.140$m in a $50\times50$m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.
items.abstract_zh: 协作定位利用里程计和机器人间测量来估计机器人团队的运动。这些测量仅描述相对几何，但团队估计的位置和姿态可能随时间一起漂移，即规范漂移。在本工作中，我们研究利用配准到与机器人位姿相同世界坐标系中的无线电衰减图来校正这种规范漂移。具体而言，我们提出无线电到位姿信息（RPI）接口，将功率残差及其位姿导数转换为高斯信息矩阵与向量对。RPI 基于如下洞见：接收功率对世界地图中的共享位移敏感。位姿估计器将该接口与里程计和机器人间测量结合使用，以更新位姿并最小化不确定性。我们刻画了可从地图和观测链路中检测到的共享运动。对于不确定的共享地图，RPI 保持跨机器人和跨时间的相关性，并复现联合高斯位姿估计和协方差。在 1000 次模拟高斯试验中，RPI 与联合估计的结果相匹配。在带有配准地图的 32 组配对试验中，与仅使用无线电对相对测量加权的基线相比，RPI 在 50×50 m 场地中将共同位置 RMSE 从 0.542 m 降至 0.140 m。

items.title_en: PoseRieFlow: Riemannian Flow Matching for Whole-Body Text-to-Pose Generation
items.title_zh: PoseRieFlow：用于全身文本到姿态生成的黎曼流匹配
items.abstract_en: We present PoseRieFlow, a compact flow-matching framework for text-conditioned generation of whole-body 3D human poses. Prior text-to-pose methods either neglect articulated hands or model rotations in Euclidean space despite their non-Euclidean geometry. PoseRieFlow instead formulates generation directly on the product manifold of SMPL-H joint rotations, learning a text-conditioned vector field that transports samples from an isotropic $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ Gaussian prior to the data distribution along Riemannian geodesics. A part-tokenized Diffusion Transformer aggregates the 52 joints into eight body-part tokens, allocating a dedicated token and nonlinear projector to each hand, and restores per-joint resolution through part-specific decoders, shortening the sequence while improving kinematic fidelity over per-joint tokenization. With only 21.6M trainable parameters, PoseRieFlow supports expressive SMPL-H generation with detailed hand articulation at a fraction of the scale of recent LLM-based generators. On PoseScript, it attains the lowest whole-body kinematic error among all hand-producing methods, with consistent kinematic gains from the Riemannian formulation over its Euclidean counterpart at every practical inference budget, while distributional and retrieval metrics remain comparable between them.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 PoseRieFlow，一个用于文本条件生成全身三维人体姿态的紧凑流匹配框架。此前的文本到姿态方法要么忽略关节手部，要么尽管旋转具有非欧几里得几何性质仍在欧几里得空间中建模。PoseRieFlow 则直接在 SMPL-H 关节旋转的乘积流形上形式化生成过程，学习一个文本条件向量场，使样本沿黎曼测地线从各向同性 SO(3) 高斯先验传输到数据分布。部件标记化的 Diffusion Transformer 将 52 个关节聚合为八个身体部件 token，为每只手分配专用 token 和非线性投影器，并通过部件特定解码器恢复逐关节分辨率，从而在缩短序列的同时相较逐关节标记化提升运动学保真度。PoseRieFlow 仅有 21.6M 可训练参数，却能以远小于近期基于 LLM 的生成器的规模支持具有细节手部关节运动的富有表现力的 SMPL-H 生成。在 PoseScript 上，它在所有生成手部的方法中取得最低的全身运动学误差，并且在每个实际推理预算下，黎曼形式化相较其欧几里得对应方法都带来一致的运动学增益，而二者在分布指标和检索指标上仍保持可比。

items.title_en: Accounting for Insulin-on-board in Large Language Model Advice about Pediatric Hyperglycemia
items.title_zh: 在关于儿童高血糖的大型语言模型建议中考虑体内胰岛素（insulin-on-board）
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can be used by patients and caregivers to answer medical questions and the characterization of safety concerns in LLM outputs for patient-facing applications is an active area of research. In this work, we study LLM responses to caregiver questions about hyperglycemia in pediatric type 1 diabetes. We measure the frequency of a potential safety failure: advice to dose insulin in the absence of a clear warning to account for insulin-on-board. We found occurrences of the potential safety failure across four LLMs tested through programmatic endpoints and two LLMs tested through chat interfaces. The rates of the potential safety failure varied when different context was given about the patient's meal and insulin history and treatment regimen. These results highlight a need for guardrails for patients with diabetes who use LLMs to manage their care.
items.abstract_zh: 患者和照护者可以使用大型语言模型（LLM）回答医学问题，而面向患者应用的 LLM 输出中安全问题的表征是一个活跃的研究领域。在这项工作中，我们研究 LLM 对儿童 1 型糖尿病高血糖相关照护者问题的回答。我们测量了一种潜在安全失效的频率：在没有明确警告要考虑体内胰岛素（insulin-on-board）的情况下建议给予胰岛素剂量。我们在通过程序化端点测试的四个 LLM 和通过聊天界面测试的两个 LLM 中发现了这种潜在安全失效的发生。当提供关于患者进餐和胰岛素历史及治疗方案的不同背景信息时，潜在安全失效的发生率有所不同。这些结果凸显了为使用 LLM 管理自身照护的糖尿病患者设置防护措施的必要性。

items.title_en: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
items.title_zh: 一种无源智能超表面：网络模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length $\ell_m$ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter $λ_m$ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
items.abstract_zh: 智能超表面能够实现先进的波操控，包括负折射、聚焦、分束和波束偏转，具有重要的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法往往依赖带有增益的有源超材料，或需要计算密集地求解逆问题以找到最优配置。在本工作中，我们使用量子图论的散射框架，推导出可产生指定反射波场的无源超表面配置的精确解析表达式。该超表面端接周期波导晶格，由一组通道组成，每个通道是一根长度为 $\ell_m$ 的管，末端为一个顶点，其散射参数 $\lambda_m$ 决定有多少波损失到壁中。对于任意给定的入射场和反射场，精确的长度和散射参数可逐通道地由返回晶格和离开晶格的波振幅之比以闭式形式得到，且当该比值的模不超过 1 时，超表面是无源的。我们演示了一维和二维超表面的构造。一维超表面端接二维晶格，可对高斯光束进行偏转、分束或完美吸收。二维超表面端接三维晶格，并在晶格内部的平面上生成指定图像。在每种情况下，我们都获得了产生该效果的精确边界性质。

items.title_en: KnowEvo: Knowledge Evolution for Protein Optimization
items.title_zh: KnowEvo：用于蛋白质优化的知识演化
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in scientific discovery, yet systematically accumulating and refining reusable scientific knowledge remains challenging. Existing approaches primarily improve LLM-based problem solving through parameter optimization or feedback-driven refinement of prompts, programs, and solution trajectories, leaving acquired expertise either embedded in model weights or scattered across iterative problem-solving processes. As a result,knowledge is difficult to systematically inspect, evaluate, and refine. We propose KnowEvo, a framework that treats externalized knowledge itself as the optimization target. Our key insight is that scientific knowledge is inherently modular: multiple interacting mechanisms jointly determine the design outcomes. This makes knowledge evolution fundamentally challenging, as improvements cannot be attributed to individual components in isolation. To address this, KnowEvo represents knowledge as executable expertise blocks and organizes their refinements into strategy mutation trees, enabling structured exploration over a combinatorial knowledge space. The framework combines a Thompson-style forward allocation strategy that adaptively distributes evaluation budgets across strategy variants with a backward revision process, in which a code agent operates in an isolated sandbox to translate rollout evidence into localized program updates. This design enables persistent accumulation, evaluation, and refinement of mechanistic expertise across iterative experimentation. We evaluate KnowEvo on protein optimization tasks including stability and solubility. Results show that knowledge evolution consistently improves over initial strategy blocks and outperforms monolithic program evolution and prior LLM-guided evolution baselines across metrics such as pass@k, MRR, MAP,and NDCG@5. Code is available at https://github.com/recynie/KnowEvo.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在科学发现中展现出前景，但系统性地积累和精炼可复用的科学知识仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要通过参数优化或对提示、程序和求解轨迹的反馈驱动式改进来提升基于 LLM 的问题求解，使获得的知识要么嵌入模型权重，要么分散在迭代式问题求解过程中。因此，知识难以被系统性地检查、评估和精炼。我们提出 KnowEvo，一个将外化知识本身视为优化目标的框架。我们的关键见解是科学知识本质上是模块化的：多个相互作用的机制共同决定设计结果。这使知识演化从根本上具有挑战性，因为改进无法孤立地归因于单个组件。为解决这一问题，KnowEvo 将知识表示为可执行的专业知识块，并将其精炼组织为策略变异树，从而支持在组合式知识空间中进行结构化探索。该框架结合 Thompson 式前向分配策略与后向修订过程：前者自适应地在策略变体之间分配评估预算，后者中代码智能体在隔离沙箱中运行，将 rollout 证据转化为局部程序更新。该设计支持在迭代实验中持续积累、评估和精炼机制性专业知识。我们在包括稳定性和溶解度在内的蛋白质优化任务上评估 KnowEvo。结果表明，知识演化相较初始策略块持续提升，并在 pass@k、MRR、MAP 和 NDCG@5 等指标上优于单体程序演化和先前的 LLM 引导演化基线。代码见 https://github.com/recynie/KnowEvo。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
items.title_zh: NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval任务概述：科学论文中的跨模态主张验证
items.abstract_en: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. On the first subtask, the best systems reached 98.1\% pair accuracy, but all six top-ranked systems relied on the contrastive pairs; the best system that judged each claim-evidence pair on its own scored 24.3 points lower. Open-weight models, embedded in carefully designed pipelines, matched proprietary ones. Yet verifying a single claim against its evidence, the setting that matters in practice, remains an open problem.
items.abstract_zh: 本文概述了SciClaimEval，这是NTCIR-19的一项试点任务，旨在依据科学主张所在论文中的表格和图形来验证这些主张。我们的数据集将来自机器学习、自然语言处理和医学领域180篇论文的真实主张与其表格和图形的对比版本配对，其中一个版本支持该主张，另一个经过最小修改以使其不支持该主张。该任务包括两个子任务：判断某条证据是否支持一项主张，以及从两个证据版本中选择哪一个支持该主张。共有22支团队注册，为NTCIR-19各项任务中最多，其中14支团队提交了177次运行结果。大多数系统基于多模态大语言模型构建，依赖提示和多阶段推理，而非任务特定的微调。在第一个子任务上，最佳系统达到98.1%的配对准确率，但排名前六的系统均依赖对比配对；独立判断每个主张-证据对的最佳系统得分低24.3分。嵌入精心设计流水线中的开放权重模型与专有模型相当。然而，依据证据验证单一主张这一在实践中重要的设定仍是一个开放问题。

items.title_en: Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: 安全证书函数的统一概述：来自Hamilton-Jacobi可达性与控制屏障函数的技术
items.abstract_en: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.
items.abstract_zh: 安全是现代自主系统的核心关切。安全证书——其存在保证系统满足其安全规范的函数——长期以来一直被用作严格推理安全的原则性工具。合成此类证书的方法分散于各个研究领域，关于何时使用特定方法的指导很少。本教程以两个广泛使用的方法族为中心，对安全证书合成进行全面处理：Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析和控制屏障函数（CBF）。对于每个方法族，我们首先介绍其一般形式，以及用于证书合成的经典工具和基于学习的工具。接下来，我们介绍两个由不同复杂度车辆系统组成的基准问题，以评估不同合成方法的证书质量及其在安全关键控制中的有效性。我们使用这些基准比较各种方法，并为选择方法提供实用指导。

items.title_en: Video Stitching from Multiple Moving Cameras
items.title_zh: 多移动相机视频拼接
items.abstract_en: We address geometric video alignment for the same scene captured by multiple freely moving cameras. Existing methods, which are based on image stitching or video stabilization, are typically limited to two cameras or must assume the restrictive setting of a fixed linear ordering of the cameras. We propose MViS, a lightweight test-time optimization framework for joint multi-view alignment with temporal consistency. MViS uses a spatial-transformer-inspired net to jointly process frames from all views within a short temporal window and predict per-view, per-time homographies. Optimization proceeds in two stages: geometry-guided alignment followed by appearance-based refinement, with both stages enforcing multi-view and temporal consistency across the sequence. The method requires no scene-specific hyperparameter tuning, handles arbitrary and time-varying view-intersection graphs, and remains robust under rapid camera motion. On a standard two-view video benchmark, MViS matches or surpasses the state of the art. To facilitate evaluation in more complex scenarios, we introduce an annotated dataset with more than two freely moving cameras and establish the first benchmark for this setting. Project page: https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/MViS-project/ .
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究由多个自由移动相机拍摄的同一场景的几何视频对齐。现有基于图像拼接或视频稳定的方法通常局限于两个相机，或必须假设相机固定线性排序这一限制性设置。我们提出 MViS，一个轻量级测试时优化框架，用于具有时间一致性的联合多视角对齐。MViS 使用受空间变换器启发的网络，在短时间窗口内联合处理所有视角的帧，并预测逐视角、逐时刻的单应性矩阵。优化分两个阶段进行：几何引导对齐，随后基于外观的精炼；两个阶段都在序列上强制多视角和时间一致性。该方法无需场景特定的超参数调优，可处理任意且随时间变化的视角相交图，并在快速相机运动下保持鲁棒。在标准双视角视频基准上，MViS 达到或超过当前最优水平。为便于在更复杂场景中评估，我们引入一个带标注的数据集，其中包含两个以上自由移动相机，并为该设置建立首个基准。项目页面：https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/MViS-project/。

items.title_en: Inferring viral variants and fitness advantages from longitudinal wastewater sequencing data
items.title_zh: 从纵向废水测序数据推断病毒变异株和适应度优势
items.abstract_en: During the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, wastewater-based epidemiology emerged as an effective tool for monitoring infection dynamics. However, wastewater represents a pooled sample of incomplete viral genomic fragments originating from multiple individuals in the catchment area of a wastewater treatment plant, preventing the assembly of complete viral genomes. Existing computational pipelines are therefore limited in detecting new variants that are absent from clinical sequencing data. We developed FitNMF, an integrated viral dynamics and non-negative matrix factorization model that leverages the temporal structure of wastewater sequencing data and the underlying variant competition to jointly infer mutational signatures, relative abundances, and fitness advantages of circulating variants directly from wastewater next-generation sequencing data. Using simulated data as well as wastewater time-series data collected between 2021 and 2024 across six Swiss wastewater treatment plants, we demonstrate FitNMF's ability to identify and quantify emerging variants de novo, offering a powerful tool for real-time variant surveillance in settings with limited clinical sequencing.
items.abstract_zh: 在 SARS-CoV-2 大流行期间，基于废水的流行病学成为监测感染动态的有效工具。然而，废水是来自污水处理厂集水区多个个体的不完整病毒基因组片段的混合样本，无法组装完整病毒基因组。因此，现有计算流程在检测临床测序数据中不存在的新变异株方面受到限制。我们开发了 FitNMF，一种整合病毒动力学与非负矩阵分解的模型，利用废水测序数据的时间结构以及潜在的变异株竞争，直接从废水下一代测序数据中联合推断突变特征、相对丰度和流行变异株的适应度优势。使用模拟数据以及 2021 年至 2024 年间在瑞士六座污水处理厂采集的废水时间序列数据，我们证明 FitNMF 能够从头识别和量化新出现的变异株，为临床测序有限环境下的实时变异株监测提供有力工具。

items.title_en: Approaching quantum limits in sub-Rayleigh resolution using phase modulation optimization
items.title_zh: 利用相位调制优化逼近亚瑞利分辨率中的量子极限
items.abstract_en: Spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) has made significant progress in incoherent optical imaging and has been implemented through various experimental approaches. Holography-based SPADE is widely used in proof-of-principle experiments because of its low cost, stable optical arrangement, and ease of implementation. However, its low photon utilization severely limits its practical applications. Alternating Fourier transforms and phase modulations can implement unitary optical transformations. Building on this idea, we use backpropagation to optimize the phase profiles of spatial light modulators (SLMs) and thereby design quantum measurements that are efficient in both information and energy. We study centroid--separation estimation for two incoherent point sources, using Fisher information or the estimation errors of an auxiliary neural network estimator as optimization objectives. As the number of SLMs increases, the optimized measurements approach the quantum limits characterized by the quantum Cramér-Rao bound and the information-regret tradeoff relation. With a few SLMs, our method can outperform direct imaging, showing its potential for superresolution imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 空间模式解复用（SPADE）在非相干光学成像中取得了显著进展，并已通过多种实验方法实现。基于全息术的 SPADE 因其低成本、稳定光学布置和易于实现而广泛用于原理验证实验。然而，其低光子利用率严重限制了实际应用。交替傅里叶变换和相位调制可以实现酉光学变换。基于这一思想，我们使用反向传播优化空间光调制器（SLM）的相位分布，从而设计在信息和能量两方面都高效的量子测量。我们研究两个非相干点源的中心-间距估计，使用 Fisher 信息或辅助神经网络估计器的估计误差作为优化目标。随着 SLM 数量增加，优化后的测量逼近由量子 Cramér-Rao 界和信息-遗憾权衡关系刻画的量子极限。仅使用少量 SLM 时，我们的方法即可优于直接成像，显示出其在超分辨成像中的潜力。

items.title_en: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
items.title_zh: SAE 解读 MoE：稀疏自编码器揭示 MoE 专家具有人类可解释的细粒度专业化
items.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, yet what an individual expert is responsible for remains unsettled. Existing analyses count how often an expert is selected on domain-labeled corpora, an instrument that fixes the taxonomy in advance, stays coarse, and records selection rather than contribution. We instead study specialization in feature space by training a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on the output of an MoE layer. Since this output is a router-weighted sum of expert outputs and the SAE encoder is affine, the pre-activation of every latent decomposes exactly over the experts. Aggregated over a corpus, this gives each expert a dominant set of latents whose activation it principally drives. On layers 4, 30 and 46 of Qwen3-30B-A3B, contribution is far more concentrated than gating, most latents have only one or two dominators, and the overlap between dominant sets concentrates on a few expert pairs. Auto-interpreting these sets reveals a division of labor below coarse domains, with distinct experts for Java and front-end web code, or for geometry and for arithmetic and polynomials, while the coarse domains themselves take very unequal numbers of experts. Our SAEs and code are available at https://github.com/Bytedance-Seed/SAE-Interprets-MoE.
items.abstract_zh: 专家混合（MoE）模型将每个 token 路由到众多专家中的少数几个，但单个专家负责什么仍未确定。现有分析统计专家在领域标注语料上被选择的频率，这种工具预先固定分类体系、粒度较粗，且记录的是选择而非贡献。我们改为通过在 MoE 层输出上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）来研究特征空间中的专业化。由于该输出是专家输出的路由器加权和，且 SAE 编码器是仿射的，每个潜变量的预激活可精确分解到各专家上。在语料上聚合后，这为每个专家给出其主导驱动激活的一组主导潜变量。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的第 4、30 和 46 层，贡献远比门控集中，大多数潜变量只有一个或两个主导者，且主导集合之间的重叠集中在少数专家对上。自动解释这些集合揭示了粗粒度领域之下的分工，例如 Java 与前端 Web 代码有不同专家，几何与算术和多项式也有不同专家，而粗粒度领域本身占用的专家数量非常不均。我们的 SAE 和代码见 https://github.com/Bytedance-Seed/SAE-Interprets-MoE。

items.title_en: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
items.title_zh: 通往现实世界的最后一英里：智能体原生原语作为解决现实世界任务的可复用构建模块
items.abstract_en: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ less time and 1.55$\times$ lower cost per completed task.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体如何端到端处理现实世界任务？具有自身 harness 的前沿模型在现实世界基准上仍然表现不足：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，GPT-5.6 Sol 搭配 Codex 解决 37.3% 的任务，Claude Opus 5 搭配 Claude Code 解决 51.8%。这些任务失败在从触及资源到应用资源的步骤，我们称之为通往现实世界的最后一英里。现有方法让资源触手可及，却把应用资源的能力留给调用者，因此每个 harness 都要重新构建该能力。我们引入智能体原生原语，即可复用单元，为资源配备一个常驻 LLM，使其在上下文中应用该资源并与其他原语通信；我们还引入 HEELO（Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-World Tasks），一个 harness 工程框架，从此类原语库中为每个任务构建 harness。HEELO 将任务所需的原语组合成任务特定图，依据环境证据验证结果，修订失败所牵涉的原语，并在验证后接纳新的或改进的原语。我们用八个原语家族实例化 HEELO，每个家族针对一类任务构建，并在二十多个基准上评估。Dev-Primitives 将 Terminal-Bench 4.0 的解决率从 Codex 下的 37.3% 提升到同一骨干上的 55.5%，按任务组合的 Harness Primitives 将 Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 从种子 harness 的 60.0% 提升到 72.2%，Tool Primitives 将 ToolBench 通过率从 55.8% 提升到 75.1%，Navigation Primitives 将 GAIA-Text-103 准确率从 45.6% 提升到 58.3%。在我们 heelo.dev 平台的 46 个现实世界任务上，Claude Opus 5.5 搭配 Claude Code 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 搭配 Codex 各自独立完成 9 个任务，而在通过我们的 MCP 服务器连接到 HEELO 时分别完成 39 和 35 个任务，每个完成任务的时间分别减少 1.9 倍和 2.3 倍，成本降低 1.55 倍。

items.title_en: Scenario Orchestration for Closed-loop Policy Evaluation of Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 用于自动驾驶闭环策略评估的场景编排
items.abstract_en: Scenario-based simulation is central to evaluating autonomous-driving policies, but a scenario scripted before execution (i.e., with predetermined, fixed actor routes and speeds) may not preserve its intended interaction once the tested ego policy responds in closed loop. Scripted scenarios cannot adapt to unanticipated ego behavior, while learned traffic actors may remain reactive without reliably realizing a particular scenario intent. We introduce a scenario orchestrator that continuously monitors the joint traffic state and adapts non-ego actors through re-timing, re-routing, and role reassignment for creating a specific scenario intent. At each step, the orchestrator solves a constrained optimization problem that preserves the intended interaction while limiting interventions and maintaining traffic feasibility. We further distinguish scenario realization from policy failure, allowing a test to first be judged based on whether the intended interaction occurred and then by how the ego policy responded. Experiments in the CARLA simulator across multiple scenario families and driving policies show that orchestration realizes targeted interactions more reliably than scripted and learned actor-level baselines, particularly under variations in initial conditions and ego behavior. These results support closed-loop scenario orchestration as a tool for controlled and reproducible policy evaluation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于场景的仿真对于评估自动驾驶策略至关重要，但一个在执行前编写好的场景（即具有预先确定且固定的参与者路线和速度）一旦被测自车策略在闭环中作出响应，可能无法保持其预期交互。脚本化场景无法适应未预料的自车行为，而学习型交通参与者可能保持反应性，却不能可靠实现特定场景意图。我们引入一个场景编排器，它持续监测联合交通状态，并通过重新定时、重新路由和角色重新分配来调整非自车参与者，以创建特定场景意图。在每一步，编排器求解一个约束优化问题，在保持预期交互的同时限制干预并维持交通可行性。我们进一步区分场景实现与策略失败，使测试可以先根据预期交互是否发生来判定，然后再根据自车策略如何响应来判定。在 CARLA 模拟器中跨多个场景家族和驾驶策略的实验表明，编排比脚本化和学习型参与者级基线更可靠地实现目标交互，尤其是在初始条件和自车行为变化时。这些结果支持将闭环场景编排作为受控且可复现的策略评估工具。

items.title_en: Dual Architecture Fusion Vehicle Lidar 3D Target Detection
items.title_zh: 双架构融合的车载激光雷达三维目标检测
items.abstract_en: In this paper, a 3D backbone network (SpconvTransformer) based on the fusion of convolutional architecture branch and Transformer architecture branch is proposed. The convolution branch uses 3D sparse convolution and submanifold convolution to learn local voxel features and semantic information, and the Transformer branch uses the self-attention mechanism to model the remote relationship between voxels, uses the broad receptive field to capture rich context information, and complementing the advantages of the two architectures by fusing the local features extracted from the two branches and the global features solves the problem of limited receptive fields of 3D convolutional neural networks. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of SpconvTransformer in 3D object detection and bird's-eye view detection tasks reaches 81.45% and 88.09%, respectively, and the average directional similarity reaches 91.10%, which is significantly better than other existing algorithms.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于卷积架构分支与 Transformer 架构分支融合的三维骨干网络 SpconvTransformer。卷积分支使用三维稀疏卷积和子流形卷积学习局部体素特征与语义信息，Transformer 分支使用自注意力机制建模体素之间的远程关系，利用大感受野捕获丰富的上下文信息，并通过融合两个分支提取的局部特征与全局特征来互补两种架构的优势，解决三维卷积神经网络感受野有限的问题。实验结果表明，SpconvTransformer 在三维目标检测和鸟瞰图检测任务中的平均精度分别达到 81.45% 和 88.09%，平均方向相似度达到 91.10%，显著优于其他现有算法。

items.title_en: Deep learning-based electrocardiographic differentiation of Takotsubo syndrome from acute anterior myocardial infarction: explainability, human-AI interaction, and a utilization bias hypothesis
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的心电图鉴别Takotsubo综合征与急性前壁心肌梗死：可解释性、人机交互及一种使用偏倚假设
items.abstract_en: Background and Aims: Artificial intelligence (AI) may help differentiate Takotsubo syndrome from acute anterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) on electrocardiograms (ECGs). We developed an ECG image-based model and evaluated whether AI assistance and visual explanations improved reader performance, overall and by reader background. Methods: A self-supervised three-architecture deep learning ensemble was developed and externally validated using 12-lead ECG images from two institutions, recorded [≤]14 days after onset regardless of reperfusion. A four-phase reader study compared unaided interpretation, a reference sheet, and AI assistance (Phases 1--3). In Phase 4, readers were randomized to the reference sheet alone, AI predictions, or predictions with gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM). Correctness was analyzed with generalized linear mixed-effects models. Results: Cohorts comprised 832 development and 95 external validation participants. External validation accuracy was 0.914, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.970 (95% CI, 0.938--0.992), or 0.958 using first recorded ECGs. Among 70 readers, the estimated probability of correct diagnosis increased from 0.632 unaided to 0.864 with AI (odds ratio [OR], 3.71; P<0.001). In Phase 4, AI assistance improved accuracy vs reference sheet (OR, 4.28; 95% CI, 3.08--5.95), and Grad-CAM added value (OR, 1.53; 95% CI, 1.04--2.25). In exploratory analyses, less experienced readers gained more; with AI, non-cardiologists outperformed cardiologists. Mean AI-assisted reader accuracy remained below model accuracy. Conclusions: An ECG image-based ensemble differentiated Takotsubo syndrome from anterior STEMI and improved reader performance, particularly with visual explanations. Experience-related differences emphasize the need for effective human-AI interaction.
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：人工智能（AI）可能有助于在心电图上鉴别Takotsubo综合征与急性前壁ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）。我们开发了一个基于心电图图像的模型，并评估AI辅助和视觉解释是否改善判读者表现（总体及按判读者背景分层）。方法：开发了一个自监督三架构深度学习集成模型，并使用来自两家机构的12导联心电图图像进行外部验证，这些心电图记录于发病后≤14天，无论是否再灌注。一项四阶段判读者研究比较了无辅助判读、参考表和AI辅助（第1—3阶段）。在第4阶段，判读者被随机分配至仅参考表、AI预测或带梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）的预测。正确性采用广义线性混合效应模型分析。结果：队列包括832名开发参与者和95名外部验证参与者。外部验证准确率为0.914，受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.970（95% CI，0.938—0.992），使用首次记录的心电图时为0.958。在70名判读者中，正确诊断的估计概率从无辅助时的0.632增加到AI辅助时的0.864（比值比[OR]，3.71；P<0.001）。在第4阶段，AI辅助较参考表提高了准确率（OR，4.28；95% CI，3.08—5.95），Grad-CAM增加了价值（OR，1.53；95% CI，1.04—2.25）。在探索性分析中，经验较少的判读者获益更多；使用AI时，非心脏病专家表现优于心脏病专家。AI辅助判读者的平均准确率仍低于模型准确率。结论：一个基于心电图图像的集成模型可鉴别Takotsubo综合征与前壁STEMI，并改善判读者表现，尤其是在有视觉解释时。经验相关差异强调需要有效的人机交互。

items.title_en: Raman anyon-Hubbard model in a 1D Bose lattice gas
items.title_zh: 一维玻色晶格气体中的Raman任意子-Hubbard模型
items.abstract_en: The anyon-Hubbard model is the paradigmatic lattice model of one-dimensional (1D) anyons, in which chiral interactions make bosons equivalent to particles with fractional statistics. Its continuum limit, the chiral BF theory, emerges as the low-energy description of a Raman-coupled Bose gas with imbalanced interactions. Here, we show that loading such a gas into a 1D optical lattice realizes the lattice counterpart of this theory, which we name the Raman anyon-Hubbard model. The Raman-dressed bosons acquire density-dependent Peierls phases when tunneling through occupied sites. For a small statistical phase, the model reduces to the anyon-Hubbard model, while beyond this limit it defines a distinct lattice anyon model with unbounded rather than periodic statistical interactions. Numerically, we show that the dressed gas displays the defining properties of 1D anyons, namely a density-dependent asymmetry of the ground-state momentum distribution, interaction-induced asymmetric transport and chiral bound states. Remarkably, these features are readily accessible with Raman-coupled $^{39}$K atoms, opening up the experimental exploration of 1D anyons beyond the few-particle regime.
items.abstract_zh: 任意子-Hubbard模型是一维（1D）任意子的典型晶格模型，其中手性相互作用使玻色子等效于具有分数统计的粒子。其连续极限——手性BF理论——作为具有不平衡相互作用的拉曼耦合玻色气体的低能描述而出现。在此，我们表明将这种气体装载到一维光晶格中可实现该理论的晶格对应物，我们将其命名为Raman任意子-Hubbard模型。拉曼修饰的玻色子在隧穿通过被占据格点时获得密度依赖的Peierls相位。对于小的统计相位，该模型退化为任意子-Hubbard模型，而超出此极限时，它定义了一种不同的晶格任意子模型，其统计相互作用是无界的而非周期的。在数值上，我们表明修饰气体表现出一维任意子的定义性性质，即基态动量分布的密度依赖不对称性、相互作用诱导的不对称输运和手性束缚态。值得注意的是，这些特征用拉曼耦合的$^{39}$K原子即可方便地实现，从而开辟了超越少粒子 regime 的一维任意子实验探索。

items.title_en: CoMoFlow: Controllable Protein Conformational Ensemble Generation via Explicit Collective-Mode Modeling
items.title_zh: CoMoFlow：通过显式集体模式建模生成可控蛋白质构象系综
items.abstract_en: Protein conformational ensemble generation aims to efficiently characterize the structural variations accessible to a protein beyond a single static structure. Recent flow-based methods efficiently generate conformational ensembles, but they model coordinated structural variation implicitly, which can limit ensemble fidelity and hinder direct control. To address this limitation, we propose CoMoFlow, a controllable framework for generating protein backbone conformational ensembles by explicitly modeling collective variation. CoMoFlow constructs protein-specific collective modes from the equilibrium structure, learns the distribution of their coefficients across the molecular dynamics (MD) ensemble, and uses sampled collective variations to guide SE(3) flow matching through feature conditioning and prior recentering. Experiments on ATLAS and de novo proteins show that CoMoFlow improves reconstruction of MD conformational distributions and coordinated structural variation relative to strong flow-based baselines, while enabling direct control over targeted conformational changes.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象系综生成旨在高效表征蛋白质在单一静态结构之外可访问的结构变异。近期基于流的方法能够高效生成构象系综，但它们隐式地建模协调结构变异，这可能限制系综保真度并妨碍直接控制。为解决这一局限，我们提出CoMoFlow，一个通过显式建模集体变异来生成蛋白质骨架构象系综的可控框架。CoMoFlow从平衡结构构建蛋白质特异性集体模式，学习这些模式的系数在分子动力学（MD）系综中的分布，并使用采样的集体变异通过特征条件化和先验重中心化来引导SE(3)流匹配。在ATLAS和从头蛋白质上的实验表明，相对于强基于流的基线，CoMoFlow改善了MD构象分布和协调结构变异的重建，同时能够直接控制目标构象变化。

items.title_en: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
items.title_zh: 论预填充到自回归跨模型迁移的机遇与挑战
items.abstract_en: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. We find that trainable bridges can act as parameter-efficient adaptation mechanisms without exploiting useful sender information. We therefore propose PACT-Check to quantify how much of a trained PACT system's gain genuinely comes from communication. Finally, we discuss the opportunities and challenges of PACT systems. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour.
items.abstract_zh: 预填充到自回归跨模型迁移（PACT）是一种语言模型间潜在通信形式，它将较大模型的提示表示与较小模型的高效生成相结合，为平衡能力与推理成本提供了一种有前景的方式。然而，现有系统对独立评估大小模型协作的支持有限，而且仅任务性能提升并不能确定接收方是否从发送方信息中获益。我们提出 PLatour，一个开源 PACT 框架，通过轻量、零初始化线性桥连接冻结模型，这些桥直接以任务奖励训练，并支持混合注意力架构。PLatour 在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，并在共享数学和编码基准上使用小得多的发送方超过 Mostik 报告的结果。然而，受控实验表明，某些任务上的增益可由无信息发送方信号、自通信或仅训练接收方来复现。我们发现，可训练桥可以作为参数高效适应机制发挥作用，而并不利用有用的发送方信息。因此我们提出 PACT-Check，以量化训练后的 PACT 系统增益中有多少真正来自通信。最后，我们讨论 PACT 系统的机遇与挑战。代码见 https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour。

items.title_en: Autonomous Particle Image Velocimetry Using Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 使用零样本仿真到现实强化学习的自主粒子图像测速
items.abstract_en: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) reconstructs a flow field from the motion of tracer particles but the reconstruction quality is bounded by how well the flow structure of interest is resolved in the images. The acquisition position is typically fixed by the operator before the measurement. We cast camera placement as a sequential decision-making problem and train a reinforcement learning agent to control a 6-DoF manipulator equipped with a camera, enabling it to locate, frame and resolve a hydrofoil wake in a water tunnel. The agent commands the camera pose and observes the scene only through the velocity field and uncertainty estimated from time-separated image pairs. It is trained entirely in a photorealistic simulation of our water tunnel, with wakes generated by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations of hydrofoils with varying profiles, positions and angles of attack. After zero-shot transfer to the real water tunnel, the policy reliably locates and frames the wakes of randomly placed hydrofoils. It resolves the wake at a higher resolution than a fixed camera view and with lower error in the measured flow statistics, in roughly half the time of a full scan and with far fewer image pairs.
items.abstract_zh: 粒子图像测速（PIV）从示踪粒子的运动重建流场，但重建质量受限于图像中所关注流动结构被解析的程度。采集位置通常由操作者在测量前固定。我们将相机放置建模为序列决策问题，并训练强化学习智能体控制配备相机的6自由度机械臂，使其能够在水洞中定位、取景并解析水翼尾流。智能体命令相机位姿，并仅通过由时间分离图像对估计的速度场和不确定性观察场景。它完全在我们的水洞逼真仿真中训练，尾流由具有不同翼型、位置和攻角的水翼的计算流体动力学（CFD）仿真生成。在零样本迁移到真实水洞后，该策略能够可靠地定位并取景随机放置水翼的尾流。它以高于固定相机视角的分辨率解析尾流，并在测得流动统计量中具有更低误差，耗时约为全扫描的一半且使用的图像对少得多。

items.title_en: A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models
items.title_zh: 组合局部-全局光流模型的双层优化表述的理论分析
items.abstract_en: This paper analyzes a bilevel formulation for learning the regularization parameter of combined local-global (CLG) optical flow models. The lower-level problem computes the flow from a Lucas--Kanade data term and a quadratic or total variation (TV) regularizer, and the upper-level problem selects the parameter that minimizes the squared distance to a ground-truth flow. The setting is finite-dimensional, and a full-rank assumption makes the lower-level solution unique. For the quadratic model we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of an optimal parameter, for every optimal parameter to be positive, and for strict local optimality. For TV regularization an optimal parameter always exists, because the lower-level solution vanishes for large parameters, and we give a sufficient condition for positivity that accounts for the coupling of the two flow components through the local structure tensors. Synthetic examples illustrate the conditions, including cases in which they fail.
items.abstract_zh: 本文分析了一种用于学习组合局部-全局（CLG）光流模型正则化参数的双层表述。下层问题根据Lucas--Kanade数据项和二次或总变分（TV）正则化项计算光流，上层问题选择使与真实光流的平方距离最小化的参数。该设置是有限维的，满秩假设使下层解唯一。对于二次模型，我们推导了最优参数存在的充分条件、每个最优参数为正的充分条件以及严格局部最优性的充分条件。对于TV正则化，最优参数总是存在，因为当参数较大时下层解消失；我们给出了一个考虑两个光流分量通过局部结构张量耦合的正性充分条件。合成示例说明了这些条件，包括它们不成立的情形。

items.title_en: Identification of co-segregating RUBCN and KANK1 mutations in a UK amyotrophic lateral sclerosis kindred
items.title_zh: 在一个英国肌萎缩侧索硬化家系中鉴定共分离的RUBCN和KANK1突变
items.abstract_en: Bioinformatic analysis of next-generation sequencing data identified novel missense variants in RUBCN (p.Cys517Phe) and KANK1 (p.Pro1332Ala) that co-segregated with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in a United Kingdom kindred and were ultra-rare in European control populations (allele frequency < 0.001%). Likelihood-based segregation analysis demonstrated significant co-segregation with disease, yielding full-likelihood Bayes factor (FLB) scores of 4.6 and 5.5 for RUBCN and KANK1, respectively, exceeding the threshold supporting pathogenicity (FLB [≥] 4.33). Sex-stratified penetrance modelling identified maximal FLB scores of 7.9 for both genes under a model with male and female penetrances of 0.99 and 0.01, respectively. Gene-based burden analysis of deleterious ultra-rare variants in independent ALS case-control cohorts demonstrated exome-wide significant associations with ALS (SKAT-O, p < 1 x 10-9). Functional studies in lymphoblastoid cell lines derived from variant carriers revealed significantly increased apoptosis and dysregulated expression of genes involved in endocytosis, LC3-associated phagocytosis, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and cytoskeletal organisation (p < 0.05). Analysis of spinal cord tissue from ALS cases and controls showed significant upregulation of RUBCN (2.85-fold) and downregulation of KANK1 (0.40-fold) (p < 0.05). Collectively, these findings implicate RUBCN and KANK1 as candidate ALS genes and suggest that disruption of vesicular trafficking, autophagy-related pathways, and cytoskeletal homeostasis may contribute to disease pathogenesis of ALS.
items.abstract_zh: 对下一代测序数据的生物信息学分析鉴定了RUBCN（p.Cys517Phe）和KANK1（p.Pro1332Ala）中的新错义变异，这些变异在一个英国家系中与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）共分离，并且在欧洲对照人群中超罕见（等位基因频率 < 0.001%）。基于似然的分离分析证明与疾病显著共分离，RUBCN和KANK1的全似然贝叶斯因子（FLB）评分分别为4.6和5.5，超过支持致病性的阈值（FLB ≥ 4.33）。按性别分层的外显率建模在男性和女性外显率分别为0.99和0.01的模型下，鉴定出两个基因的最大FLB评分均为7.9。在独立ALS病例对照队列中对有害超罕见变异的基于基因的负荷分析显示与ALS存在外显子组范围显著关联（SKAT-O，p < 1×10^-9）。在来源于变异携带者的淋巴母细胞样细胞系中进行的功能研究显示凋亡显著增加，并且参与内吞作用、LC3相关吞噬作用、内质网应激和细胞骨架组织的基因表达失调（p < 0.05）。对ALS病例和对照的脊髓组织分析显示RUBCN显著上调（2.85倍）和KANK1显著下调（0.40倍）（p < 0.05）。总之，这些发现表明RUBCN和KANK1是候选ALS基因，并提示囊泡运输、自噬相关途径和细胞骨架稳态的破坏可能参与ALS的疾病发病机制。

items.title_en: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI
items.title_zh: 用AI发现经过形式化验证的量子程序
items.abstract_en: The timeline by which quantum computers can solve breakthrough problems in science depends on improved quantum algorithms as much as on better hardware. Such algorithmic advances are typically achieved through many years of expert human collaboration. In mathematics and computer science, large language models have accelerated progress through automated discovery loops. However, quantum algorithms can only be evaluated by classical computers on restricted or small instances. Here we demonstrate automated discovery of quantum programs beyond these regimes including order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications. To achieve this, we build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover in which large language model agents synthesize novel programs against formal problem specifications and verify their correctness and cost. Agent teams collaborate, sharing results and knowledge through wikis and discussing ideas at organized conferences. Our results improve on prior baselines for parallel search (up to 1.4x), quantum arithmetic (290x), and simulations relevant to fusion, photochemistry and drug-metabolism by 11x, 8x and 2.5x respectively. Combining human and artificial intelligence at scale, under the rigor of mathematical proof, lets researchers design algorithms that today's classical and quantum computers cannot test, shortening the path to practical quantum computation.
items.abstract_zh: 量子计算机能够解决科学突破性问题的时间线，既取决于更好的硬件，也同样取决于改进的量子算法。此类算法进展通常通过多年的专家人类协作实现。在数学和计算机科学中，大语言模型通过自动化发现循环加速了进展。然而，量子算法只能由经典计算机在受限或小规模实例上评估。在此，我们展示了在这些范围之外自动发现量子程序，包括在科学应用上实现数量级的改进。为实现这一点，我们在Lean定理证明器中构建了一个量子程序库，其中大语言模型智能体根据形式化问题规范合成新程序，并验证其正确性和成本。智能体团队协作，通过维基共享结果和知识，并在组织的会议上讨论想法。我们的结果改进了先前基线：并行搜索（最高1.4倍）、量子算术（290倍），以及与聚变、光化学和药物代谢相关的仿真分别改进11倍、8倍和2.5倍。在数学证明的严谨性下大规模结合人类与人工智能，使研究人员能够设计当今经典计算机和量子计算机无法测试的算法，从而缩短通往实用量子计算的路径。

items.title_en: Bridging Spiking and Continuous Dynamics in Spiking Neural Networks: A Muscle-Inspired Model
items.title_zh: 衔接脉冲神经网络中的脉冲动力学与连续动力学：一种受肌肉启发的模型
items.abstract_en: Transforming the spike trains produced by spiking neural networks (SNNs) into continuous signals through biologically inspired mechanisms remains an open challenge in generative and regression tasks. In biological systems, a similar transformation occurs when muscles integrate neural spikes to produce smooth, coordinated movements. Inspired by this mechanism, we introduce a muscle-response model, a biologically motivated dynamical layer that converts spike trains into continuous representations. Our approach uses second-order dynamics to model the temporal integration of spiking activity. We investigate how the number of spiking neurons and temporal resolution affect the quality of the generated signals in a text-to-speech task, showing that increasing representational capacity has a greater impact than increasing temporal resolution under the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, an analysis of the learned dynamics reveals that, without explicit constraints on the response type, most neurons converge toward non-oscillatory behavior. These results demonstrate the potential of biologically inspired dynamical decoders for bridging spiking neural computation and continuous signal generation.
items.abstract_zh: 通过生物学启发机制将脉冲神经网络（SNN）产生的脉冲序列转换为连续信号，在生成和回归任务中仍是一个开放挑战。在生物系统中，当肌肉整合神经脉冲以产生平滑、协调的运动时，会发生类似的转换。受此机制启发，我们引入肌肉响应模型，这是一种生物学动机的动态层，可将脉冲序列转换为连续表示。我们的方法使用二阶动力学来建模脉冲活动的时间积分。我们在文本到语音任务中研究脉冲神经元数量和时间分辨率如何影响生成信号的质量，表明在所评估配置下，增加表示容量比提高时间分辨率影响更大。此外，对学习到的动力学的分析表明，在没有对响应类型施加显式约束的情况下，大多数神经元收敛到非振荡行为。这些结果展示了受生物学启发的动态解码器在衔接脉冲神经计算与连续信号生成方面的潜力。

items.title_en: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
items.title_zh: RuACT：将非活跃评分细则恢复为自适应评判者与教师
items.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT.
items.abstract_zh: 基于评分细则的强化学习（RL）通过依据查询特定的评分细则对每个回答打分，将带可验证奖励的强化学习扩展到开放式任务。然而，在组相对优化下，一个所有采样回答都未通过（不可达）或都通过（饱和）的评分细则会给所有回答相同结果，不提供学习信号；在 Qwen3-4B 医学训练中，60.88% 的查询-评分细则观测是非活跃的。我们发现这两种状态缺乏不同的监督：在提示中陈述不可达评分细则可将其满足率从 1.13% 提高到 91.25%，而所有回答都通过某个饱和评分细则时，回答质量仍然存在差异。因此我们提出 RuACT（Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers），为每个非活跃评分细则分配能提供其所缺内容的角色。Rubric as Teacher 将不可达评分细则作为特权信息，用于奖励门控的在线策略自蒸馏；Rubric as Critic 将饱和评分细则分解为子评分细则，在共享父评分细则权重的同时区分当前回答。RuACT 在 Qwen3-4B 上于四个医学与科学基准上优于 GRPO、评分细则重加权和评分细则引导探索，并在 Qwen3-1.7B 上取得最佳平均值。在初始不可达评分细则上，无引导恢复率从 35.02% 升至 42.86%；子评分细则细化将独立 rollout 上的奖励-质量对齐从 57.74% 提升至 60.77%。代码见 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT。

items.title_en: FATHOM: World-Model-Guided Diffusion Action-Trajectory Selection for Sparse-Marker AUV Tracking
items.title_zh: FATHOM：面向稀疏标记 AUV 跟踪的世界模型引导扩散动作轨迹选择
items.abstract_en: Reliable relative tracking is fundamental to cooperative autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), yet remains challenging under nonlinear vehicle dynamics and degraded underwater visual conditions. Active light markers improve robustness to appearance variation, but provide deliberately sparse observations that can become incomplete or corrupted by occlusion, reflections, and detection noise during dynamic motion. To address the resulting partial-observation control problem, this paper proposes FATHOM, a world-model-guided diffusion action-trajectory selection framework for sparse-marker AUV tracking. FATHOM first integrates structured marker observations, inertial measurements, action history, and temporal dynamics into a predictive tracking belief using a multimodal task-supervised recurrent state-space model. A diffusion action prior then generates multiple expert-like multi-thruster trajectories, whose future tracking consequences are predicted through the learned latent dynamics. Rather than directly executing a generated trajectory, FATHOM selects the most favorable candidate under an explicit receding-horizon objective and continually updates the decision from onboard observations. Extensive offline analyses verify the learned predictive belief, multi-step world-model prediction, diffusion trajectory generation, and predictive selection. More importantly, comprehensive real-AUV experiments, including strong pose-based comparisons and component ablations, demonstrate robust autonomous tracking across nominal and challenging motions with naturally occurring partial marker visibility, while maintaining real-time onboard operation without motion-capture feedback.
items.abstract_zh: 可靠的相对跟踪是协作自主水下航行器（AUV）的基础，但在非线性载体动力学和水下视觉条件退化下仍具挑战性。主动光标记提升了对表观变化的鲁棒性，但有意提供稀疏观测，这些观测在动态运动过程中可能因遮挡、反射和检测噪声而变得不完整或受损。为解决由此产生的部分观测控制问题，本文提出 FATHOM，一种面向稀疏标记 AUV 跟踪的世界模型引导扩散动作轨迹选择框架。FATHOM 首先使用多模态任务监督的循环状态空间模型，将结构化标记观测、惯性测量、动作历史和时序动态集成到预测性跟踪信念中。随后，扩散动作先验生成多个类专家多推进器轨迹，并通过学习到的潜在动力学预测其未来跟踪后果。FATHOM 不直接执行生成的轨迹，而是在显式滚动时域目标下选择最有利的候选，并根据船载观测持续更新决策。大量离线分析验证了学习到的预测信念、多步世界模型预测、扩散轨迹生成和预测性选择。更重要的是，全面的真实 AUV 实验，包括强姿态基线比较和组件消融，展示了在自然发生的部分标记可见性下，在常规与挑战性运动中实现鲁棒自主跟踪，同时无需动作捕捉反馈即可保持实时船载运行。

items.title_en: Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation
items.title_zh: 智能体驱动的病理图像合成与分割生成先验
items.abstract_en: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.
items.abstract_zh: 病理深度学习方法受限于大规模像素级标注的可用性有限且成本高昂。合成数据可以缓解这一限制，但现有流程往往缺乏可靠的质量控制，并且与下游分析的关联较弱。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个三阶段框架，集成了自动化数据筛选、生成式表征学习以及对下游任务的高效适配。首先，我们开发了一个病理智能体系统来评估图像质量并过滤样本，得到 TCGA-200K，这是一个包含从公开 TCGA 库中选取的 217,030 个病理图像块的数据集。其次，我们在筛选后的数据上训练生成模型。除图像合成外，其骨干网络还学习可迁移至下游任务的结构与语义表征。第三，我们使用轻量级任务专用头将预训练生成骨干适配到语义分割。我们进一步引入 PathSeg-380K，这是一个语义分割数据集，包含专家对 12 种细胞类型约 380,000 个细胞的标注。在多个病理数据集上的实验表明，所提框架达到当前最优的分割性能。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath。

items.title_en: Proliferation and mutation as humoral immune response
items.title_zh: 增殖与突变作为体液免疫应答
items.abstract_en: The affinity maturation process, through which antibodies acquire relatively high affinity for an invading pathogen, involves complex mechanisms whose relative importance is not yet fully understood. This study proposes an analytical model of this process, to investigate the main factors governing proliferation and mutation and assess their respective roles. The model suggests that the immune system should not be expected to follow a single, rigid evolutionary pattern, as a wide range of proliferation and mutation strategies can yield nearly optimal outcomes. Keywords: Antibody, antigen, affinity, B-cell, mutation, proliferation
items.abstract_zh: 亲和力成熟过程使抗体获得对入侵病原体相对较高的亲和力，其涉及复杂机制，这些机制的相对重要性尚未被完全理解。本研究提出该过程的分析模型，以研究支配增殖与突变的主要因素并评估其各自作用。模型表明，不应期望免疫系统遵循单一、僵化的进化模式，因为广泛的增殖与突变策略都能产生近乎最优的结果。关键词：抗体、抗原、亲和力、B 细胞、突变、增殖

items.title_en: Exciton design via topological spin textures
items.title_zh: 通过拓扑自旋织构设计激子
items.abstract_en: Excitons carry energy and information through a semiconductor without carrying charge. This makes them attractive for optoelectronics, but also hard to guide. Magnetic skyrmions, on the other hand, are moved by small electrical currents. Here we develop a theory of excitons interacting with a skyrmion in which the electron and the hole are treated as distinct constituents, each with its own spin--orbit coupling. We find that the topology of the skyrmion is transferred to the exciton only when the exchange coupling exceeds the relevant spin--orbit splitting. The exciton then experiences a full flux quantum, with opposite signs in the two valleys. The quantum metric of the spin texture creates a ring-shaped barrier that traps excitons, whereas the topological charge fixes the angular momentum of the trapped states and hence their optical selection rules. Because the trap moves with the skyrmion, excitons can be transported by current pulses, and small skyrmions accommodate a single exciton, which opens the door for potential hybrid applications in future information technology intertwining topological magnetic bits with optical excitations.
items.abstract_zh: 激子在不携带电荷的情况下通过半导体传递能量和信息。这使其对光电子学具有吸引力，但也难以引导。另一方面，磁性斯格明子可由小电流驱动。本文建立激子与斯格明子相互作用的理论，其中电子和空穴被视为不同组分，各自具有自己的自旋-轨道耦合。我们发现，只有当交换耦合超过相关自旋-轨道劈裂时，斯格明子的拓扑才转移到激子上。此时激子经历一个完整磁通量子，且在两个谷中符号相反。自旋织构的量子度规产生环形势垒以捕获激子，而拓扑电荷固定被捕获态的角度动量，从而固定其光学选择定则。由于陷阱随斯格明子移动，激子可由电流脉冲输运，且小斯格明子可容纳单个激子，这为未来信息技术中拓扑磁比特与光激发交织的潜在混合应用打开了大门。
