items.title_en: Controllable Molecule Generation via Sparse Representation Editing: An Interpretability-Driven Perspective
items.title_zh: 通过稀疏表示编辑实现可控分子生成：一种可解释性驱动的视角
items.abstract_en: Controllable molecule generation is crucial for diverse scientific applications, such as drug discovery and materials design. While large language models (LLMs) show great promise, their dense and entangled representations impede precise control over the generation of molecules with bespoke substructures or properties. To address this, we propose Sparse Representation Editing (SpaRE), an interpretability-driven framework for fine-grained and precise control in LLM-based molecule generation. The crux of SpaRE is to learn an overcomplete sparse feature space that disentangles LLM representations into a compact set of latent features corresponding to chemically meaningful concepts. Within this space, we can directly manipulate these concept-aligned latent features to achieve (1) local control, by generating target atoms and functional groups at specified positions; and (2) global control, by customizing the overall structural and physicochemical properties within defined ranges. In this way, our framework advances interpretability from post-hoc analysis to actionable generative control. Experiments show that SpaRE can generate chemically desirable molecules under complex constraints in real-world scenarios, while offering mechanistic insights for quantitative structure-property analysis. The code and demo are available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_SpaRE.
items.abstract_zh: 可控分子生成对药物发现和材料设计等多种科学应用至关重要。尽管大语言模型（LLM）展现出巨大前景，其稠密且纠缠的表示阻碍了对具有定制子结构或性质的分子生成的精确控制。为此，我们提出稀疏表示编辑（SpaRE），一种可解释性驱动的框架，用于基于 LLM 的分子生成中的细粒度精确控制。SpaRE 的关键是学习一个过完备稀疏特征空间，将 LLM 表示解缠为对应于化学意义概念的紧凑潜在特征集合。在该空间中，我们可以直接操纵这些概念对齐的潜在特征，以实现：（1）局部控制，即在指定位置生成目标原子和官能团；（2）全局控制，即在限定范围内定制整体结构和物理化学性质。这样，我们的框架将可解释性从事后分析推进到可操作的生成控制。实验表明，SpaRE 能在真实场景的复杂约束下生成化学上合意的分子，同时为定量结构-性质分析提供机制性洞见。代码和演示见 https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_SpaRE。

items.title_en: An Effective Spoken Language Understanding Approach Leveraging Query-Adaptive Intent Detection
items.title_zh: 一种利用查询自适应意图检测的有效口语理解方法
items.abstract_en: Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3 4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval analysis further indicates that prototype-guided candidate selection achieves higher ground truth intent coverage across multiple input conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过上下文学习实现了无需微调的口语理解（SLU），但直接基于查询的检索可能选出语义相似却与意图无关的示例。本文提出通过原型提取的查询自适应意图检测（APEX），一种两阶段检索框架，首先使用意图级原型选择候选意图，然后在所选意图空间内检索上下文示例。在 SLURP 数据集上的实验，在完整转写和按困惑度分层条件下使用精确匹配准确率（EMA）评估联合 SLU 性能，并对 ASR 生成的转写进行额外检索分析。与基于查询的检索相比，在完整转写上，APEX 使用 Qwen3 4B 和 Gemma-3-4B 分别将 EMA 提高 4.34 和 3.97 个百分点。在高困惑度输入下，APEX 还带来 7.66 和 2.13 个百分点的 EMA 增益。检索分析进一步表明，原型引导的候选选择在多种输入条件下实现了更高的真实意图覆盖。

items.title_en: A Multimodal Haptic Interface for Simultaneous Softness and Thermal Modulation
items.title_zh: 用于同时调制柔软度与温度的多模态触觉接口
items.abstract_en: Haptic interactions, such as touching an object in virtual reality, involve detecting a plethora of sensations through the skin. Whilst tactile displays exist to simulate and manipulate all of these cues individually, little progress has been made constructing devices that can control multiple cues simultaneously. This paper presents a tactile display technology that offers both softness and temperature change. A prototype display, based on particle jamming and the thermal transfer of heated and cooled water, is evaluated in terms of its ability to change both stiffness and temperature. Mechanical evaluations demonstrate controllable stiffness increase of 300%, whilst thermal characterisation showed strong surface uniformity and a range of achievable temperatures from 10°C up to 50°C, with closed-loop control maintaining a 0.2°C error from a setpoint. This work advances the design of multimodal tactile displays with applications to perceptual research, medical simulation, and affective haptics.
items.abstract_zh: 触觉交互，例如在虚拟现实中触摸物体，涉及通过皮肤检测大量感觉。尽管已有触觉显示器可以单独模拟和操控所有这些线索，但在构建能够同时控制多种线索的设备方面进展甚少。本文提出一种同时提供柔软度和温度变化的触觉显示技术。基于颗粒阻塞以及加热和冷却水的热传递的原型显示器，就其改变刚度和温度的能力进行了评估。机械评估表明刚度可控制地增加300%，热表征显示出很强的表面均匀性以及从10°C到50°C的可实现温度范围，闭环控制相对于设定值保持0.2°C误差。这项工作推进了多模态触觉显示器的设计，应用于知觉研究、医学模拟和情感触觉。

items.title_en: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.title_zh: SplatAnything：面向任意场景前馈3DGS的高斯间距归一化
items.abstract_en: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.
items.abstract_zh: 我们指出现有前馈3DGS方法的一个关键局限：高斯属性通常在径向距离归一化空间中预测，该空间将重建几何的全局径向统计量规范化，但相邻高斯中心之间的间距在不同场景尺度和相机配置下仍可能显著变化。这种不匹配会导致高斯尺度目标出现系统性偏移，从而产生模糊的监督。为此，我们提出带有高斯间距归一化（GSNorm）的SplatAnything，它将高斯间距的稳健场景级统计量规范化，为高斯预测提供更一致的空间参考。为严格评估我们的方法，我们进一步建立了一个系统基准，涵盖多样数据集、输入稀疏程度和具有挑战性的外推视角。大量实验表明，SplatAnything达到最先进性能，在场景尺度和视角发生显著变化时收益尤为突出。

items.title_en: Identification of Kinome Biomarkers and Therapeutic Rescue in cGMP-Linked Retinal Degeneration
items.title_zh: cGMP相关视网膜变性中激酶组生物标志物的鉴定与治疗性挽救
items.abstract_en: Inherited retinal degenerations, such as Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP) and Leber's congenital amaurosis (LCA), are major causes of progressive and irreversible vision loss. The large number of genes associated with these disorders makes their clinical and molecular characterization difficult, while systemic biomarkers for disease progression or treatment response remain limited. These challenges were addressed by targeting cGMP-associated mechanisms shared by RP and LCA and integrating systemic biomarker profiling with retinal outcomes. Kinase activity analysis (kinome analysis) in peripheral blood mononuclear cells distinguished healthy and diseased states and captured therapy-associated signatures in rd10 mice treated with LP-CN03, a liposomal formulation of the cGMP analog CN03. This first systemic analysis in a therapeutically responsive animal model highlights kinome analysis as a potential translational readout. Given shared cGMP signaling in RP and AIPL1-associated LCA, LP-CN03's therapeutic potential was further evaluated in a new CRISPR-Cas9-generated Aipl1-/- mouse model. Treatment with LP-CN03 preserved retinal structure and function, as shown by electroretinography, longitudinal optical coherence tomography, fundus imaging, optomotor testing, and photoreceptor-specific gene expression. Together, these findings provide independent in vivo evidence for the neuroprotective effect of LP-CN03 in both cGMP-related RP and LCA, also highlighting the translational value of kinome profiling.
items.abstract_zh: 遗传性视网膜变性，如视网膜色素变性（RP）和Leber先天性黑蒙（LCA），是进行性和不可逆视力丧失的主要原因。与这些疾病相关的大量基因使其临床和分子表征变得困难，而用于疾病进展或治疗反应的系统性生物标志物仍然有限。为应对这些挑战，研究靶向RP和LCA共有的cGMP相关机制，并将系统性生物标志物分析与视网膜结局相结合。外周血单核细胞中的激酶活性分析（激酶组分析）可区分健康和疾病状态，并在接受LP-CN03（cGMP类似物CN03的脂质体制剂）治疗的rd10小鼠中捕获治疗相关特征。这是治疗反应性动物模型中的首个系统性分析，突出激酶组分析作为潜在转化读出。鉴于RP和AIPL1相关LCA共享cGMP信号传导，LP-CN03的治疗潜力进一步在新的CRISPR-Cas9生成的Aipl1-/-小鼠模型中得到评估。视网膜电图、纵向光学相干断层扫描、眼底成像、视动运动测试和光感受器特异性基因表达显示，LP-CN03治疗保留了视网膜结构和功能。总之，这些发现为LP-CN03在cGMP相关RP和LCA中的神经保护作用提供了独立体内证据，也突显了激酶组分析的转化价值。

items.title_en: Time-gated optical-parametric-amplification and field-resolved detection of mid-infrared free-induction decay signals
items.title_zh: 中红外自由感应衰减信号的时间门控光学参量放大与场分辨探测
items.abstract_en: Infrared spectroscopy is a key tool to study complex structural dynamics in molecular systems. However, resolving weak or broad vibrational modes is challenging due to their rapid decay. Here, we demonstrate a technique to significantly extend the detectable lifetime - and thereby spectral resolution - of molecular signatures by employing synchronized time-gated optical parametric amplification of mid-infrared free-induction decay signals. Utilizing a Cr:ZnS laser system and a nonlinear ZnGeP2 crystal, we achieve a 10-fold increase in the electric field strength of the infrared molecular signal, yielding a two-orders of magnitude enhancement in dynamic range and a 2-fold increase in the signal-to-noise ratio. Using isopropyl alcohol as a model system, we demonstrate that OPA-enhanced detection extends the observable window of vibrational modes up to 72 %. This approach allows for the reconstruction of high-fidelity molecular fingerprints that resolve complex vibrational relaxation pathways and weak structural dynamics, previously hidden within the background and noise, providing a pathway for new high-sensitivity and time-resolved studies of complex chemical structures.
items.abstract_zh: 红外光谱是研究分子系统中复杂结构动力学的关键工具。然而，由于弱或宽振动模式快速衰减，分辨它们具有挑战性。在此，我们展示一种技术，通过采用同步时间门控光学参量放大中红外自由感应衰减信号，显著延长分子特征的可探测寿命——并因此提高光谱分辨率。利用Cr:ZnS激光系统和非线性ZnGeP2晶体，我们使红外分子信号的电场强度提高10倍，动态范围增强两个数量级，信噪比提高2倍。以异丙醇为模型系统，我们证明OPA增强探测将振动模式的可观测窗口最多延长72%。该方法能够重建高保真分子指纹，分辨先前隐藏于背景和噪声中的复杂振动弛豫路径和弱结构动力学，为复杂化学结构的新高灵敏度和时间分辨研究提供途径。

items.title_en: An Ultra-Low-Noise Tunable TIA in 45nm Silicon Photonics for Electro-Optical Ultrasound Data Acquisition
items.title_zh: 用于电光超声数据采集的45nm硅光子超低噪声可调TIA
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and experimental characterization of a 32-channel, WDM-compatible electronic-photonic receiver array fabricated in the GlobalFoundries 45nm monolithic silicon photonics process. Optimized for miniaturized, millimeter-scale electro-optical ultrasound data acquisition probes for broadband photo-acoustic imaging (PAI), the chip utilizes integrated micro-ring resonator (MRR) demultiplexers and photodiode (PD) arrays to decode multi-wavelength acoustic signals outside the body. This work focuses specifically on the comprehensive characterization of the receiver front-end, evaluating both the optical WDM filter bank and the transimpedance amplifier (TIA) performance. Monolithic co-integration minimizes critical photodiode-to-TIA interface parasitics. The TIA incorporates a DC-offset cancellation loop that compensates for photodiode-induced offset currents while providing tunable low-frequency cutoff control over a range of 30 kHz to 1.5 MHz. This tunability enables effective suppression of flicker noise and improves overall signal integrity. The front-end achieves the peak transimpedance gain of 144 dB$Ω$ while maintaining an ultra-low input-referred noise current density of $1\text{ pA}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$, demonstrating a highly scalable architecture for high-sensitivity intravascular and endobronchial imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍一款32通道、兼容WDM的电子-光子接收器阵列的设计与实验表征，该阵列在GlobalFoundries 45nm单片硅光子工艺中制造。该芯片针对用于宽带光声成像（PAI）的小型化毫米级电光超声数据采集探头进行优化，利用集成微环谐振器（MRR）解复用器和光电二极管（PD）阵列在体外解码多波长声信号。本工作特别聚焦于接收器前端的全面表征，评估光学WDM滤波器组和跨阻放大器（TIA）性能。单片共集成最大限度减小关键的光电二极管到TIA接口寄生。TIA包含直流失调消除环路，可补偿光电二极管引起的失调电流，同时在30 kHz至1.5 MHz范围内提供可调低频截止控制。这种可调性能够有效抑制闪烁噪声并改善整体信号完整性。前端实现144 dBΩ的峰值跨阻增益，同时保持1 pA/√Hz的超低输入参考噪声电流密度，展示了用于高灵敏度血管内和支气管内成像的高度可扩展架构。

items.title_en: Syn2DRE: Synergistic Dual Teacher-Student Framework for Document-level Relation Extraction
items.title_zh: Syn2DRE：用于文档级关系抽取的协同双教师-学生框架
items.abstract_en: Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify relations between entities across a document but typically relies on costly large-scale annotations. While pseudo-labelling enables the use of low-quality data, existing methods often suffer from inefficiency and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we propose Syn2DRE, a semi-supervised framework that combines self-supervised learning with cross-supervision in a lightweight teacher-student architecture to produce more reliable pseudo-labels. Additionally, we introduce a unified end-to-end training strategy to further improve efficiency of the framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Syn2DRE consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art semi-supervised DocRE methods.
items.abstract_zh: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）旨在识别文档中实体之间的关系，但通常依赖昂贵的大规模标注。虽然伪标注能够利用低质量数据，但现有方法往往存在效率低和确认偏差问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出Syn2DRE，一种半监督框架，在轻量级教师-学生架构中结合自监督学习与交叉监督，以生成更可靠的伪标签。此外，我们引入统一的端到端训练策略，进一步提高框架效率。在多个基准上的实验表明，Syn2DRE持续优于先前最先进的半监督DocRE方法。

items.title_en: H-BRICK: Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene Closure for Directed Grid Graphs
items.title_zh: H-BRICK：用于有向网格图的带压缩 Kleene 闭包的分层边界可达性索引
items.abstract_en: Repeated directed reachability queries arise in online path planning, task-agent allocation, and swarm control on static grid maps, where reachability is asymmetric and full transitive closure is storage-prohibitive. We introduce H-BRICK, a Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene closure for exact cell-to-cell queries on directed grid graphs. H-BRICK partitions the graph into tiles, computes a local Boolean Kleene closure within each tile, and projects it onto the tile's boundary ports. The resulting directed port-to-port summaries are then composed recursively across shared interfaces up to a single root covering the graph. We prove algebraically that the construction is exact: in the Boolean Kleene algebra of binary relations, every composed summary equals the boundary projection of the regional reflexive transitive closure, and every cell-to-cell query agrees with reachability in the original graph. Experiments on directed grid graphs across diverse map topologies compare H-BRICK against directed search and component-based baselines, and compare its storage requirements against full transitive closure. A batched reachability evaluation further demonstrates that sharing endpoint lifts across many-source/many-target queries amortizes hierarchical traversal and, at k=64, yields a 5.0x-22.9x throughput improvement over the scalar query loop. The results show that hierarchical boundary compression is most advantageous in query-intensive spatial graphs where online search traverses large reachable regions and the hierarchy maintains compact boundary interfaces.
items.abstract_zh: 重复的有向可达性查询出现在静态网格图上的在线路径规划、任务-智能体分配和群体控制中，其中可达性是非对称的，完整传递闭包在存储上开销过高。我们引入 H-BRICK，一种用于有向网格图上精确单元到单元查询的带压缩 Kleene 闭包的分层边界可达性索引。H-BRICK 将图划分为瓦片，在每个瓦片内计算局部布尔 Kleene 闭包，并将其投影到瓦片的边界端口上。由此得到的有向端口到端口摘要随后跨共享接口递归组合，直至覆盖整个图的单一根节点。我们从代数上证明该构造是精确的：在二元关系的布尔 Kleene 代数中，每个组合摘要都等于区域自反传递闭包的边界投影，并且每个单元到单元查询都与原图中的可达性一致。在不同地图拓扑的有向网格图上的实验将 H-BRICK 与有向搜索和基于组件的基线进行比较，并将其存储需求与完整传递闭包进行比较。批量可达性评估进一步表明，在多源/多目标查询中共享端点提升可摊销分层遍历，并且在 k=64 时相对于标量查询循环带来 5.0 倍至 22.9 倍的吞吐量提升。结果表明，分层边界压缩在查询密集型空间图中最为有利，因为在线搜索会遍历大的可达区域，而层次结构维持紧凑的边界接口。

items.title_en: Multiscale Closing Index (MCI) for measuring structural similarity between 2D point sets
items.title_zh: 用于度量二维点集间结构相似性的多尺度闭运算指数（MCI）
items.abstract_en: We introduce Multi-scale Closing Index (MCI), a new dissimilarity measure for evaluating the alignment of two 2D point sets. MCI is bounded between 0 and 1 and is based on multiscale mathematical morphology operations, with smaller values indicating greater structural agreement. The measure was motivated by the need to assess the quality of registration between point sets representing cell populations in biological images. To evaluate its behaviour under controlled conditions, we generated synthetic point clouds from Perlin-noise-based spatial structures, following established approaches for simulating biologically plausible spatial organization. We assessed MCI between those point clouds and different transformed versions, obtained by local perturbation, point removal, translation, rotation and addition of impulsive noise. Across these experiments, the dissimilarity MCI increased gradually and consistently with perturbation severity, while showing a clear discontinuity between clouds originating from the same underlying spatial structure and point clouds generated from different structures. We further compared MCI with commonly used point-set distances, including Hausdorff-based measures and Sliced Wasserstein distance. These experiments show the ability of MCI to capture structural agreement and quantify deviations between point sets, highlighting its potential as a complementary metric for evaluating two-dimensional point-set registration.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出多尺度闭运算指数（MCI），一种用于评估两个二维点集对齐情况的新差异度量。MCI取值范围在0到1之间，基于多尺度数学形态学操作，数值越小表示结构一致性越高。该度量的提出源于评估生物图像中代表细胞群体的点集之间配准质量的需求。为在受控条件下评估其行为，我们遵循模拟生物学上合理的空间组织的既有方法，从基于Perlin噪声的空间结构生成合成点云。我们评估了这些点云与通过局部扰动、点移除、平移、旋转和加入脉冲噪声获得的不同变换版本之间的MCI。在这些实验中，差异度MCI随扰动严重程度逐渐且一致地增加，同时在源自相同底层空间结构的点云与由不同结构生成的点云之间表现出明显的不连续性。我们进一步将MCI与常用点集距离进行比较，包括基于Hausdorff的度量和Sliced Wasserstein距离。这些实验表明MCI能够捕捉结构一致性并量化点集间偏差，突显其作为评估二维点集配准的补充指标的潜力。

items.title_en: Citrobacter rodentium infection disrupts colonic mucus barrier function via ablation of intercrypt goblet cells
items.title_zh: 鼠柠檬酸杆菌感染通过消除隐窝间杯状细胞破坏结肠黏液屏障功能
items.abstract_en: The colonic mucus barrier, composed of distinct layers maintained by specialized goblet cell (GC) subtypes, forms the first line of defense against enteric pathogens. However, the individual contributions of inner (IML) and fecal (FML) mucus layers to barrier integrity, and how these layers and the GC responses are dynamically modulated during infection remain incompletely understood. Using Citrobacter rodentium infection in mice, we show that early colonization disrupts the inner mucus layer, increases mucus penetrability and drives alterations in faecal mucus layer thickness. Spatial imaging revealed progressive crypt infiltration and concurrent accumulation of pathogen clusters within the FML. Transcriptomic and functional analyses identified Spdef-dependent intercrypt goblet cells (icGCs) as essential for sustaining IML integrity and limiting epithelial access. Spdef-deficient mice exhibited delayed clearance and enhanced crypt invasion, highlighting the protective role of icGCs. Infection selectively depleted icGCs, collapsing the intercrypt mucus and creating permissive niches for colonization. Mechanistically, C. rodentium leveraged its type III secretion system, specifically the EspF effector to reprogram GC transcriptional responses, inducing metabolic stress and promoting apoptotic signatures in GCs specifically. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized virulence strategy in which EspF-driven GC remodeling compromises intercrypt mucus defenses, potentially facilitating pathogen persistence and transmission.
items.abstract_zh: 结肠黏液屏障由特化杯状细胞（GC）亚型维持的 distinct 层组成，构成抵御肠道病原体的第一道防线。然而，内黏液层（IML）和粪便黏液层（FML）对屏障完整性的各自贡献，以及这些层和GC反应在感染过程中如何被动态调节，仍不完全清楚。利用小鼠鼠柠檬酸杆菌感染，我们表明早期定植破坏内黏液层，增加黏液可穿透性，并驱动粪便黏液层厚度的改变。空间成像显示进行性隐窝浸润以及病原体簇在FML中的同时积累。转录组和功能分析确定，Spdef依赖的隐窝间杯状细胞（icGCs）对维持IML完整性和限制上皮可及性至关重要。Spdef缺陷小鼠表现出清除延迟和隐窝侵袭增强，突显了icGCs的保护作用。感染选择性耗竭icGCs，使隐窝间黏液塌陷，并为定植创造许可性生态位。机制上，鼠柠檬酸杆菌利用其III型分泌系统，特别是EspF效应蛋白，重编程GC转录反应，诱导代谢应激，并特异性地促进GC中的凋亡特征。这些发现揭示了一种此前未被认识到的毒力策略：EspF驱动的GC重塑损害隐窝间黏液防御，可能促进病原体持续存在和传播。

items.title_en: Universal photonic synthetic temporal-mode converter for heterogeneous quantum interconnects
items.title_zh: 用于异构量子互连的通用光子合成时间模式转换器
items.abstract_en: We propose a synthetic temporal-mode converter (STC) that combines programmable waveform matching with denser time multiplexing for heterogeneous quantum interconnects. Programmable couplers and optical delays reshape known single-photon temporal waveforms through coherent interference between time bins. Conversion to a common single-bin mode concentrates amplitudes from $N$ bins in $\lceil\log_2N\rceil$ mixing stages, simultaneously improving temporal indistinguishability and freeing channel time. Simulations yield mode overlaps above 99.9\% for exponential and Gaussian inputs. For $N=256$ and $0.5\,\mathrm{dB}$ loss per stage, STC gives a 45.6-fold higher photon-pair coincidence rate than temporal gating at equal mode overlap for two exponential inputs. Relative to long pulses, the shortened temporal matched mode can support an approximately 41-fold higher photon-pair coincidence rate when the available time-multiplexing capacity is fully utilized.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种合成时间模式转换器（STC），将可编程波形匹配与更密集的时间复用相结合，用于异构量子互连。可编程耦合器和光延迟通过时间仓之间的相干干涉重塑已知的单光子时间波形。转换为共同的单时间仓模式可在⌈log2 N⌉个混合级中将来自N个时间仓的振幅集中起来，同时提高时间不可区分性并释放信道时间。仿真显示，对于指数型和高斯型输入，模式重叠超过99.9%。对于N=256且每级损耗0.5 dB，在两个指数型输入且模式重叠相同的情况下，STC的光子对符合计数率比时间门控高45.6倍。相对于长脉冲，当可用的时间复用容量被充分利用时，缩短的时间匹配模式可支持约41倍更高的光子对符合计数率。

items.title_en: Sensing-Based Communication: A Non-Orthogonal Passive Reflection Framework for ISAC
items.title_zh: 基于感知的通信：面向ISAC的非正交无源反射框架
items.abstract_en: While integrating uplink without disrupting the primary downlink remains a critical challenge for existing reflective communication systems, this paper proposes a non-orthogonal passive integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) mechanism termed Sensing-based Communication. Originating from and validated within an optical retro-reflective system, this mechanism possesses an underlying wave-agnostic architecture with the potential to be generalized across other physical modalities. It leverages incident downlink signals for parasitic modulation via passive tags. By relying solely on fundamental on-off keying (OOK) reflection, the tag unifies the reflective sensing channel and the uplink communication channel, and simultaneously achieves both sensing and duplex communication. Consequently, our approach introduces uplink capability without sacrificing the downlink data rate or consuming additional spectrum resources. At the receiver, we design a joint decoding architecture combining cross-correlation computation and successive interference cancelation (SIC) to fully exploit the degrees of freedom in broadband signals for multi-user interference suppression. We derive closed-form expressions for the interference and bit error rate (BER) assuming zero-mean Gaussian signals. Using an experimental testbed, we validate the pivotal theoretical finding, the scaling relationship of SINR with signal bandwidth and cross-correlation time--where linear regression yields a strong goodness-of-fit with $R^2 = 0.9688$. Furthermore, evaluations under noise-like orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms exhibit high consistency between theoretical derivations and simulation data ($R^2 = 0.9372$, mean absolute percentage error, $\text{MAPE} = 14\%$), confirming the model's accuracy and waveform generalizability.
items.abstract_zh: 在不破坏主下行链路的情况下集成上行链路，仍是现有反射通信系统的关键挑战；本文提出一种称为基于感知的通信的非正交无源集成感知与通信（ISAC）机制。该机制源于光回反射系统并在其中得到验证，具有潜在的与波型无关的体系结构，有望推广到其他物理模态。它利用入射的下行信号，通过无源标签进行寄生调制。仅依靠基本的开关键控（OOK）反射，标签统一了反射感知信道和上行通信信道，并同时实现感知与双工通信。因此，我们的方法在不牺牲下行数据速率或不消耗额外频谱资源的情况下引入了上行能力。在接收端，我们设计了一种联合解码架构，结合互相关计算和串行干扰消除（SIC），以充分利用宽带信号中的自由度进行多用户干扰抑制。在假设零均值高斯信号的情况下，我们推导了干扰和误码率（BER）的闭式表达式。使用实验测试平台，我们验证了关键理论发现，即SINR随信号带宽和互相关时间的缩放关系——其中线性回归给出强拟合优度，R²=0.9688。此外，在类噪声正交频分复用（OFDM）波形下的评估显示，理论推导与仿真数据高度一致（R²=0.9372，平均绝对百分比误差MAPE=14%），证实了模型的准确性和波形泛化性。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Correspondence Learning for Lexical and Style Embeddings: Interpreting Latent Space via Acoustic Features
items.title_zh: 面向词汇与风格嵌入的非对称对应学习：通过声学特征解释潜在空间
items.abstract_en: Self-supervised speech embeddings jointly encode lexical, speaker, and prosodic information, complicating feature isolation. We introduce Asymmetric Correspondence Learning (ACL), distilling HuBERT features into separate Acoustic Word Embeddings (AWEs) and Acoustic Style Embeddings (ASEs) via a split-latent correspondence bottleneck. Through probing and clustering evaluations on single-word utterances, we demonstrate that substantial variance from extrinsic sources remains encoded within each latent space, despite linear probing indicating the information has been stripped. Whilst the AWE space exhibits cohesive lexical clustering (AP$\approx$0.90, Fisher$\approx$6.28), linear probing on the ASE space achieves 97.9\% speaker accuracy across a diffuse topology (Fisher$\approx$1.01), yet preserves substantial lexical variance (Fisher$\approx$0.86) that remains linearly unrecoverable (0.17\%). To explain these findings, we apply group-level permutation feature importance over eGeMAPS acoustic features, finding that AWEs partition by vocal tract filters and ASEs by $F_0$ dynamics. These findings suggest that standard diagnostic benchmarks may be insufficient for verifying feature isolation, as substantial speech structure can be retained even when it remains entirely hidden from probes.
items.abstract_zh: 自监督语音嵌入联合编码词汇、说话人和韵律信息，使特征分离变得复杂。我们提出非对称对应学习（ACL），通过分裂潜在对应瓶颈将HuBERT特征蒸馏为独立的声学词嵌入（AWEs）和声学风格嵌入（ASEs）。通过对单词话语的探测和聚类评估，我们证明，尽管线性探测表明信息已被剥离，但来自外在来源的显著方差仍编码在每个潜在空间中。虽然AWE空间表现出内聚的词汇聚类（AP≈0.90，Fisher≈6.28），但在ASE空间上进行线性探测，在弥散拓扑（Fisher≈1.01）上达到97.9%的说话人准确率，却保留了大量词汇方差（Fisher≈0.86），且该方差仍线性不可恢复（0.17%）。为解释这些发现，我们对eGeMAPS声学特征应用组级置换特征重要性，发现AWEs按声道滤波器划分，而ASEs按F0动态划分。这些发现表明，标准诊断基准可能不足以验证特征分离，因为即使大量语音结构对探测完全隐藏，也可能被保留。

items.title_en: Reinforcing End-to-End Autonomous Driving Safety via Negative-Aware Planning in a Unified World-Action Model
items.title_zh: 在统一世界-动作模型中通过负样本感知规划增强端到端自动驾驶安全
items.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future traffic states and driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. However, their action learning remains dominated by expert-trajectory imitation, leaving unsafe alternatives close to expert trajectories insufficiently constrained. To improve WAM robustness in safety-critical scenarios, we propose NegWAM, a safety post-training framework for unified WAMs that learns explicit safety boundaries from near-expert failure trajectories. NegWAM constructs negative trajectories that are geometrically close to the expert trajectory yet carry safety risks, uses them as repulsive anchors to steer predictions away from dangerous behavior, and encodes them as scene-conditioned rider tokens to learn scene--trajectory compatibility. During training, NegWAM jointly optimizes the flow-matching and near-expert negative objectives, while the auxiliary rider branch is discarded at inference, incurring no additional overhead. On NAVSIM v2, NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard, a 4.1% relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest. These results demonstrate that NegWAM achieves strong performance in safety-critical scenarios while preserving routine-driving performance. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further demonstrates cross-benchmark generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAM）联合建模未来交通状态和驾驶动作，用于智能交通系统中的端到端自动驾驶。然而，其动作学习仍由专家轨迹模仿主导，导致接近专家轨迹的不安全替代方案未得到充分约束。为提升 WAM 在安全关键场景中的鲁棒性，我们提出 NegWAM，一种用于统一 WAM 的安全后训练框架，从接近专家的失败轨迹中学习显式安全边界。NegWAM 构建在几何上接近专家轨迹但带有安全风险的负轨迹，将其用作排斥锚点以引导预测远离危险行为，并将其编码为场景条件化的 rider token，以学习场景—轨迹兼容性。训练期间，NegWAM 联合优化流匹配和接近专家的负样本目标，而辅助 rider 分支在推理时被丢弃，不产生额外开销。在 NAVSIM v2 上，NegWAM 在 navhard 上达到 40.4 EPDMS，相较最强的对比无评分器 WAM 基线相对提升 4.1%，并在 navtest 上达到 93.3 EPDMS。这些结果表明，NegWAM 在安全关键场景中取得强劲性能，同时保持常规驾驶性能。在 HUGSIM 上的零样本闭环评估进一步展示了跨基准泛化能力。代码见 https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM。

items.title_en: Dual-Region Slice Aggregation for CT-Based Renal Tumor Classification
items.title_zh: 用于基于CT的肾肿瘤分类的双区域切片聚合
items.abstract_en: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is the most common kidney cancer in adults. We present a region-aware architecture for CT-based ccRCC classification. Tumor and 0--10 mm peritumoral context are pooled separately from shared frozen DINOv3 feature maps. A shared position-aware slice aggregator precedes fixed training-only principal component analysis (PCA). The resulting representations are fused with radiomics using two scalar feature gates. Evaluation on KiTS23 and 111 external cases yields internal test and external AUCs of 0.8078\pm0.0154 and 0.9094\pm0.0015. Compared with matched single-tumor readout, mean AUC increases by 1.50 and 2.34 percentage points, respectively. Early-PCA and reconstruction controls yield lower internal mean AUCs, while external AUC is similar for early and late PCA. These findings highlight the joint role of regional readout and slice aggregation in adapting frozen visual features to renal CT.
items.abstract_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）是成人中最常见的肾癌。我们提出一种用于基于CT的ccRCC分类的区域感知架构。肿瘤和0–10 mm瘤周上下文分别从共享的冻结DINOv3特征图中池化。共享的位置感知切片聚合器位于固定的仅训练期主成分分析（PCA）之前。所得表示通过两个标量特征门与放射组学融合。在KiTS23和111例外病例上的评估得到内部测试和外部AUC分别为0.8078±0.0154和0.9094±0.0015。与匹配的单肿瘤读出相比，平均AUC分别提高1.50和2.34个百分点。早期PCA和重建对照产生较低的内部平均AUC，而早期和晚期PCA的外部AUC相似。这些发现突显了区域读出和切片聚合在使冻结视觉特征适应肾脏CT中的共同作用。

items.title_en: Frequency-Dependent Structural Responses of Amyloid-β Fibrils to Terahertz Pulses: A Nonequilibrium Molecular Dynamics Study
items.title_zh: 淀粉样β纤维对太赫兹脉冲的频率依赖性结构响应：非平衡分子动力学研究
items.abstract_en: The abnormal aggregation of amyloid proteins into fibrils is closely associated with several neurodegenerative diseases, highlighting the importance of developing effective strategies to modulate fibril structural stability. Here, we employed nonequilibrium molecular dynamics(NEMD) simulations to examine the effects of intense terahertz-to-mid-infrared pulses on three amyloid fibrils (2LMP, 2MXU, and 5OQV), focusing on the combined effects of pulse frequency and electric-field strength. Frequency scans from 0.5 to 60 THz in 0.5 THz steps revealed frequency-dependent losses of {beta}-sheet content, with several common response patterns in these fibrils. Comparisons at 2, 23, 33, and 50 THz showed that pulse-induced changes in secondary structure differed from those in high-temperature controls. Hydrogen-bond analysis showed that total hydrogen-bond counts could partially recover even as interchain hydrogen bonds continued to decrease, with distinct responses among representative chain pairs. We therefore propose a two-threshold electric-field framework for fibril disruption: Eth1 describes the onset of structural perturbation, whereas Eth2 indicates persistent structural loss after the pulse. This framework offers a testable approach for characterizing amyloid structural responses to external fields, although the underlying energy-coupling mechanisms, quantitative thresholds, and long-term recovery require further validation. These findings may provide a theoretical basis for exploring external-field-based strategies to modulate protein aggregation.
items.abstract_zh: 淀粉样蛋白异常聚集为纤维与多种神经退行性疾病密切相关，凸显了开发有效策略调节纤维结构稳定性的重要性。在此，我们采用非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）模拟，考察强太赫兹至中红外脉冲对三种淀粉样纤维（2LMP、2MXU和5OQV）的影响，重点关注脉冲频率和电场强度的联合效应。以0.5 THz为步长从0.5到60 THz进行频率扫描，揭示了β-折叠含量的频率依赖性损失，并在这些纤维中呈现出若干共同响应模式。在2、23、33和50 THz处的比较显示，脉冲诱导的二级结构变化不同于高温对照中的变化。氢键分析显示，即使链间氢键持续减少，总氢键数仍可部分恢复，且代表性链对之间具有不同响应。因此，我们提出一个用于纤维破坏的双阈值电场框架：Eth1描述结构扰动的起始，而Eth2指示脉冲后持续的结构损失。该框架为表征淀粉样结构对外部场的响应提供了一种可检验的方法，尽管潜在的能量耦合机制、定量阈值和长期恢复仍需进一步验证。这些发现可能为探索基于外部场调节蛋白质聚集的策略提供理论基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。

items.title_en: Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning
items.title_zh: 超越量子消息：迈向量子原生网络功能
items.abstract_en: The Quantum Internet is commonly envisioned as a network that transports quantum states and distributes entanglement as the key resource underpinning distributed quantum applications. This view is necessary but incomplete if quantum phenomena are confined to what the network carries or manages, while network functionalities remain grounded predominantly in classical abstractions. This Perspective advances a broader thesis: quantum phenomena can also participate directly in the realization of network functionalities. We first establish the architectural baseline by introducing entanglement as a stateful network resource whose operational condition is non-locally distributed across remote nodes, evolves through manipulation or consumption, and degrades over time through decoherence. Its evolving state must therefore remain visible to the functionalities acting on it. We then move beyond resource visibility and use two mechanisms as proof points of a broader quantum-native functional design space: entanglement generation during propagation through coherent spatial-path superposition, and operational connectivity induced by shared entanglement that can depart from the physical graph. These examples show that paths, neighbors, or participating nodes may become operationally relevant in ways determined by quantum coherence and shared entanglement, rather than by physical connectivity alone. We identify Quantum Addressing as a transversal abstraction capable of representing such relations while complementing, rather than replacing, classical addressing and signaling. The resulting perspective broadens the Quantum Internet from transporting quantum information and distributing entanglement to exploiting quantum phenomena in network functioning, opening a coupled frontier spanning routing, forwarding, control, and functionality placement.
items.abstract_zh: 量子互联网通常被设想为传输量子态并分发纠缠的网络，纠缠是支撑分布式量子应用的关键资源。如果量子现象仅限于网络所承载或管理的内容，而网络功能仍主要基于经典抽象，那么这种观点虽必要但不完整。本观点文章提出一个更广泛的论点：量子现象也可以直接参与网络功能的实现。我们首先建立架构基线，将纠缠引入为一种有状态网络资源，其运行条件非局部地分布在远程节点上，通过操纵或消耗而演化，并因退相干随时间退化。因此，其演化状态必须对作用于其上的功能保持可见。随后，我们超越资源可见性，以两个机制作为更广泛量子原生功能设计空间的例证：通过相干空间路径叠加在传播过程中生成纠缠，以及由共享纠缠诱导的、可偏离物理图的操作连通性。这些例子表明，路径、邻居或参与节点可能以由量子相干和共享纠缠而非仅物理连通性决定的方式变得在操作上相关。我们将量子寻址识别为一种横向抽象，能够表示此类关系，同时补充而非替代经典寻址与信令。由此形成的观点将量子互联网从传输量子信息和分发纠缠，拓展到在网络功能中利用量子现象，开辟了跨越路由、转发、控制和功能放置的耦合前沿。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: 13,000-Fold Frequency Down Conversion From 280 MHz to 21 kHz Using Mechanical Frequency Combs
items.title_zh: 利用机械频率梳实现从280 MHz到21 kHz的13,000倍频率下转换
items.abstract_en: Optical frequency combs bridge the microwave and terahertz regimes by down-converting terahertz optical energy into microwave signals. A photodetector converts the comb's equally spaced lines, generated through optical nonlinearities, into a low-frequency tone at their spacing. Here, we present the first mechanical version of this process, using mechanical frequency combs to downconvert energy over 4 orders of magnitude, from the MHz to kHz regime. Thin-film lithium niobate (LN) is used to design an acoustic resonator with a wide range of mode frequencies. We achieve phononic comb excitation from 250 MHz to 900 MHz and compare the electrical and laser Doppler vibrometer (LDV) measurements at 277 MHz. We then show the low-frequency spectrum of the devices, highlighting mechanical motion at the comb's spacing and demonstrating energy transfer from 277 MHz to 21 kHz.
items.abstract_zh: 光学频率梳通过将太赫兹光能量下转换为微波信号，架起微波与太赫兹区间之间的桥梁。光电探测器将经由光学非线性产生的、等间隔的梳线转换为以其间隔为频率的低频音调。在此，我们首次展示该过程的机械版本，利用机械频率梳将能量下转换超过4个数量级，从MHz区间到kHz区间。使用薄膜铌酸锂（LN）设计具有宽模式频率范围的声学谐振器。我们实现了250 MHz至900 MHz的声子梳激发，并比较了277 MHz处的电学测量与激光多普勒振动计（LDV）测量。随后我们展示器件的低频频谱，突出梳间隔处的机械运动，并演示从277 MHz到21 kHz的能量转移。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对波长、器件、光路、噪声与实验条件；数值仿真不等于已制备器件或可直接部署。

items.title_en: Representational drift in a code model: behaviour settles, which neurons carry it does not
items.title_zh: 代码模型中的表征漂移：行为稳定下来，承载它的神经元却不稳定
items.abstract_en: In neuroscience, representational drift is a change in which neurons carry a representation while behaviour stays the same; we measure its analogue in OpenCoder-1.5B during pretraining, for 169 Python constructs over two trillion tokens at a constant learning rate, with a noise unit on every change, at checkpoints as close as 1,000 training steps. For 16 of the 169, those whose grammar fixes a next token, the loss at those positions reaches its floor within the first 4% of training, while the model's reliance on the neurons carrying them grows to the end: removing them costs 0.06, 0.25 and 0.40 nats more than removing a random set, at 4 billion, 84 billion and 2 trillion tokens. Which neurons carry a construct never settles: for all 169 the carrier set is still changing at the last checkpoint, and an abrupt settling at any date from 84 billion to 1.5 trillion tokens, or a gradual one before 500 billion, would have been detected in 99% of injected cases. The set measured at 84 billion tokens, removed at the end, cannot be separated from a random set, so the function is carried by whichever neurons are current. Up close the change is a persisting pool and a changing sample: a neuron that leaves a construct's set returns at three times the rate of a matched neuron, and no set reassembles. The hypothesis we fixed in advance, that the carriers settle, is refuted; we discuss candidate causes and name the experiment that would separate them.
items.abstract_zh: 在神经科学中，表征漂移是指在行为保持不变的情况下，承载某一表征的神经元发生改变；我们在预训练期间于 OpenCoder-1.5B 中测量其类似现象，针对169个 Python 构造、在恒定学习率下跨越两万亿 token，每次变更都设有噪声单元，检查点间隔近至1,000个训练步。在169个构造中，有16个（其语法确定下一个 token）的损失在这些位置于训练前4%内就达到下限，而模型对承载它们的神经元的依赖一直增长到训练结束：在40亿、840亿和2万亿 token 处，移除这些神经元比移除随机神经元集合分别多付出0.06、0.25和0.40 nats 的代价。承载某一构造的神经元始终未稳定：全部169个构造的承载集合在最后一个检查点仍在变化，而若在840亿至1.5万亿 token 之间的任一时刻突然稳定，或在5000亿 token 之前逐渐稳定，在99%的注入情形中都会被发现。在840亿 token 处测得的集合，在末尾被移除时，无法与随机集合区分，因此功能由当前哪些神经元承载。细看之下，变化是一个持续存在的池子与不断变化的样本：离开某构造集合的神经元回归的速率是匹配神经元的3倍，且没有任何集合重新聚合。我们预先固定的假设——承载者会稳定——被否定；我们讨论可能的原因，并指出能区分它们的实验。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Dual-Arm Tabletop Rearrangement with Movable Stacking and Gap-Aware Push Transfers
items.title_zh: 基于可移动堆叠与间隙感知推动转移的双臂桌面重排
items.abstract_en: Object rearrangement in cluttered tabletop scenes is challenging, especially in wide workspaces where dual-arm systems improve coverage and efficiency. Limited free space often necessitates buffering, while objects near or across the shared reachability region of the manipulators must be transferred under careful coordination to avoid inter-arm collisions. Conventional inter-arm transfer typically relies on a fixed handoff configuration, which constrains where and how objects are exchanged, enforces spatiotemporal synchronization of the arms, and reduces flexibility in dense layouts. This paper presents a dual-arm rearrangement framework that combines movable stacking with Gap-Aware Push Transfer for asynchronous cross-boundary exchange. The method scans the shared boundary to identify collision-free transfer gaps, places an object near a selected crossing point, and then pushes it into the receiving workspace without requiring simultaneous interaction between the two arms. A joint Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based planner coordinates both manipulators while reasoning over buffering and transfer decisions, and execution cost is used after planning to assess the resulting plan. Experiments show that the proposed method shortens joint execution sequences and becomes increasingly advantageous over a fixed handoff baseline as scene density increases, achieving lower execution cost in denser scenes while remaining competitive in lighter ones.
items.abstract_zh: 在杂乱桌面场景中进行物体重排具有挑战性，尤其是在双臂系统可提高覆盖范围和效率的宽工作空间中。有限的自由空间通常需要缓冲，而位于或跨越机械臂共享可达区域附近的物体必须在仔细协调下转移，以避免臂间碰撞。传统的臂间转移通常依赖固定的交接配置，这限制了物体交换的位置和方式，强制双臂在时空上同步，并降低了密集布局中的灵活性。本文提出一种双臂重排框架，将可移动堆叠与间隙感知推动转移相结合，用于异步跨边界交换。该方法扫描共享边界以识别无碰撞转移间隙，将物体放置在选定穿越点附近，然后将其推入接收工作空间，而不需要两臂同时交互。一个联合的基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的规划器在推理缓冲和转移决策的同时协调两个机械臂，并在规划后使用执行成本评估所得计划。实验表明，所提方法缩短了联合执行序列，并且随着场景密度增加，相对于固定交接基线越来越具有优势，在更密集场景中实现更低执行成本，同时在较稀疏场景中仍具竞争力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: FishSense Lite: A Camera-Based, Single Laser Hardware Framework with Software System for In Situ Fish Length Measurement
items.title_zh: FishSense Lite：一种基于相机、单激光的硬件框架及软件系统，用于原位鱼类体长测量
items.abstract_en: Fish stock assessments need fish lengths paired with species from far more places than trained surveyors can reach. Recreational divers already visit many of those places, but measuring a fish underwater has required trained observers or specialist equipment. We present FishSense Lite, which recovers fish length from a single photograph taken with a recreational dive camera, a dive laser pointer, and a 3D-printed mount. The diver aims the laser at a fish and takes a picture; afterward, the dot's position in the image gives the range to the fish, and the range turns the fish's size in the image into a length. A citizen-science program, trained by the system's builders, taught its own divers and collected lengths paired with species for 73 wild fish across seven open-water dives. On seven wild fish also measured by an underwater stereo-imaging system, the two instruments agreed without detectable bias (mean difference +0.8%). On rigid targets of known length, FishSense Lite recovered every target to within 1.3%, and 99% of 1,055 frames fell within a 15% error budget. From the error sources we measure, we derive a field protocol: calibrate against a dive slate on every dive, photograph fish within 15 degrees of perpendicular and beyond 1 m, and take at least ten frames of each.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼类种群评估需要在远比受过训练的调查人员所能到达的更多地点获得鱼类体长及对应物种。休闲潜水员已经到访许多此类地点，但在水下测量鱼类一直需要受训观察者或专门设备。我们提出 FishSense Lite，它从一张由休闲潜水相机、潜水激光笔和3D打印支架拍摄的照片中恢复鱼类体长。潜水员将激光对准鱼并拍照；之后，光斑在图像中的位置给出到鱼的距离，该距离将图像中鱼的尺寸转换为体长。一个由系统构建者培训的公民科学项目，培训了自己的潜水员，并在七次开放水域潜水中为73条野生鱼收集了体长及对应物种。在同样由水下立体成像系统测量的七条野生鱼上，两种仪器一致，未检测到偏差（平均差 +0.8%）。在已知长度的刚性目标上，FishSense Lite 将所有目标恢复到1.3%以内，1,055帧中有99%落在15%的误差预算内。根据我们测量的误差来源，我们推导出一套野外规程：每次潜水都用潜水记录板进行校准，在距垂直方向15度以内且超过1 m处拍摄鱼，并对每条鱼至少拍摄十帧。

items.title_en: Self-Supervised Learning of Local Predictive Directions as a Neural Computation
items.title_zh: 作为神经计算的局部预测方向自监督学习
items.abstract_en: Natural sensory dynamics are globally nonlinear but often exhibit simple local geometry, with nearby trajectories evolving preferentially along a small number of predictive directions. We ask how neural circuits could discover this geometry directly from temporal experience. We introduce Local Predictive Directions (LPD), a self-supervised framework that learns local directions whose projections maximally predict near-future trajectory evolution. LPD applies past-future canonical correlation analysis to temporal differences, making the learned representation invariant to translations of the underlying state while avoiding estimation of equilibria or a global dynamical model. To represent systems with multiple predictive regimes, we introduce a non-negative similarity-matching objective, with offline and online algorithms, that partitions trajectory segments into predictive domains, each associated with a distinct local predictive direction. The online algorithm admits a natural neural-network interpretation: the resulting activities provide soft domain assignments, while synaptic weights encode the corresponding local predictive filters. On stochastic nonlinear dynamical systems, LPD recovers the local predictive geometry and partitions trajectories into distinct dynamical regimes. On naturalistic sensory streams, the online algorithm produces center-surround spatial receptive fields and ON/OFF sustained and transient temporal filters resembling those of early visual neurons. Our results suggest that predictive learning can provide a self-supervised mechanism by which neural circuits discover the local geometry of environmental dynamics and represent it in receptive fields.
items.abstract_zh: 自然感官动力学在全局上是非线性的，但往往表现出简单的局部几何结构，邻近轨迹优先沿少量预测方向演化。我们追问神经回路如何能够直接从时间经验中发现这种几何结构。我们引入局部预测方向（Local Predictive Directions, LPD），一个自监督框架，学习这样的局部方向：其投影能够最大程度地预测近未来的轨迹演化。LPD 对时间差分施加过去-未来典型相关分析，使学习到的表征对底层状态的平移不变，同时避免估计平衡点或全局动力学模型。为表示具有多种预测体制的系统，我们引入一个非负相似性匹配目标，配有离线与在线算法，将轨迹片段划分为预测域，每个域关联一个不同的局部预测方向。在线算法具有自然的神经网络解释：由此产生的活动提供软性域分配，而突触权重编码相应的局部预测滤波器。在随机非线性动力系统上，LPD 恢复了局部预测几何，并将轨迹划分为不同的动力学体制。在自然感官流上，在线算法产生中心-外周空间感受野，以及类似早期视觉神经元的 ON/OFF 持续与瞬态时间滤波器。我们的结果表明，预测学习可以提供一种自监督机制，使神经回路发现环境动力学的局部几何并在感受野中加以表示。

items.title_en: Accelerating Quantum-Classical Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo with Shadow-Trained Neural Quantum States
items.title_zh: 利用影子训练的神经量子态加速量子-经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛
items.abstract_en: Quantum-classical auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (QC-AFQMC) uses a trial state prepared on a quantum computer to improve the accuracy of the classical AFQMC algorithm. State-of-the-art QC-AFQMC represents this state with matchgate shadows, so every trial-walker overlap and local energy must be averaged over many snapshots, making this classical computation a bottleneck. Here we distill the matchgate shadow data into a symmetry-constrained, noise-aware, autoregressive transformer neural quantum state (NQS). Used as the AFQMC trial state, the NQS evaluates overlaps, force biases, and local energies without repeatedly summing over the matchgate shadows. For a nickel-catalyzed oxidative-addition reaction, the noise-awareness of our NQS design successfully recovers the ideal-upCCD AFQMC barrier and reaction energy within statistical uncertainty, while standard QC-AFQMC execution with the same shadow data yields qualitatively inaccurate results as a result of hardware noise. Since the shadow data are needed only for training, the estimated classical cost for the nickel system falls by approximately 99% relative to our previous QC-AFQMC implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 量子-经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（QC-AFQMC）使用在量子计算机上制备的试探态来提高经典AFQMC算法的精度。最先进的QC-AFQMC用matchgate影子表示该态，因此每个试探-行走子重叠和局部能量必须对许多快照求平均，使这一经典计算成为瓶颈。在这里，我们将matchgate影子数据蒸馏为一个受对称性约束、噪声感知的自回归Transformer神经量子态（NQS）。作为AFQMC试探态使用时，NQS评估重叠、力偏差和局部能量，而无需重复对matchgate影子求和。对于镍催化的氧化加成反应，我们NQS设计的噪声感知成功在统计不确定度内恢复了理想upCCD AFQMC的势垒和反应能，而使用相同影子数据的标准QC-AFQMC执行由于硬件噪声而给出定性不准确的结果。由于影子数据仅用于训练，镍体系估计的经典成本相对于我们之前的QC-AFQMC实现下降约99%。

items.title_en: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
items.title_zh: 计算机使用代理是具身通才
items.abstract_en: In many areas of AI, general-purpose models have increasingly replaced handcrafted methods and specialized architectures. We argue that embodied AI is poised for a similar shift. Our key claim is that embodied tasks can be formulated as interaction with digital software. Specifically, we build software that renders an agent's view of a physical environment on a screen and provides controls for acting in it. A computer-use agent (CUA) can then perform embodied tasks through the same screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions that it uses to operate ordinary software. Using a single CUA design and changing only the software, our entries win first-, second-, third-, and sixth-place prizes across four ECCV workshop competitions, without any competition-specific agent tuning. These results suggest that the skills CUAs learn on software, such as visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration, already carry over to embodied tasks, giving CUAs a far broader scope in embodied AI than previously realized. We therefore advocate that computer-use agents can be embodied generalists. Further, we advocate that, by following the training strategy that made computer-use agents general, embodied AI can converge on a single general model as well, ushering in a new era of general embodied AI. Website: https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied
items.abstract_zh: 在 AI 的许多领域，通用模型已日益取代手工方法和专用架构。我们认为具身 AI 也正面临类似的转变。我们的核心主张是：具身任务可以被表述为与数字软件的交互。具体而言，我们构建软件，在屏幕上渲染代理对物理环境的视图，并提供在其中行动的控制。计算机使用代理（CUA）随后可以通过其操作普通软件所用的相同截图和键盘鼠标动作来执行具身任务。使用单一 CUA 设计、仅更换软件，我们的参赛作品在四个 ECCV 研讨会竞赛中获得第一、第二、第三和第六名，且未做任何针对竞赛的代理调优。这些结果表明，CUA 在软件上习得的技能，如视觉定位、精确点击和探索，已经可以迁移到具身任务，使 CUA 在具身 AI 中的适用范围远超此前认识。因此我们主张，计算机使用代理可以成为具身通才。进一步，我们主张，遵循使计算机使用代理变得通用的训练策略，具身 AI 也能收敛到单一通用模型，开创通用具身 AI 的新时代。网站：https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied

items.title_en: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
items.title_zh: 大语言模型不知道自己知道什么：面向金融回测的时间自知识基准测试
items.abstract_en: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的金融回测只有在模型事先并不知道被要求预测的结果时才是有意义的。从业者通过信任供应商声明的知识截止时间、询问模型它知道什么，或指示其以过去某一日期为基准作答来防范这一点。为验证这些保障措施中是否有任何一项可信，我们引入了 FinDendro，一个包含1999年至2026年间2,226条带日期的美国事实的基准，涵盖月度宏观经济序列、月末股票价格和美联储决策。每条事实生成四个提示：一个数值问题、将每个候选数值与“知道”或“猜测”的主张配对且不声明日期的 Recall 和 Predict 问题，以及一个带有历史声明日期的 Predict 问题。针对持续性和主导结果的对照使随机准确率接近0.27。结果显示，对大多数前沿模型而言，自我报告低估了其知识。GPT-5 对76%的受控事实作答正确，却声称知道38%，并且对它说自己不知道的事实中有61%作出了正确回答。知识主张可以超出所测量的知识边界，最多达七个季度；而声明日期消除了大多数先前知识的主张，同时准确率保持不变。因此，模型训练窗口内的回测无法通过自我报告、指令或声明的截止时间来证明无泄漏。这些发现推动对时间知识边界进行行为测量，FinDendro 提供了基于已展示的事实知识来选择回测周期的基准和流程。

items.title_en: PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion
items.title_zh: PhySA：解耦人形机器人运动中的审美奖励与物理奖励
items.abstract_en: Humanoid locomotion policies trained without an explicit smoothness objective tend to produce jerky, high-energy gaits that stress actuators. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer an appealing reward source: given a rendered rollout, a VLM returns an aesthetic quality score on [0,10] without task-specific feature engineering. We find, however, that aesthetic preference and physical smoothness point in opposite directions: across four production VLMs, clips with higher joint acceleration receive higher aesthetic scores (mean Pearson r=+0.66). We study PhySA (Physical Smoothness and Aesthetics), which keeps the two on separate, independently removable reward channels: a sparse, asynchronous VLM score and a phase-triggered correction channel that adjusts physical penalty weights from simulator state. Ablations attribute the smoothness gain to the correction channel. On MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 at 2.6M steps, PhySA lowers joint acceleration by 26 to 32% relative to vanilla PPO, Text2Reward, and Eureka (three seeds), at the cost of shorter episodes. In a single extended run it lowers joint acceleration by 59.5% relative to Prompt2Policy, while a three-seed replication shows a smaller, non-significant reduction (7.2%). The gain does not transfer to IsaacLab or the Unitree G1, even after rescaling the smoothness term.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有明确平滑目标的情况下训练的人形机器人运动策略往往会产生急促、高能量的步态，给执行器带来压力。视觉-语言模型（VLM）提供了一种有吸引力的奖励来源：给定渲染的 rollout，VLM 返回 [0,10] 范围内的审美质量分数，而无需任务特定的特征工程。然而，我们发现审美偏好和物理平滑性指向相反方向：在四个生产级 VLM 中，关节加速度较高的片段获得更高的审美分数（平均 Pearson r=+0.66）。我们研究 PhySA（物理平滑性与审美），它将两者保持在独立、可独立移除的奖励通道上：一个稀疏、异步的 VLM 分数，以及一个根据模拟器状态调整物理惩罚权重的相位触发校正通道。消融将平滑性增益归因于校正通道。在 MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 上，2.6M 步时，PhySA 相对于 vanilla PPO、Text2Reward 和 Eureka（三个种子）将关节加速度降低 26% 至 32%，代价是回合更短。在一次扩展运行中，它相对于 Prompt2Policy 将关节加速度降低 59.5%，而三次种子重复显示较小的、非显著的降低（7.2%）。即使重新缩放平滑项，该增益也无法迁移到 IsaacLab 或 Unitree G1。

items.title_en: MCUFlowNet: Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search for Optical Flow on Microcontrollers
items.title_zh: MCUFlowNet：面向微控制器上光流的硬件感知神经架构搜索
items.abstract_en: Dense optical flow allows small drones to avoid obstacles. However, few dense optical flow networks are designed for microcontrollers (MCUs) with neural accelerators, whose on-chip SRAM limits the input resolution. We present PACE-NAS, a macro-to-micro neural architecture search framework that decouples memory from latency: a macro design fixes the backbone and its peak SRAM, and a micro design searches operators and depths to trade accuracy against compiler-estimated latency. We apply it to EdgeFlowNet on a Grove Vision AI V2 board (Ethos-U55), where profiling locates the peak SRAM at the full-resolution output head. Replacing transposed convolutions with bilinear upsampling and convolutions lowers the peak SRAM by 18%, and two lightweight context modules lower the endpoint error (EPE) without raising the peak. All searched subnets share this peak, so the search needs no memory constraint. We name the Pareto-optimal models MCUFlowNet; the fastest variant, MCUFlowNet-S, runs 1.76x faster than a retrained EdgeFlowNet at a 1.6% higher EPE and, in simulated forest flights at 2 m/s, reaches the goal without collision in 51.5% of trials, against 41.8%. PACE-NAS also applies to semantic segmentation, where a searched PIDNet-S variant runs 1.17x faster at similar accuracy. Code is available at https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet.
items.abstract_zh: 密集光流可使小型无人机避障。然而，面向带有神经加速器的微控制器（MCU）的密集光流网络很少，其片上 SRAM 限制了输入分辨率。我们提出 PACE-NAS，一种从宏观到微观的神经架构搜索框架，将内存与延迟解耦：宏观设计固定骨干网络及其峰值 SRAM，微观设计搜索算子和深度，以在精度与编译器估计的延迟之间权衡。我们将其应用于 Grove Vision AI V2 板（Ethos-U55）上的 EdgeFlowNet，性能分析将峰值 SRAM 定位在全分辨率输出头。用双线性上采样和卷积替换转置卷积使峰值 SRAM 降低 18%，两个轻量上下文模块在不提高峰值的情况下降低端点误差（EPE）。所有搜索到的子网共享该峰值，因此搜索无需内存约束。我们将帕累托最优模型命名为 MCUFlowNet；最快变体 MCUFlowNet-S 比重新训练的 EdgeFlowNet 快 1.76 倍，EPE 高 1.6%，在 2 m/s 的模拟森林飞行中，51.5% 的试验无碰撞到达目标，而对比方法为 41.8%。PACE-NAS 也适用于语义分割，其中搜索得到的 PIDNet-S 变体在相似精度下运行快 1.17 倍。代码见 https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet。

items.title_en: Learning Time-Varying Connectomes for Stable Behavior Across Development
items.title_zh: 学习时变连接组以在发育过程中保持稳定行为
items.abstract_en: Neural circuits must maintain functionality to drive effective behavior while their size, topology, geometry, and intrinsic dynamics change across development. To model developing visuomotor circuits and behavior, we investigated whether a single compact generative encoding could produce functional recurrent controllers across such changes. Building on the HyperNEAT algorithm, we represented this program as a compositional pattern-producing network that received developmental time as an input to generate age-specific connectivity. The developmental substrate prescribed neuronal birth, position, sensory organization, and intrinsic time constants. We tested this approach using two geometrically distinct developmental substrates and two visuomotor tasks: optomotor responses and phototaxis. Controllers optimized at only the initial or mature substrate generally failed when evaluated at other ages. In contrast, controllers optimized across multiple developmental snapshots maintained substantially higher and more consistent performance across trained and unseen ages. Optimization at only three developmental snapshots was often sufficient to produce effective behavior across the tested developmental interval. The resulting connectomes changed substantially with age and did not converge on a single trajectory of sparsity or connection-weight statistics. Controllers also differed in whether they relied on neurons born later in development. These results demonstrate that a shared spatiotemporal time-varying connectivity program can produce recurrent neural networks that preserve behavior across substantial developmental changes. Together, these results provide a framework for studying how functional stability can emerge without requiring structural or dynamical stability.
items.abstract_zh: 神经回路必须维持功能以驱动有效行为，同时其大小、拓扑、几何结构和内在动力学在发育过程中发生变化。为对发育中的视觉运动回路和行为建模，我们研究了单一紧凑的生成式编码能否在此类变化中产生有功能的循环控制器。基于 HyperNEAT 算法，我们将该程序表示为一个组合模式生成网络，其接收发育时间作为输入以生成年龄特异性连接。发育基质规定了神经元诞生、位置、感觉组织和内在时间常数。我们使用两个几何上不同的发育基质和两个视觉运动任务——视动反应和趋光性——测试了该方法。仅在初始或成熟基质上优化的控制器在其他年龄评估时通常失败。相反，在多个发育快照上优化的控制器在已训练和未见年龄上保持了显著更高且更一致的性能。仅在三个发育快照上优化通常就足以在测试的发育区间内产生有效行为。所得连接组随年龄发生显著变化，并且未收敛到单一的稀疏性或连接权重统计轨迹。控制器在是否依赖发育后期诞生的神经元方面也存在差异。这些结果表明，共享的时空时变连接程序可产生在显著发育变化中保持行为的循环神经网络。总之，这些结果为研究功能稳定性如何在不要求结构或动力学稳定性的情况下出现提供了框架。

items.title_en: Majorana corner modes and tunable braiding in an altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure
items.title_zh: 交错磁体-超导体异质结构中的马约拉纳角模与可调编织
items.abstract_en: Zeeman fields are usually required for realizing and manipulating Majorana corner modes at the cost of suppressed superconducting pairing. Altermagnetism offers a new route toward realizing Majorana corner modes under zero net external magnetic fields. Here we propose a theoretical scheme to host Majorana corner modes in a honeycomb-lattice altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure. In contrast to previous studies on square lattices, altermagnetism yields distinct effective low-energy edge masses on various inequivalent edges of the honeycomb lattice. Within a low-energy edge-theory framework, we establish the conditions under which Majorana corner modes emerge for both bearded and zigzag edge terminations. We further explicitly construct a complete set of Clifford gates by tuning the altermagnetic anisotropy and chemical potential of the heterostructure. Our results provide a promising platform for the realization and manipulation of Majorana corner modes.
items.abstract_zh: 实现和操纵马约拉纳角模通常需要塞曼场，代价是超导配对被抑制。交错磁性为在零净外部磁场下实现马约拉纳角模提供了新途径。在此，我们提出一种理论方案，在蜂窝晶格交错磁体-超导体异质结构中承载马约拉纳角模。与先前在方晶格上的研究不同，交错磁性在蜂窝晶格的不同非等价边缘上产生不同的有效低能边缘质量。在低能边缘理论框架内，我们建立了在胡须型和锯齿型边缘终止下马约拉纳角模出现的条件。我们进一步通过调节异质结构的交错磁各向异性和化学势，显式构造了一组完整的Clifford门。我们的结果为马约拉纳角模的实现和操纵提供了一个有前景的平台。

items.title_en: Fifty-Two Shades of Pig: What the UCR Archive Really Asks Classifiers to Do
items.title_zh: 五十二种猪：UCR 档案究竟要求分类器做什么
items.abstract_en: The pigs were bleeding. That was the point of the experiment: could airway pressure reveal hemorrhage before it became critical? In the UCR Time Series Classification Archive, the de facto benchmark for Time Series Classification (TSC), the same recordings ask a different question: "which of 52 pigs produced this trace?". The dataset PigAirwayPressure is not an outlier. Although the archive is the standard benchmark, whether its tasks resemble the problems TSC is meant to solve has rarely been examined. We find that several datasets are repurposed from their original task, built from toy setups, or have flawed test splits. We further question how representative the archive's ordered non-temporal sequences (e.g. spectra, shape outlines) are of real TSC, and the potential downsides from the decomposition of multivariate problems. Our findings call for more careful interpretation of archive-wide scores and greater attention to deployment-relevant evaluation. The audit is at https://github.com/automl/ucr-provenance-audit.
items.abstract_zh: 那些猪在流血。这正是实验的目的：气道压力能否在出血变得危急之前揭示它？在 UCR 时间序列分类档案——时间序列分类（TSC）事实上的基准——中，同样的记录却提出另一个问题：“这条迹线由52头猪中的哪一头产生？”数据集 PigAirwayPressure 并非异类。尽管该档案是标准基准，但其任务是否类似于 TSC 本应解决的问题却很少被审视。我们发现若干数据集是由原始任务改造而来、由玩具式设置构建，或存在有缺陷的测试划分。我们进一步质疑该档案中的有序非时间序列（如光谱、形状轮廓）对真实 TSC 的代表性，以及多变量问题分解可能带来的潜在弊端。我们的发现呼吁对全档案范围的分数作更谨慎的解读，并更加关注与部署相关的评估。审计见 https://github.com/automl/ucr-provenance-audit。

items.title_en: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
items.title_zh: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法-系统协同设计实现原生 FP4 KV 缓存解码
items.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.
items.abstract_zh: 键值（KV）缓存主导长上下文 LLM 服务中的内存容量和带宽。虽然 4 位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）可缩小缓存并在 FP4 Tensor Core 上运行注意力，但算法量化与系统感知加速之间仍存在根本差距：现有 FP4 KV 系统使用朴素量化，导致严重精度下降；而面向精度的 4 位算法依赖向量码本，其查找开销会降低解码吞吐。我们提出 BitDecoding-FP4，一种用于准确高效原生 FP4 KV 解码的算法-系统协同设计。我们缓解三个误差来源：双残差查询量化（Dual-Residual Query Quantization）将查询拆分为两个 FP4 张量，将查询 logit 误差从 60% 降至 1%；下溢感知概率缩放（Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling）防止 E4M3 缩放因子将长上下文概率舍入为零；离群值感知键量化（Outlier-Aware Key Quantization）结合静态平滑、Hadamard 旋转和缩放搜索，在逐 token 缩放条件下抑制键离群值。在系统层面，我们通过转置 softmax（融合概率量化）以及在分页 KV 缓存上堆叠查询 MMA，消除 softmax 瓶颈。在采用 GQA 和 MLA 的稠密与 MoE 模型中，BitDecoding-FP4 在 NVFP4 下与 BF16 KV 精度的差距保持在 0.5 分以内（MXFP4 下为 1 分），并在 RL 训练 rollout 中与 BF16 KV 保持一致。在 NVIDIA B300 上使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 进行端到端服务时，其峰值服务吞吐量比 BF16 KV 高 2.4-3.0 倍。实现见 https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4。

items.title_en: Training-Independent Validation of a Learning-Based Controller for Stunt Maneuvers
items.title_zh: 面向特技机动的学习型控制器的训练无关验证
items.abstract_en: Learned controllers for vehicle maneuvers are usually validated under the conditions and objective used to train them, where they appear highly reliable, yet the parameters that change on real roads are often not those the model was trained on. We argue that validation must be independent of training: it should vary physical parameters that training kept fixed and use acceptance criteria absent from the training objective. A learning-based control policy, G-Maneuver, with 90.11% success is tested for stunt-level maneuvers. A looser terminal-heading score ranked the worst setting as the best. Because real stunt tests are safety-critical, a simulation-to-reality-to-simulation (Sim2Real2Sim) loop uses the simulation to select safe zones for real-vehicle trials with 16.9% acceptance. Automotive safety analysis frameworks are used to identify parameters for validation using coverage tests. We demonstrated that the kinematic stunt-driving indicators, namely heading change, sideslip, and speed-normalized yaw rate, match between simulation and the real world, while force and roll indicators do not, which identifies the indicators that can support safe deployment. A video of the experiments is available at https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo.
items.abstract_zh: 用于车辆机动的学习型控制器通常在训练所用条件和目标下验证，此时它们看起来高度可靠，但真实道路上发生变化的参数往往不是模型训练时所针对的参数。我们认为验证必须独立于训练：应改变训练中保持固定的物理参数，并使用训练目标中不存在的接受标准。学习型控制策略G-Maneuver以90.11%的成功率针对特技级机动进行测试。一个更宽松的终端航向评分将最差设置评为最佳。由于真实特技测试是安全关键的，采用模拟到现实再到模拟（Sim2Real2Sim）循环，利用模拟为真实车辆试验选择安全区域，接受率为16.9%。使用汽车安全分析框架，通过覆盖测试识别用于验证的参数。我们证明，运动学特技驾驶指标，即航向变化、侧滑和速度归一化偏航率，在模拟与真实世界之间匹配，而力和侧倾指标不匹配，从而识别出可支持安全部署的指标。实验视频见 https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo。

items.title_en: Frontier3DBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for 3D Creation across Objects, Scenes, and Interactive Open Worlds
items.title_zh: Frontier3DBench：面向对象、场景与交互式开放世界 3D 创作的编码智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: Coding agents combine visual understanding with program execution, offering a new route to automated 3D creation. By translating images and instructions into editable programs, they bring reconstruction, generation, and editing into a shared workflow. Yet existing benchmarks fragment evaluation across task scopes and protocols, leaving their capabilities across construction levels unclear. We propose Frontier3DBench, a unified benchmark of 145 tasks across 9 categories spanning object, scene, and interactive open-world creation, with joint evaluation of appearance, structure, and behavior. Experiments with 11 model-harness configurations reveal strengths that vary by level: GPT-6.1-sol leads the object and scene levels and achieves the highest overall score of 66.02/100, whereas GPT-6-astra leads interactive world construction. However, all configurations score lower on reference reconstruction than on text-driven generation in object and scene tasks. Producing plausible content thus remains easier than reproducing specified geometry, layouts, and visual details. Moreover, generated worlds average 83.08/100 on local mechanisms but only 20.82 on motion clearance and 30.26 on stateful workflows: individual mechanisms often function, whereas complete activities that require coordinated actions and persistent state remain difficult. These results identify reference fidelity and coordinated activity completion as central bottlenecks for coding agents in 3D creation.
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体将视觉理解与程序执行相结合，为自动化 3D 创作提供了新途径。通过将图像和指令转换为可编辑程序，它们将重建、生成和编辑纳入统一工作流。然而，现有基准将评估分散在不同任务范围和协议中，使其在不同构建层级上的能力仍不清晰。我们提出 Frontier3DBench，一个统一基准，包含跨 9 个类别的 145 项任务，覆盖对象、场景和交互式开放世界创作，并联合评估外观、结构和行为。对 11 种模型-评测框架配置的实验揭示了随层级而异的优势：GPT-6.1-sol 在对象和场景层级领先，并取得 66.02/100 的最高总分，而 GPT-6-astra 在交互式世界构建中领先。然而，在对象和场景任务中，所有配置在参考重建上的得分都低于文本驱动生成。因此，生成看似合理的内容仍比复现指定几何、布局和视觉细节更容易。此外，生成世界在局部机制上平均得分为 83.08/100，但在运动间隙上仅为 20.82，在有状态工作流上为 30.26：单个机制通常能发挥作用，而需要协调动作和持久状态的完整活动仍然困难。这些结果将参考保真度和协调活动完成确定为编码智能体在 3D 创作中的核心瓶颈。

items.title_en: Synchronized Hearts, Desynchronized Brains: A Nonlinear Dynamics Perspective for Function and Failure
items.title_zh: 同步的心脏，去同步的大脑：功能与失效的非线性动力学视角
items.abstract_en: Both the heart and the brain are built from electrically excitable cells, yet the emergent dynamics of these organs could not differ more. In the myocardium, a coherent traveling wave of action potentials ensures coordinated contraction; in the cerebral cortex, distributed, irregular spiking underlies efficient information processing and the generation of behavior. Here, we illuminate the principles that underlie the emergence of such distinct nonlinear dynamics using concepts from complex systems. We trace these principles across scales from ion channels and cellular action potential generation, through cellular coupling mechanisms and network architecture, to organ level dynamics and clinical phenotypes. Designed to support either synchronized waves or desynchronized information processing, the heart and the brain can thus be understood as operating on opposite sides of a synchronization phase transition. Crossing this transition implies pathological dynamics in both organs: Loss of synchrony in the heart produces arrhythmia; excess synchrony in the brain leads to epileptic seizures. We discuss how adaptation mechanisms, including plasticity, modulation, remodeling, and learning, maintain the appropriate level of (de)synchronization. Overall, we provide a unified excitable-system perspective, together with an educational notebook, to foster cross-disciplinary insights into cardiac and neural function and pathology.
items.abstract_zh: 心脏和大脑都由电兴奋性细胞构成，但这些器官的涌现动力学却截然不同。在心肌中，一致的动作电位行波确保协调收缩；在大脑皮层中，分布式、不规则的尖峰活动是高效信息处理和行为产生的基础。本文利用复杂系统概念，阐明这种不同非线性动力学涌现背后的原理。我们跨尺度追踪这些原理：从离子通道和细胞动作电位产生，到细胞耦合机制和网络架构，再到器官层面动力学和临床表型。心脏和大脑被设计为分别支持同步波或去同步信息处理，因此可被理解为运行在同步相变的两侧。跨越该相变意味着两个器官都会出现病理性动力学：心脏失去同步性会产生心律失常；大脑同步性过度会导致癫痫发作。我们讨论适应机制，包括可塑性、调制、重塑和学习，如何维持适当的（去）同步水平。总体而言，我们提供一个统一的兴奋系统视角以及一个教学笔记本，以促进对心脏和神经功能与病理的跨学科理解。

items.title_en: PolyGPT: A Decoder-Only Transformer for Polymer Electrolyte Design
items.title_zh: PolyGPT：用于聚合物电解质设计的仅解码器Transformer
items.abstract_en: Designing polymer electrolytes requires control over both material properties and chemical structure. Here, we present PolyGPT, a Transformer with 38.3 million parameters that generates polymer repeat units from optional property targets, requests to include or exclude a specified chemical feature, and an electrolyte-domain condition. Using the model selected by validation loss, we compared unconditional generation with requests for electrolyte-associated structures, a low glass-transition temperature (Tg), or both. Unconditional and electrolyte-only generation achieved structural validity of 99.46% and 99.59%, respectively. However, electrolyte conditioning increased repetition: uniqueness among valid outputs fell from 99.99% to 51.74%. At a Tg target of 246.11 K, we compared generation with and without electrolyte conditioning, and adding the electrolyte condition slightly reduced the predictor-estimated mean absolute error from 26.97 to 26.07 K, but the fraction of all attempts yielding distinct valid polymers within 50 K of the target fell from 82.35% to 32.31%. When we also required absence from the training catalog, these yields were 59.90% and 19.71%, respectively. The lower yield persisted with a tighter 25 K tolerance. Domain conditioning also weakened control of inclusion requests: the mean fraction of attempts producing valid polymers containing the requested chemical feature fell from 94.27% to 31.27%. Across nine checkpoints, earlier models sometimes produced more distinct, catalog-unseen polymers meeting the Tg target: 10,000 checkpoint model with electrolyte conditioning and 30,000 checkpoint model without it. Together, these results show why property error alone is insufficient for evaluating conditional polymer generation. It must be considered alongside repetition, training-catalog novelty, and whether combined design requests are satisfied.
items.abstract_zh: 设计聚合物电解质需要同时控制材料性质和化学结构。在此，我们提出PolyGPT，一个具有3830万参数的Transformer，可根据可选的性质目标、包含或排除指定化学特征的请求以及电解质领域条件生成聚合物重复单元。使用由验证损失选出的模型，我们比较了无条件生成与请求电解质相关结构、低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）或两者兼有的生成。无条件生成和仅电解质生成的结构有效率分别为99.46%和99.59%。然而，电解质条件化增加了重复：有效输出中的唯一性从99.99%降至51.74%。在Tg目标为246.11 K时，我们比较了有和无电解质条件化的生成，加入电解质条件使预测器估计的平均绝对误差从26.97 K略降至26.07 K，但所有尝试中产生与目标相差50 K以内且互不相同的有效聚合物的比例从82.35%降至32.31%。当我们还要求不存在于训练目录中时，这些产率分别为59.90%和19.71%。在更严格的25 K容差下，较低产率仍然存在。领域条件化也削弱了对包含请求的控制：产生包含所请求化学特征的有效聚合物的尝试平均比例从94.27%降至31.27%。在九个检查点中，较早的模型有时产生更多满足Tg目标的互不相同且训练目录未见过的聚合物：带电解质条件化的10,000检查点模型和不带电解质条件化的30,000检查点模型。总之，这些结果表明为什么仅凭性质误差不足以评估条件聚合物生成。必须同时考虑重复、训练目录新颖性以及组合设计请求是否被满足。

items.title_en: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
items.title_zh: 两层对话记忆中的压缩、衰减与强化：与检索增强生成的配对评估
items.abstract_en: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations.
items.abstract_zh: 一个能记忆的对话智能体必须决定保留什么。检索增强生成保留对话记录并对其进行搜索；另一种方法是将每轮对话压缩为原子事实并搜索这些事实。我们在 LoCoMo 上比较两者：两个实验组都在一个窗口内回答全部 1,985 个问题，使用相同的存储、相同的生成器和评判器，并将两者的预测放在同一行，从而允许对二者不一致的 512 个问题使用 McNemar 精确检验。在可比工作报告的四个类别上，压缩方法得分为 71.4%，对比方法为 64.6%，领先 6.8 分（p = 5.5e-08），且提示 token 少 34%。在全部五个类别上（包括可比工作所舍弃的对抗集），领先优势降至 2.0 分且不再显著，因为基线在对抗集上领先 14.6 分。这一损失具有结构性。当参考答案要求更多源文本措辞时，我们的领先优势下降：当参考答案包含一两个词时领先 9.6 分，超过八个词时落后 3.1 分，token 重叠度也呈相同趋势，因此评判器并非原因。压缩保留事实所断言的内容，丢弃其表述方式，因此当答案是取值时胜出，当答案是措辞时落败。我们还报告了四项负结果及其功效计算。

items.title_en: UniLoop: Unified Loop Closure Detection from Retrieval to Geometric Verification and Relative Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: UniLoop：从检索到几何验证与相对位姿估计的统一回环检测
items.abstract_en: Loop closure detection conventionally cascades separate models for global retrieval, geometric verification, and relative pose estimation, leading to redundant computation and disconnected visual representations. We propose UniLoop, a unified framework that reuses the hierarchical representations of the pretrained geometric foundation model throughout this pipeline. A shared image encoder produces features for compact global descriptors; the same features are passed to the cross-view decoder for pairwise verification; and the original geometric predictions provide relative camera constraints for pose-graph optimization. Experiments on place recognition, loop verification, and relative pose estimation show that UniLoop improves loop-closure robustness and accuracy while reducing redundant backbone computation relative to modular pipelines. UniLoop achieves the best Recall@10 on MSLS (96.6) and Pitts30k (99.3) among the compared methods, while its verification branch reaches 95.63 AP and 96.29 ROC-AUC, surpassing the existing geometric verification baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 回环检测通常级联用于全局检索、几何验证和相对位姿估计的独立模型，导致冗余计算和割裂的视觉表示。我们提出UniLoop，一个统一框架，在整个流程中复用预训练几何基础模型的分层表示。共享图像编码器生成紧凑全局描述子的特征；相同特征被送入跨视角解码器进行成对验证；原始几何预测为位姿图优化提供相对相机约束。在地点识别、回环验证和相对位姿估计上的实验表明，相对于模块化流程，UniLoop提高了回环检测的鲁棒性和准确性，同时减少了冗余骨干计算。在比较方法中，UniLoop在MSLS（96.6）和Pitts30k（99.3）上取得最佳Recall@10，其验证分支达到95.63 AP和96.29 ROC-AUC，超过现有几何验证基线。
